jobs.title: Senior Growth Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Senior Growth Marketing Manager

Join our expanding Product Growth team! We’re actively recruiting a Senior Growth Marketing Manager as we continue to scale at M-KOPA. Most senior growth hires get one channel and one pod for years. This role is built differently: you’ll own two of our core growth pods in your first year, then land where you’ve had the most impact. It’s a fast track to pod leadership, not a support seat.

The Impact 💚

You’ll drive the conversion growth that turns customers into long-term, high-value ones, creating financial inclusion for Africa’s traditionally excluded. We’ve already helped over 10 million customers access over $2 billion in credit 🌍

The Opportunity

🏗️ Real ownership from day one. You'll be the one accountable for delivery in Repeat Phones, not shadowing or supporting someone else's plan.

🎒 Two growth motions, one year. You'll take on Digital Lending mid-way through, working directly with one of our strongest performers to understand cash loans end to end, then carry that pod solo for a defined stretch. Few people get this breadth this early.

🧭 A defined path, not indefinite floating. You'll build real expertise in our two conversion pods first, then move into Lifecycle in the second half of next year, reporting to the Lifecycle CRM Lead once you're there. The destination is set. What you bring to it is up to you. 🌍 Work inside a proven CLV engine. M-KOPA has helped more than 10 million customers access over $2 billion in credit. You'll be executing inside systems that already work, not guessing at what might.

What You'll Do

Phase 1: Repeat Phones. Take ownership of reactivation and upgrade campaigns in CleverTap, working closely with the Growth Lead there to understand what's driving the pod's numbers and where the next opportunity is. You'll be trusted to make real calls here, not just execute a checklist.

Phase 2: Cross into Digital Lending. Work directly with the Digital Lending lead, one of our top performers, to understand cash loan growth end to end before taking it on yourself.

Phase 3: Own Digital Lending. Carry primary responsibility for Digital Lending for a defined period, with the Repeat Phones lead available if you need a second opinion.

Phase 4: Move into Lifecycle. In the second half of next year, join the Lifecycle pod full-time, reporting to the Lifecycle CRM Lead. You'll bring a year of hands-on conversion experience into a pod that's still being built, real currency for shaping what Lifecycle does next. Throughout all phases, you will:

  • Build and run multi-channel campaigns (SMS, WhatsApp, push, in-app) in CleverTap against pod goals

  • Track funnel performance and flag drop-off points to the pod lead you're supporting

  • Run structured experiments (creative, audience, incentive, or timing) with clear hypotheses

  • Turn what works into documented playbooks the next person can pick up

  • Keep data quality and campaign tracking clean enough that leadership can trust the numbers

Key Metrics You'll Influence

Repeat Phones: Reactivation rate, upgrade conversion %, unit economics per sale

Digital Lending: Approval → disbursement rate, digital loan volume, approval quality

Campaign ROI and payback period across both

Your Environment

💼 Tech Stack: CleverTap (primary), Looker Channels: WhatsApp, SMS, push, in-app messaging

Markets: Kenya, Nigeria, Uganda, Ghana

What You Need

  • 5+ years in growth, performance, or lifecycle marketing, ideally in fintech, telco, or e-commerce, with real ownership over what a campaign or a pod achieved, not just involvement in it.

  • Judgment as much as skill. You can walk into a pod, understand what's working and why, and make calls on where to push, not just follow a brief.

  • Genuine appetite for pod leadership. This is a deliberate path toward owning a pod outright, and the breadth here is designed to get you there faster than a single-channel role would.

  • Hands-on fluency in CRM platforms like CleverTap, Braze, or similar, and comfortable reading a funnel or cohort without translation.

  • Energized, not unsettled, by ambiguity. You'll work across two pods and land in a third decision point by mid-year. If that sounds like an opportunity rather than a risk, you'll thrive here.

  • Strong enough presence to build trust quickly with senior leads across two different pods.

Location & Benefits

  • 🌍 Fully remote role within UTC -1 to UTC +3 time zones

  • 🤝 Work with diverse teams across UK, Europe, and Africa

  • 📚 Professional development programmes and coaching partnerships

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Family-friendly policies and flexible working arrangements

  • 💚 Well-being support and career growth opportunities

 

Our Mission 🌍

We create financial inclusion for the traditionally excluded through a fair, flexible, customer-centric financing model. We strive to drive greater inclusion of women, youth, and low-income communities.

 

Our Impact 💚

Our technology has created measurable change:

  • Connected 📱: 2.5 million first-time smartphone users connected

  • Prosperous 💰: 70% of customers use M-KOPA products for income generation, with 35,000+ livelihoods created for agents

  • Green 🌱: 2.1 million tonnes of CO₂ avoided through clean energy products, with over 127,700 circular economy products provided

 

Why M-KOPA?

At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritize well-being, and embrace flexibility.

Join us in shaping the future of M-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at m-kopa.com.

Recognized four times by the Financial Times as one Africa's fastest growing companies (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026), named on CNBC's World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025 & 2026 and by TIME100 Most influential companies in the world 2023 and 2024 , we've served over 10 million customers, unlocking $2 billion in cumulative credit for the everyday earners across Africa, in addition to over 10,000 e-bikes financed in Kenya.

Important Notice

M-KOPA is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to assembling a diverse, broadly trained staff. Women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply.

M-KOPA explicitly prohibits the use of Forced or Child Labour and respects the rights of its employees to agree to terms and conditions of employment voluntarily, without coercion, and freely terminate their employment on appropriate notice. M-KOPA shall ensure that its Employees are of legal working age and shall comply with local laws for youth employment or student work, such as internships or apprenticeships. 

M-KOPA does not collect/charge any money as a pre-employment or post-employment requirement. This means that we never ask for ‘recruitment fees’, ‘processing fees’, ‘interview fees’, or any other kind of money in exchange for offer letters or interviews at any time during the hiring process.

Applications for this position will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisting and interviews will take place at any stage during the recruitment process. We reserve the right to close the vacancy early if a suitable candidate is selected before the advertised closing date.

If your application is successful M-KOPA undertakes pre-employment background checks as part of its recruitment process, these include; criminal records, identification verification, academic qualifications, employment dates and employer references.

jobs.title: Compliance Officer / MLRO- Senegal
jobs.description:
Compliance Officer / MLRO- Senegal

Why Join dLocal?
dLocal is the financial infrastructure powering global commerce in the world's fastest-growing markets. The biggest companies in the world trust us to unlock growth in 60+ countries across emerging markets—moving money where others see complexity. We don't just process payments; we are architects of payment ecosystems and partners in our customers' expansion. You'll work alongside 1,300+ teammates from 40+ nationalities and tackle global challenges from day one.

What's the Opportunity?

We are looking for a Compliance Officer based in Senegal to join our global team. This role is open to the whole of Senegal and plays a crucial part in our banking relationships, local regulatory compliance, and internal reporting. You will serve as the primary compliance contact for all matters within the WAEMU/BCEAO zone.

What will I be doing?

KYC Onboarding

  • Oversee and manage the Know Your Customer (KYC) onboarding process for new customers and update existing ones across Senegal.

  • Ensure compliance with local and international regulatory requirements related to customer identification and verification, including BCEAO and CENTIF directives.

Transaction Monitoring

  • Implement and enhance transaction monitoring systems to detect and report suspicious activities within the Senegalese context.

  • Conduct periodic reviews and assessments to ensure the effectiveness of transaction monitoring processes.

AML/CFT Compliance

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for AML/CFT matters in Senegal.

  • Possess in-depth knowledge of Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Counter-Terrorism Financing (CFT) regulations in Senegal, including WAEMU directives, BCEAO instructions, and FATF recommendations.

  • Develop and enforce AML/CFT policies and procedures tailored to the Senegalese regulatory environment.

Regulatory Compliance

  • Stay abreast of the regulatory landscape governing the payments and financial services industry in Senegal and the wider WAEMU/ECOWAS zone.

  • Interpret and communicate regulatory changes, especially those related to AML/CFT requirements, to relevant stakeholders within the organisation.

  • Establish and maintain strong relationships with Senegalese regulators, including the BCEAO, Ministry of Finance, CENTIF, and ARTP (for mobile money services).

Remittance Compliance

  • Develop and implement compliance procedures specific to domestic and cross-border remittances in Senegal, including key corridors such as West Africa–Europe and intra-ECOWAS transfers.

  • Ensure adherence to regulatory requirements governing remittance services in the Senegalese market, with particular attention to diaspora and family remittance flows.

Risk Assessments

  • Conduct regular risk assessments to identify and mitigate potential compliance risks within the Senegalese and WAEMU context.

  • Collaborate with other departments to implement risk mitigation strategies.

Reporting

  • Report findings and compliance matters related to AML/CFT to different stakeholders in a clear and understandable manner.

  • Ensure timely and accurate reporting to internal and external stakeholders as required by Senegalese regulations, including suspicious activity reports to CENTIF and BCEAO regulatory filings.

Training and Awareness

  • Provide training to staff on compliance policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements, with a specific focus on AML/CFT in the Senegalese market.

  • Foster a culture of compliance awareness within the organisation.

What skills do I need?

Education & Certifications

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Law, Finance, Economics, or a related field; a degree from a Senegalese or WAEMU-region institution is an advantage.

  • Professional certifications are a must: CAMS, ACAMS, ICA, or an equivalent qualification recognised in Francophone Africa.

Experience

  • 4–6 years of experience in a compliance role within the banking, fintech, or financial services sector, ideally with exposure to the WAEMU/ECOWAS region.

  • Proven experience in compliance related to payments, remittances, and mobile financial services (mobile money, Wave, Orange Money, etc.).

  • Hands-on experience in building or implementing compliance-related automations (e.g., workflows, alerts, reporting systems).

  • Experience engaging with Senegalese regulators (BCEAO, CENTIF, ARTP) and maintaining positive working relationships is highly desirable.

Technical Knowledge

  • In-depth knowledge of KYC processes, transaction monitoring, and AML/CFT regulations in Senegal and the WAEMU zone.

  • Familiarity with the regulatory frameworks applicable to payment services in Senegal, including BCEAO regulations on electronic money institutions.

  • Understanding of the specific dynamics of international remittance corridors into West Africa.

Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to work in a multicultural, international environment.

  • Fluency in French is required; proficiency in English is a significant advantage; knowledge of Wolof or another local language is appreciated.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with global teams in a remote-first environment.

Compensation

Additional Information

What do we offer?
Besides the tailored benefits we have for each country, dLocal will help you thrive and go that extra mile by offering you:
- Flexibility in how you work: We focus on impact and productivity over fixed hours. This means our teams have flexible schedules and, depending on your role and location, you will combine self‑managed focus time with moments of in‑person connection in our collaboration hubs.
- Fintech industry: work in a dynamic and ever-evolving environment, with plenty to build and boost your creativity.
- Referral bonus program: our internal talents are the best recruiters - refer someone ideal for a role and get rewarded.
- Work From Anywhere: Team members can work while traveling for up to 3 months every year.

What happens after you apply?

Our Talent Acquisition team is invested in creating the best candidate experience possible, so don’t worry, you will definitely hear from us. We will review your CV and keep you posted by email at every step of the process!

Also, you can check out our webpage, Linkedin and Youtube for more about dLocal!

jobs.title: AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description:
AI/ML Engineer

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI/ML Engineer based in Switzerland.

Join a mission-driven engineering team developing practical AI systems that address real-world challenges in healthcare, agriculture, education, and international development. As an AI/ML Engineer, you will design, build, evaluate, deploy, and continuously improve AI-powered applications used by nonprofit organizations and their communities. You will work on solutions ranging from clinical copilots and AI coaching tools to agricultural advisory chatbots and evaluation infrastructure. Collaborating with behavioral scientists, researchers, and embedded engineers, you will translate applied AI research into reliable, scalable products and reusable technical resources. You will also help partner organizations strengthen their own AI capabilities through mentorship, open-source contributions, and knowledge sharing. This fully remote role offers substantial technical ownership and the opportunity to apply advanced AI engineering to initiatives that can improve outcomes for millions of people.


Accountabilities:

In this role, you will build and improve production-ready AI systems while helping nonprofit partners adopt effective, measurable, and responsible AI practices. Your work will combine hands-on engineering, applied research, experimentation, and collaboration with teams working directly in the field.

  • Design, build, evaluate, deploy, and improve machine learning systems and AI-powered applications for real-world use cases.

  • Contribute to open-source AI evaluation infrastructure and tools that help nonprofit organizations assess and improve their AI products.

  • Work closely with behavioral scientists, researchers, and field teams to identify recurring challenges and translate findings into reusable tools, frameworks, playbooks, and technical publications.

  • Develop rigorous evaluation methods for AI systems, including appropriate datasets, evaluation criteria, and measurable performance improvements.

  • Build and iterate on production-grade LLM applications and agentic systems, improving their reliability, usefulness, and performance for intended users.

  • Release meaningful technical innovations from partner projects as open-source contributions whenever appropriate.

  • Deliver solutions through rapid development and deployment cycles, using experimentation and measurable feedback to guide improvements.

  • Document technical decisions, maintain engineering standards, and ensure AI components remain reliable and maintainable.

  • Monitor developments in applied AI research, assess relevant advances, and test promising approaches in practical settings.

  • Advise and support nonprofit organizations developing generative AI products, helping them adopt effective engineering practices, tools, and workflows.

  • Mentor partner organization staff and help strengthen their internal technical capabilities and responsible AI practices.

  • Contribute to workshops, seminars, and knowledge-sharing initiatives that communicate lessons and best practices from ongoing projects.

  • Conduct site visits to understand operational challenges, observe how AI tools are used, and recommend technical improvements based on direct user needs.

  • Take initiative in identifying problems, defining solutions, and driving projects through implementation and deployment.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate combines strong machine learning fundamentals with substantial hands-on experience delivering end-user AI products. You should be comfortable moving between research, experimentation, production engineering, and collaboration with nontechnical stakeholders, while maintaining a strong focus on practical impact.

    • Strong foundations in mathematics, deep learning, large language models (LLMs), and modern AI systems.

    • At least 4 years of hands-on machine learning engineering experience, including building, evaluating, and systematically improving at least one end-user-facing product powered by deep learning. Experience limited to integrating model APIs, building internal dashboards, or contributing solely to ML infrastructure does not meet this requirement.

    • At least 1–2 years of experience building LLM-powered applications, including at least one production-grade agent beyond a proof of concept.

    • Practical experience evaluating AI systems, with a strong understanding of dataset design, evaluation methodology, and performance measurement.

    • Proficiency in Python and a willingness to remain deeply involved in hands-on implementation.

    • Fluency in prompting and context engineering for agentic systems, including the ability to determine whether a problem requires improved prompting, a different model, better tools, or changes to the overall pipeline.

    • Experience using AI coding agents to produce high-quality work, with the judgment and accountability to validate outputs and take responsibility for what you ship.

    • Ability to read research papers, assess new ideas, and quickly test relevant approaches through practical experimentation.

    • An experimental mindset, with the ability to reason carefully about data, models, and evaluation while making iterative, measurable progress.

    • Strong first-principles thinking and the ability to design practical, scalable solutions.

    • A user-focused approach that prioritizes whether a product works effectively for its intended audience.

    • Proactive ownership, urgency, attention to detail, and the ability to carry projects through to completion without constant direction.

    • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to nonengineering audiences.

    • A commitment to responsible AI development and technology that delivers meaningful social benefits.

      • Bonus qualifications:

      • Experience with multilingual natural language processing or low-resource languages, particularly Swahili, Hindi, and languages spoken across East Africa and South Asia.

      • Previous work in global health, international development, or social-impact technology.

      • Familiarity with behavioral science or AI applications designed to support behavior change.

      • Experience with data annotation pipelines and LLM evaluation methodologies.

      • Knowledge of AI safety, alignment, or responsible AI frameworks.

      • Experience deploying models in production and working with cloud infrastructure such as AWS, Google Cloud Platform, or Azure.

      • Publications at leading AI conferences or substantial technical writing documenting engineering research and results.

        • Benefits:

        • Compensation: Competitive within the mission-driven technology sector, with compensation positioned below typical big-tech salary levels.

        • Remote work: Fully remote, asynchronous-first working environment.

        • Flexible schedule: Work hours can accommodate your time zone, with no mandated core hours.

        • International collaboration: Join a globally distributed team working across North America, Europe, East Africa, East Asia, and South Asia.

        • Meaningful impact: Build AI applications addressing practical challenges in healthcare, agriculture, and other areas of international development.

        • Technical ownership: Take projects from initial problem definition and model selection through deployment, evaluation, and continuous improvement.

        • Interdisciplinary collaboration: Work alongside behavioral scientists, development economists, field researchers, and embedded engineers.

        • Open-source contributions: Share technical innovations, tools, and learnings with the wider community rather than keeping all work within proprietary products.

        • Professional development: Stay close to applied AI research and gain experience solving challenging problems in real operational environments.

        • Autonomy and responsibility: Contribute within a small team with minimal hierarchy, direct feedback, and opportunities to influence technical decisions.

        • Location eligibility: The role is open to candidates based in Sub-Saharan Africa and South Asia. India falls within the stated eligible regions, subject to the hiring team's location and contracting requirements.

        • Contract arrangement: International hiring is conducted on a contractor basis.

jobs.title: Commercial Lead - Clinical Trials
jobs.description:
Commercial Lead - Clinical Trials

We’re Heidi.

We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. Our platform has absorbed the administrative chaos of 175 million patient visits and supported 67 million clinical hours. Today, we support 2.8 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries, in 110 languages and over 200 specialties.

Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s capacity for care and strengthen the human connection at its heart.

We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.

We’ve grown annual recurring revenue from $1 million to $50 million in two years.

To go further, we’ve secured US$340 million: a $100 million Series C led by Blackbird, with Phoenix Court, Point72 Private Investments and Headline, alongside a $240 million growth investment led by General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund.

If you want to join us in doing work worth shipping, jump in.

The role

We are hiring a Clinical Trials Lead to own the commercial work that follows. You will develop Heidi’s view of the market, identify the strongest entry point, build senior relationships across the industry, secure early customers and shape a repeatable route to market. Your knowledge of clinical trials will inform and shape what Heidi builds.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who operates like a founder. You will make the calls, open the doors, write the proposal, run the meeting and stay accountable after the contract is signed. As the business proves itself, the role can grow into broader ownership of Heidi’s clinical trials business.

What you’ll do

  • Develop the market thesis. Map the clinical trials ecosystem, test the most valuable opportunities and recommend where Heidi should focus its time and capital.

  • Lead customer development. Build direct relationships with senior decision makers across sponsors, biotechnology companies, CROs, sites and health systems. Conduct the outreach yourself and turn conversations into qualified opportunities.

  • Own early commercial outcomes. Build the pipeline, secure design partners and paid programmes, and own early revenue. Define the measures that show whether the business is gaining traction.

  • Shape the proposition. Turn buyer needs into a clear commercial offer, including target customer, value proposition, pricing, packaging and proof of value.

  • Inform what Heidi builds. Bring evidence from customers and clinical trials workflows to the product lead. Help the team choose problems worth solving while the product lead retains ownership of product strategy and delivery.

  • Navigate the buying process. Understand how life sciences organisations evaluate vendors, allocate budgets, manage procurement and compliance, and move from pilot to broader deployment.

  • Build the delivery model. Work with product, engineering, clinical, legal and implementation colleagues to make early programmes successful and increasingly repeatable.

  • Create the route to scale. Determine which partnerships, channels, proof points and team capabilities are required to grow beyond founder-led selling.

  • Represent Heidi. Build Heidi’s credibility with customers, partners and industry networks through thoughtful engagement and useful domain expertise.

What you’ll need

The strongest candidates will combine deep clinical trials knowledge with a record of creating commercial value. We expect the following experience.

  • Deep experience in the clinical trials industry through a pharmaceutical or biotechnology company, CRO, trial technology business, research network or closely related organisation.

  • A strong understanding of how clinical trials are funded, sold, bought and delivered, including the incentives and constraints faced by sponsors, CROs and research sites.

  • A record of building revenue, partnerships, a business line or a company in the sector. You can show what you personally originated and how it performed.

  • Senior commercial credibility. You can open a conversation with an industry executive, diagnose the underlying business problem and move the relationship towards a concrete commitment.

  • The judgement to operate in a regulated environment while respecting Good Clinical Practice, patient consent, privacy and data integrity.

  • The independence to create structure, make decisions and produce results without an established playbook or a large supporting team.

  • Passion for AI, shown through hands-on building, prototyping, or side projects.

  • You default to building over requesting.

  • You're confident in your thinking and open to being wrong. Great ideas win regardless of who surfaces them.

How we show up

  • Build for the next decade, not next quarter. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.

  • Lead, don't wait. We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that.

  • Follow the evidence. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.

  • Own the outcome. Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander.

  • Ship, measure, go again. A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.

  • Live in clinicians' reality. Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it.

Why Heidi?

You’ll join a team measured on real-world impact, not press cycles. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we’d like to see. We’re medicos, engineers, builders and designers who’ve felt (on every side of the equation) what non-care feels like, the moral and practical toll as a provider or receiver.

Building what we’re building isn’t always easy. Standard tech playbooks routinely fail in healthcare, and the friction of the medical system will test your perseverance. But we didn’t choose easy, we chose a purpose-driven mission that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognize that the deeper question isn’t whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it.

True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally.

We take care of you.

We offer comprehensive private medical and dental cover through Bupa, 24/7 mental health, coaching and wellbeing support through Sonder, a £100/month Healthy Heidi's wellness stipend, a £500 home office budget, a £700 annual learning and development budget, 26 weeks paid primary parental leave and 18 weeks paid secondary parental leave, fertility support up to £7,000, up to four weeks of work from anywhere per year, Recharge Days after major milestones and busy periods, 10 days per year of clinical leave for eligible clinical roles, and a hybrid working environment with 3 days in the office.

We chose to open-source our benefits hub, if you care to take a peek.

jobs.title: Product Line Manager
jobs.description:
Product Line Manager

About Wallee Group AG

Wallee Group is a leader in advanced payment solutions, dedicated to providing robust, scalable, and secure systems across multiple domains. We enhance customer experiences through innovative payment and finance technology that empowers businesses to grow efficiently. With operations spanning several countries, we thrive on collaboration and agility, utilizing the Scrum framework to drive our international teams. At Wallee, we stay at the forefront of market trends, continuously innovating to deliver premier services to our global customers.

The Role

The Product Line Manager owns the full lifecycle of a product line - from introduction through to controlled end-of-life. The role combines strategic portfolio and roadmap management with subject matter expertise in specific verticals, bringing market, product, and supplier perspectives into one consistent strategy.

In Wallee's payment technology context, this specifically includes managing hardware/firmware generations (e.g., terminal models, certification versions like the EMV L2 kernel) and forward-looking planning for successor products.

The Impact You’ll Make

  • Drive Full Lifecycle & Strategy: Own the product journey from concept to decommissioning—defining launch criteria, target segments, success metrics, and forward-looking successor products before hardware/firmware generation changes.

  • Optimize the Portfolio: Maintain a structured view of all variants (terminal types, SoftPOS vs. hardware POS) using frameworks like the BCG matrix to prioritize investment and avoid overlap/cannibalization.

  • Build Capacity-Synced Roadmaps: Translate strategic goals and vertical needs into prioritized, time-boxed feature roadmaps (e.g., quarterly or PI planning in SAFe), balancing "run the business" compliance updates against "grow the business" initiatives.

  • Champion Vertical Expertise & Research: Act as the "translator" between vertical requirements (e.g., retail, hospitality, events) and engineering's technical language while running ongoing trend scanning (PCI/EMV updates), competitor analysis, and customer feedback synthesis.

  • Lead Go-to-Market & Sales Enablement: Define launch plans (positioning, pricing, training, documentation), coordinate alignment across Sales, Marketing, and Support, and assist Sales with technical expertise on complex, regulated deals.

  • Manage Suppliers & Ecosystems: Onboard and manage external partners (terminal manufacturers, component suppliers, certification labs), overseeing SLAs, operational forecasting, defect escalations, contract negotiations, and risk mitigation (such as dual-sourcing).

What Success Looks Like

  • Strategic Portfolio Health: A clear, non-overlapping product line where investments are prioritized effectively and End-of-Sale (EOS) / End-of-Life (EOL) migration paths are seamlessly executed.

  • Uncompromising Compliance: Continuous alignment with certification and regulatory standards (PCI, EMV, ep2) across the entire portfolio, eliminating compliance risk.

  • Reliable Supplier Alignment: High-performing partner relationships with well-managed SLAs, aligned roadmaps, and secure supply chains.

  • Market-Driven Innovation: Roadmaps and GTM materials that accurately reflect vertical user journeys, market trends, and validated customer needs.

  • Cross-Functional Readiness: Seamless coordination with internal teams so all departments are aligned and fully enabled from day one of product launches.

What You Bring to the Table

  • Product Experience: Proven experience in product management, ideally with portfolio or product line ownership in fintech, payments, or hardware-enabled software.

  • Domain Knowledge: Understanding or familiarity with payment certification and compliance topics (PCI, EMV, ep2) is a strong plus.

  • Vertical & Market Expertise: Experience or strong interest in specific industry verticals, coupled with a track record in market research and competitor analysis.

  • Strategic & Analytical Mindset: Strong problem-solving skills with a solution- and customer-oriented approach.

  • Stakeholder & Supplier Management: Exceptional communication and negotiation skills, comfortable managing both internal stakeholders and external supplier relationships.

  • Languages: Fluent in English and German.

Why Join Wallee?

  • Modern Workspace: A beautiful office in the heart of Winterthur - comfortable, bright, and collaboration-ready.

  • True Flexibility: Flexible daily hours and a 4-week "Work from Anywhere" policy every year.

  • Innovation First: We work with the latest tech stacks in a flat hierarchy where your voice actually matters.

  • Growth & Culture: Competitive compensation, aligned with experience, seniority, and expertise, personal development budgets, and a social calendar filled with events.

  • The Perks: Fresh fruits, snacks, and high-quality coffee to keep you fueled.

Don’t tick every box? Neither do most great hires. If the role feels right, reach out, we’d love to see if we’re a match.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative - French Speaking (Europe)
jobs.description:
Sales Development Representative - French Speaking (Europe)

Location: Remote in Europe

Salary: Competitive base + Commission

About Nivoda 🚀

Nivoda is a rapidly scaling global B2B diamond and gemstone marketplace connecting jewellery retailers with competitive, high-quality suppliers worldwide. Processing $300M+ in annual transactions and operating across multiple regions, Nivoda is transforming a $350B industry that has historically been slow to modernise.

Our platform gives businesses of all sizes, from independent jewellers to major retail chains access to the world's best diamond and gemstone inventory, without the traditional barriers of capital, geography, or information asymmetry.

Diamond and gemstone trading has long been plagued by inefficiency, opacity, and exclusivity. jobs.title: AI Tooling Engineer
jobs.description:
AI Tooling Engineer

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Tooling Engineer based in Switzerland.

We are looking for an AI Tooling Engineer to develop and scale an internal agentic platform that brings together company knowledge, data, and tools in one secure, accessible environment. Working closely with a Principal Engineer, you will build production-ready AI agents and integrations that help employees and their AI assistants access the information they need. You will take ownership of the full development lifecycle, from understanding user needs and designing solutions to deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. Using technologies such as Python, LangGraph, LLM APIs, and Model Context Protocol (MCP), you will transform prototypes into reliable tools used across the organization. You will also establish evaluation frameworks, optimize AI performance and costs, and ensure robust security and access controls. This remote opportunity offers the chance to shape company-wide AI capabilities within a globally distributed, technology-driven team.


Accountabilities:

You will help develop and maintain an internal AI platform, combining agent development, systems integration, production engineering, and continuous optimization to deliver practical tools that improve how teams work.

  • Collaborate with the Principal Engineer to design, develop, and deploy new platform capabilities, taking ownership from initial design through production release.

  • Integrate internal systems and SaaS applications by connecting APIs and data sources, defining shared data models, and implementing appropriate access permissions.

  • Build AI agents and supporting tools, including MCP servers that enable agents across the organization to interact with internal systems and retrieve relevant context.

  • Design and improve retrieval workflows, tool calling, embeddings, prompts, and context management to deliver accurate and useful AI-generated responses.

  • Establish and maintain AI quality standards through evaluation datasets, benchmarks, regression testing, tracing, and observability.

  • Monitor performance indicators, including cost per answer and token usage, and optimize models, prompts, and workflows for efficiency and reliability.

  • Troubleshoot production issues, incorporate user feedback, and continuously improve the platform based on real-world usage.

  • Turn proofs of concept into secure, scalable cloud applications with appropriate infrastructure, deployment processes, and identity and access controls.

  • Use AI coding agents as a core part of the development workflow while maintaining code quality through clear specifications, automated tests, reviews, and sound engineering practices.

  • Contribute to company-wide AI tooling initiatives, including evaluating and standardizing internal AI tools, tracking usage and costs, and defining standards for AI-generated applications.

  • Support other teams in adopting and building on the platform, helping them develop effective AI-powered workflows and internal applications.

  • Engage with technical and non-technical stakeholders across the organization to understand their needs, prioritize improvements, and communicate solutions clearly.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate is a hands-on software engineer with practical experience delivering AI agents to production, a strong understanding of modern AI development frameworks, and the ability to build secure, reliable internal tools.

    • At least 3 years of experience building and shipping production software, primarily using Python and relational databases.

    • Proven experience building and deploying at least one production AI agent with LangGraph that is used by real users.

    • Practical expertise in agent development, including tool calling, retrieval and embeddings, prompt engineering, and context design.

    • Hands-on experience with LLM APIs from major providers, including token management and cost optimization.

    • Experience working with MCP or comparable tool protocols, both as a server and as a client.

    • Strong understanding of AI evaluation methodologies, including test datasets, LLM-as-judge approaches, regression testing, and performance monitoring.

    • Familiarity with tracing and observability tools such as Langfuse or equivalent solutions.

    • Experience integrating APIs and data sources, including SaaS applications, SQL databases, and data warehouses.

    • Practical experience with cloud infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Amazon Web Services (AWS), or both, including containers, managed databases, identity and access management, and CI/CD pipelines.

    • Daily use of AI coding agents, with the ability to validate their output and maintain high standards of software quality.

    • Strong understanding of security principles, identity management, permissions, and least-privilege access controls.

    • Experience with version control and collaborative development tools such as GitHub or Bitbucket.

    • Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

      • Desired Skills:

      • Familiarity with web data extraction, web scraping, or related technologies.

      • Experience with Django and PostgreSQL, including vector search using pgvector.

      • Frontend development skills sufficient to build and maintain chat interfaces using React or Next.js.

      • Experience developing internal tools that achieve adoption among colleagues.

      • Familiarity with semantic layers, knowledge graphs, or structured representations of organizational knowledge.

      • Experience implementing agent memory, multi-agent architectures, or advanced agent orchestration.

      • Previous experience working with remote, globally distributed teams.

        • Benefits:

        • Fully remote work, offering flexibility in where you work.

        • Opportunity to join a self-motivated, progressive, and multicultural team.

        • Hands-on experience with cutting-edge AI technologies, open-source frameworks, and modern software development tools.

        • Opportunity to shape and develop AI tooling used across the organization.

        • End-to-end ownership of meaningful engineering projects, from initial design to production deployment and ongoing optimization.

        • Collaborative environment focused on innovation, autonomy, and continuous improvement.

Our training is hands-on and immersive, including live virtual classes, integrated labs and projects, 24x7 support, and a collaborative learning environment. Over two million professionals and 2000 corporate training organizations across 150 countries have harnessed our award-winning programs to achieve their career and business goals.

Simplilearn has collaborated with Fullstack Academy to leverage its widespread footprint in the US region and partnerships with Top US universities to grow internationally.

Requirements

ABOUT THE ROLE

As an Instructor at Simplilearn, you'll scale your impact as a Data science professional by training the next generation of professionals. You’ll create dynamic learning experiences through deployment of instructional best practices that are student-centered and designed to meet the needs of adult learners. You’ll facilitate lessons from the curriculum and will serve as subject matter expert to students. You will support students through exercises designed to build knowledge and skills and promote grit, problem-solving and a collaborative learning community. Ultimately, you will prepare students for the next chapter in their lives as they seek employment in the field of Data science.

This is a part-time, remote role, as classes at Simplilearn are delivered synchronously and are 100% online. A cohort runs for around 5-7 months of instruction, meets on weekday evenings( Monday, Wednesday and Thursday) from 5:30 PM to 8:30 PM PST. The total weekly part-time commitment is expected to be 9-12 hours.

RESPONSIBILITIES

In this role, you will:

  • Create a positive, professional and inclusive learning environment, by:
  • Teaching select lessons in accordance with learning objectives and fidelity to session plans provided by Simplilearn
  • Employing strategies known to meet the needs of adult learners, including leveraging tech tools, instructional best practices and connecting content to the real world by sharing industry insights and professional experiences
  • Managing regular communication with students to align on progress, expectations, celebrate milestones and address concern areas
  • Providing individualized student support during synchronous class sessions and outside class synchronously during office hours and asynchronously through timely communication
  • Evaluate student performance and progression toward competencies based on course deliverables and course rubrics, by:
  • Providing constructive and timely feedback to students in the cohort
  • Assisting in the management of Performance Action Plans for individual students who need additional support
  • Serve as role model for students and as an ambassador for our brand, by:
  • Exhibiting professionalism and an ethical and empathetic approach when engaging with Simplilearn staff, students, and the public
  • Promoting student retention and amplify student satisfaction by creating a positive classroom culture for the Learning Team, communicating timely with students and leveraging effective interventions and sharing of resources
  • Encouraging teamwork and seek feedback for continuous improvement

Working Hours -

The total weekly part-time commitment is expected to be 8-12 hours.
Weekday - 06:30 PM CST - 09:30 PM CST
Weekend - 09:00 AM CST - 12:00 PM CST

Class Timings -

For Weekend sessions, 6-8 hrs of delivery
- For Weekday sessions, 9-12 hrs of delivery
- 1 prep hour/session for the first cohort and 0.5 prep hour per session for the future cohorts
- If content revamped, prep can be at 1 hour/session for the first batch and 0.5 hour per session for the future batches
***Feedback communication/General connects Minutes/hours are not billable
***Prep hour can be billed only for the actual scheduled teaching hours(Induction sessions excluded)

QUALIFICATIONS:

You are a great candidate for this role is you have:

  • 8 + years of experience in the field of Data science/Machine learning/deep learning
  • Working knowledge of Applied Data science with Python
  • Good knowledge of Machine learning
  • Good knowledge of Deep learning with keras and tensorflow
  • A passion for teaching and an ability to explain complex technical concepts
  • A history of choosing a path of integrity
  • Excellent written and verbal skills

Benefits

Compensation:

The expected compensation for this role for candidates from United States is $50 -$55 per hour for candidates who fulfill the qualifications for the role. Candidates whose qualifications are above those listed are encouraged to apply as well. All final offers to candidates will be based on that candidate's unique experience and skillset, and not all candidates will qualify for the top of the salary range.

jobs.title: Senior MLOps Engineer, Buyer
Enablement and Conversion Manager, Revenue Operations
jobs.description:
Enablement and Conversion Manager, Revenue Operations

Location: Remote in Europe

 

About Nivoda 🚀

Nivoda is a rapidly scaling global B2B diamond and gemstone marketplace connecting jewellery retailers with competitive, high-quality suppliers worldwide. Processing $300M+ in annual transactions and operating across multiple regions, Nivoda is transforming a $350B industry that has historically been slow to modernise.

Our platform gives businesses of all sizes, from independent jewellers to major retail chains access to the world's best diamond and gemstone inventory, without the traditional barriers of capital, geography, or information asymmetry.

 

Our Mission 🎯

Diamond and gemstone trading has long been plagued by inefficiency, opacity, and exclusivity. Nivoda was built to change that - to democratise access and empower every business, regardless of size or location, to buy and sell with confidence. Independent jewellers are at the heart of this mission. They deserve the same access to quality, pricing, and selection as the biggest players in the industry. That's exactly what we give them.

 

About the Role 🤔

Conversion is one of the three chokepoints in our revenue organisation. Customers arrive, take the demo, go through KYC, and too many stall before the first purchase, or buy once and never come back. The second purchase is where the product becomes sticky, and getting a merchant there is the hardest 60 days of their life with us.

Fixing that takes two things, and this role owns both. Reps who know the product, the pricing and the playbook cold. And a conversion funnel that is measured, scored and coached rather than hoped for.

 

Function one: enablement

Training and standards

  • Make sure every rep is up to spec and trained, and keep them there.

  • Own the theoretical onboarding of every new rep, SDR, AE and AM alike: what Nivoda sells, to whom, at what price, and how.

  • Set what "up to spec" means for each role and hold the bar.

Documentation and materials

  • Own the product material for every line of business: how it works, who it is for, pricing, take rate and best practice.

  • Keep it current. A rep should never be the last person to find out something changed.

The channel to marketing

  • Act as the link between marketing and the front line. Every campaign is known to the reps in advance, socialised at the all-hands before it lands, not discovered from a customer.

The channel to product

  • Translate the product roadmap into enablement. You do not decide the roadmap. You turn it into what to sell, to whom, and when.

  • When something ships, the reps already know what it is and how to position it.

Function two: conversion

Conversion rests on two things, and this role owns both: the call, and the KYC. A brilliant call that dies in KYC converts nothing, and a clean KYC on a badly run call never gets there.

Call scoring

  • Build the scoring rubrics with the team managers, so the standard is one both sides recognise.

  • Run transcript review and scoring at volume, using Claude to do it.

  • Send the reports out every week, to everyone.

  • Run a weekly leaderboard: the best calls, the scores, winners and losers, visible to the team.

  • Build a personalised coaching plan for every rep, written down and tracked, not delivered verbally and forgotten.

  • Coach in two directions: with the managers so they can coach their own people, and directly with reps where that is faster.

KYC

  • Own the insight generation of what is working and not on the process

  • Hold the accountability of the KYC SLAs, and call it out when they slip.

  • Map the blockers and the escalation paths, and push the fix at the cause rather than the symptom, across sales, product and marketing as needed.

  • Make sure the KYC operators know the rules, and that the rules are written.

  • Train and enable both sides of it: the reps and the operations team.

How we will measure it 💻

  • Conversion through to second purchase at 75% of each new cohort.

  • KYC above 60%, in every geography, not just on the average.

  • Rubric and call scores in place and reported weekly.

  • 80% compliance against the rubric, reached by your fourth month in the role.

What do we need from you? 💪

  • Experience in sales enablement, revenue operations or frontline sales coaching in a transactional, high-volume environment.

  • You have scored calls at volume and can show what changed as a result. Gong or equivalent.

  • You are fluent with AI tooling and would run transcript review and scoring through Claude rather than by hand.

  • You have built onboarding for reps from scratch, not just delivered someone else's deck.

  • You can coach a manager, not just a rep. You are comfortable telling a senior person their team's calls are not good enough, and then showing them how to fix it.

  • You write clearly. A large part of the value here is documentation other people can pick up and use.

  • You work across Product, Marketing and Finance without authority over any of them.

  • Hands-on. This is not a strategy seat. You will be on calls, in the CRM and in the material every week.

Nice to have ✨

  • Experience with onboarding or activation motions rather than pure new business.

  • Diamonds, jewellery, or another supply-driven marketplace.

  • A second language relevant to EMEA or North America.

Our culture and what we offer 😉

At Nivoda, we believe that employees today want to evolve in a collaborative, high-growth environment where they can demonstrate their abilities and thrive both professionally and personally. We work to create a culture of empowerment, continuous learning, and growth where everyone can bring their expertise, own projects, and easily measure their impact. Dynamic working environment in a rapidly growing company. Enjoy a pleasant, low-hierarchy work environment. Engage in intellectually challenging work that contributes significantly to Nivoda's success and scalability.

 

Our current benefits

🕰️ Flexible working hours and a vibrant company culture

💻 Remote work

🧠 Plenty of opportunities for growth and learning

🏖️ Unlimited holiday allowance

🚀 Chance to join and contribute to a company during its exponential expansion phase

 

Equal Opportunity

Nivoda is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to promoting diversity. We don't discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Even if it seems you don't meet 100% of our musts - don't let it stop you. We are all about finding the best talent out there! Skills can be learned, and embracing diversity is invaluable.

Please note: Our Talent Acquisition Team is international. We kindly ask you to submit your CV and application in English so that it can be reviewed correctly.

 

Not quite the right fit?

If after reading this job description you believe this is not the best fit for you, we'd encourage you to join our Nivoda Talent Pool so we can keep you in mind as new roles open up.

jobs.title: Senior MLOps Engineer, Buyer
Technical Support Consultant
jobs.description:
Technical Support Consultant Print & Copy Channel Business Unit

Locatie:

Deze hybride functie biedt de flexibiliteit om zowel vanuit ons kantoor in Almere als vanuit huis te werken.

Contract:

Het betreft een functie voor onbepaalde tijd, onder voorbehoud van de toepasselijke lokale arbeidswetgeving op basis van de standplaats van de kandidaat.

Rapporteert aan:

Cluster Manager (Primair & Commercieel) en IT Manager (Technisch & functioneel)

Scope:

Ondersteuning voor Single cluster (BnNe-regio)

Over ITS

Info Technology Supply Ltd (ITS) is een gerenommeerd softwarebedrijf met meer dan 38 jaar ervaring in de print- en documentmanagementindustrie in Europa en Noord- en Zuid-Amerika. Onze Business Unit Print & Copy Channel distribueert exclusief softwareoplossingen van toonaangevende leveranciers en ondersteunt een uitgebreid netwerk van meer dan 2.000 resellers en partners, verdeeld over zes regionale clusters.

Als het grootste PaperCut Authorised Solution Centre van Europa beschikken wij over een uitgebreid portfolio, waaronder PaperCut MF, NG, Hive en Pocket, evenals Umango, Willow360 en DocSlide. Daarnaast ontwikkelen wij diverse aanvullende modules die onze oplossingen verder versterken en uitbreiden.

Met vestigingen en activiteiten in het Verenigd Koninkrijk, Spanje, Nederland, België, Frankrijk, de DACH-regio en Oost-Europa zijn wij een werkelijk internationale organisatie. Tegelijkertijd behouden wij de persoonlijke betrokkenheid, korte lijnen en warme familiecultuur die ons al jarenlang kenmerken.

De Kans

Ben jij op zoek naar een uitdagende functie binnen een dynamische en snelgroeiende omgeving? Dan is dit jouw kans om je technische expertise verder te ontwikkelen en onderdeel te worden van het Technical Services Team van een internationaal en innovatief softwarebedrijf.

Als Technical Support Consultant ben je verantwoordelijk voor het leveren van technische ondersteuning en het uitvoeren van implementaties bij klanten binnen de BeNe-regio. Je werkt hybride vanuit ons kantoor in Almere, gecombineerd met thuiswerken.

Voor deze functie zoeken wij een enthousiaste en nauwkeurige professional met een proactieve instelling en een sterk probleemoplossend vermogen. Je bent in staat om klanten hoogwaardige technische ondersteuning te bieden en hen te begeleiden bij de implementatie en het beheer van onze oplossingen voor print-, scan- en documentmanagement.

Je werkt hierbij onder andere met producten uit ons portfolio, waaronder PaperCut, Umango, DocSlide en diverse andere innovatieve softwareoplossingen.

Belangrijkste Verantwoordelijkheden

Customer Support (Klantenondersteuning)

1. Het bieden van technische ondersteuning via de helpdesk, telefonisch, e-mail en via remote sessies en incidenteel onsite bij partners en/of eindklanten.

2. Het installeren en configureren van softwareoplossingen zoals PaperCut MF en Hive, Umango en DocSlide.

3. Het analyseren en oplossen van technische vraagstukken.

4. Het testen en reproduceren van klantproblemen in een virtuele omgeving.

Pre-Sales & Training

  1. Het geven van technische trainingen, workshops en online technische demonstraties.
  2. Het ondersteunen van collega's en bijdragen aan interne IT-projecten.
  3. Het beantwoorden van technische vragen van klanten en partners.
  4. Het samenwerken met support- en consultancycollega's binnen Europa.
  5. Het bezoeken van eindklanten in de BeNe-regio om installaties en trainingen ter plaatse uit te voeren.
  6. Nauwe samenwerking met het Internationale iTS Supportteam.
  7. Technische en functionele interne Presales-vragen beantwoorden.
  8. Het creëren en uitvoeren van praktische technische trainingen en workshops voor partners.


Internal IT

1. Assisteren bij technische support aan collega's op zowel de software als de hardware die het bedrijf gebruikt.

2. Ondersteuning van de interne infrastructuur en diensten.

Vereiste kwalificaties

Ervaring & Achtergrond

  1. Uitstekende mondelinge en schriftelijke beheersing van het Nederlands en een goede beheersing van het Engels.
  2. Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om gemakkelijk een goede relatie op te bouwen met klanten.
  3. Ervaring met print management oplossingen, zoals "Papercut" of scanoplossingen, is meegenomen.


4. Ervaring met Microsoft Windows Server- en clientplatformen, Active Directory, Entra ID en Microsoft SQL Server.

5. Ervaring met Windows-printservers, printwachtrijen en het uitrollen van printerdrivers is een pré.

6. Gedegen kennis van netwerken (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, firewallpoorten en SNMP) voor het oplossen van communicatieproblemen tussen servers, clients en printers.

7. Sterke analytische en probleemoplossende vaardigheden, met een gestructureerde aanpak van complexe technische vraagstukken.

8. Een proactieve instelling en het vermogen om nieuwe technologieën snel en zelfstandig eigen te maken.

9. In staat om zowel zelfstandig als effectief binnen een team te werken.

  1. Kan zowel zelfstandig als in team werken.


Pré

  1. Eerdere ervaring in een functie op het gebied van klantenservice of technische ondersteuning.
  2. Kennis van PaperCut-functionaliteiten zoals Find-Me Printing, Print Deploy, Mobility Print en scanworkflows (scan-to-email, scan-to-folder en scan-to-cloud).
  3. Ervaring met het configureren van embedded software en kaartlezers op multifunctionele printers van merken zoals Canon, Ricoh, Konica Minolta, Kyocera of HP.
  4. Ervaring met andere print- en scanmanagementoplossingen, zoals Equitrac, uniFLOW of YSoft SAFEQ.
  5. Een PaperCut-certificering, bijvoorbeeld PaperCut Certified Engineer.
  6. Ervaring met virtualisatieplatformen en Microsoft Azure.
  7. Bekendheid met macOS en Linux.


Wat wij aanbieden

Wij geloven dat plezier in je werk net zo belangrijk is als goede arbeidsvoorwaarden.

Daarom bieden wij:

1. Een uitdagende functie binnen een internationale organisatie.

2. Veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid.

3. Hybride werken vanuit huis en/of ons kantoor in Almere.

4. Een auto van de zaak.

5. Laptop en telefoon van de zaak.

6. Een aantrekkelijk salaris passend bij jouw ervaring.

7. 25 vakantiedagen.

8. Uitgebreide opleidingen, trainingen en certificeringsmogelijkheden.

9. Een team van collega's dat elkaar ondersteunt en kennis deelt.

10. Ruimte om door te groeien richting consultancy, projectmanagement of specialistische technische rollen.

Bedrijfsbeschrijving

ITS Benelux maakt deel uit van de internationale ITS Group, een organisatie die al meer dan 35 jaar actief is en klanten ondersteunt in Europa, Noord-Amerika en daarbuiten.

Maar wat je vooral merkt als collega, is dat we ondanks onze internationale omvang een nuchtere en persoonlijke organisatie zijn gebleven.

We werken hard, helpen elkaar, vieren successen samen en geloven dat de beste ideeën ontstaan wanneer mensen zich prettig voelen op hun werk.

Hier ben je geen nummer, maar een belangrijk onderdeel van het team.

Voel je vrij om its-group.com en printandcopycontrol.com te bezoeken om meer te weten te komen over ons bedrijf en productportfolio.

iTS is gecertificeerd volgens de ISO 9001:2015- en ISO/IEC 27001:2022-normen.

Bedrijfswaarden

Klantgericht: We streven ernaar om te zorgen dat aan de behoeften van onze klanten worden voldaan en overtroffen, en bouwen sterke, langdurige relaties op.

Flexibel & Loyaal: We investeren tijd, energie en middelen in het koesteren van onze relaties, met als doel langdurig succes.

Internationaal team met een gezinsgeest: Onze bedrijfscultuur hecht waarde aan samenwerking, waardering en persoonlijke ontwikkeling, en biedt een waardevolle omgeving waar iedereen kan floreren.

ITS is niet:

Arrogant

Arrogantie laat mensen geloven dat ze altijd het beste weten. Het stopt het constante leren dat succes vereist. Wij zien arrogantie als het begin van het einde van elke organisatie.

Om te solliciteren

Denk je dat dit bij je past?

Mooi. Dan hoeven we niet per se een perfect CV te zien.

Ben jij technisch nieuwsgierig, klantgericht en heb je zin om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen binnen een internationale organisatie? Dan gaan we graag met je in gesprek.

Graag ontvangen wij jouw cv, inclusief een motivatiebrief waarin je beschrijft:

1. Je praktische technische ervaring met PaperCut of andere producten binnen het ITS-portfolio, inclusief de omgevingen waarin je deze hebt geïmplementeerd, ondersteund of beheerd.

2. Voorbeelden van technische, presales- en adviesactiviteiten waaraan je hebt bijgedragen of die je hebt geleid, zoals solution design, productdemonstraties en aanbestedingstrajecten.

3. Je taalvaardigheden en, indien van toepassing, je kennis van de clusterregio en het bijbehorende partnernetwerk.

iTS is een werkgever die gelijke kansen biedt en zich inzet voor het opbouwen van een divers en inclusief team.

jobs.title: Inside Sales Representative (Customer Expansion)
jobs.description:
Inside Sales Representative (Customer Expansion)

Redefine the future of customer experiences. One conversation at a time.

At Nextiva, we’re reimagining how businesses connect, bringing together customer experience and team collaboration on a single, conversation centric platform. Powered by AI, driven by human innovation.

Our culture is forward thinking, customer obsessed and built on the belief that meaningful connections drive better business outcomes. Whether it’s through our signature Amazing Service®, the technology we create, or the experiences we cultivate, connection is at the core of who we are.

If you’re ready to collaborate with incredible people, make an impact, and help businesses everywhere deliver truly amazing experiences, this is where you belong.

Location: While this role is open to remote candidates across Mexico, team members located within 80 kilometers of our Guadalajara office (Calle Amado Nervo 2200, Jardínes del Sol, 45050 Zapopan, Jal.) are expected to work onsite to support collaboration, speed, and execution.

Drive Customer Growth. Deliver Better Outcomes.

As an Inside Sales Representative (Customer Expansion), you’ll drive revenue growth within Nextiva’s existing small business customer base. This is a high-velocity sales role where you’ll proactively reach out to customers, uncover opportunities, and deliver solutions by connecting customer challenges to the value of Nextiva's AI-Powered Platform. You’ll support US-based customers, with customer interactions and day-to-day work conducted in English.

You don’t need a traditional sales background to succeed here. We’re looking for people who have demonstrated success against revenue-related targets, whether in sales, account management, retention, collections, or another commercially focused customer role—and are ready to build their career in technology sales.

How You’ll Make an Impact

  • Drive Expansion Revenue: Identify and close upsell and cross-sell opportunities within Nextiva's existing small business customer base.
  • Create Opportunities: Proactively engage customers through outbound calls, email, SMS, and other channels rather than waiting for leads.
  • Understand the Customer's Business: Engage small business customers across a variety of industries, ask effective questions, uncover business challenges, and connect their needs to the right Nextiva solutions.
  • Position Nextiva's AI-Powered Solutions: Clearly articulate the value of Nextiva’s platform, including AI-driven capabilities that improve customer experience and business outcomes
  • Demonstrate Value: Deliver focused product demos and clearly explain how Nextiva’s solutions can help customers achieve better business outcomes.
  • Move Quickly: Manage multiple opportunities and maintain consistent follow-up to keep a high-velocity sales cycle moving.
  • Own Your Pipeline: Manage opportunities from outreach through close while maintaining accurate pipeline, activity, and forecasting information in Salesforce.
  • Continuously Improve: Apply coaching, performance insights, and AI-enabled tools to continuously improve your customer conversations, productivity, results, and product knowledge.

What Success Looks Like

You’re motivated by growth—both in the results you deliver and the career you’re building. You take ownership, follow through on commitments, and bring energy and resilience to a fast-paced sales environment. You’re coachable, curious, and willing to keep learning.

Successful team members:

  • Consistently meet or exceed expansion revenue targets
  • Are comfortable creating opportunities through proactive outbound outreach
  • Represent Nextiva professionally in customer conversations, including video meetings.
  • Build rapport quickly, and confidently move customer conversations toward an outcome
  • Stay organized while managing multiple customer conversations and opportunities at once
  • Bring consistency and discipline to follow-up, keeping opportunities moving
  • Respond well to coaching and quickly put feedback into practice
  • Stay resilient, learn from setbacks, and maintain momentum in a performance-driven environment
  • Effectively incorporate AI tools into your workflows to improve speed, quality, customer experience, and outcomes.

Experience matters, but mindset and execution matter more. This role is a strong fit for someone building or transitioning into a career in technology sales, where effort, consistency, and a growth mindset translate directly into success.

What You'll Bring

  • 2+ years' experience in a customer-facing role where you were directly accountable for revenue-related goals or targets, in a fast-paced environment
  • A demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding those goals
  • Advanced English fluency, both spoken and written, with the ability to simplify complex and/or technical concepts
  • Comfort with frequent outbound customer conversations and proactive outreach
  • The ability to thrive in a high-velocity environment with short, fast sales cycles
  • A professional, customer-ready presence and communication style. You’ll regularly interact directly with customers by phone, email, and video
  • Business curiosity and the ability to quickly understand different customers, industries, and business needs
  • Strong organization, follow-through, and attention to detail
  • Coachable, with demonstrated ability to apply feedback to improve performance
  • Self-motivated and resourceful, you take ownership of your work and take initiative to solve problems
  • Demonstrated curiosity about AI and technology; motivated to continuously learn, apply new tools, and build your sales and product knowledge

Relevant experience can come from many backgrounds. Examples include roles with sales quotas, upsell or cross-sell goals, customer retention/save targets tied to revenue, collections or recovery targets, account growth, or other commercially focused performance goals.

Nice to Have:

  • Bachelor's degree in business or a related field
  • Exposure to SaaS, UCaaS, CCaaS, telecommunications, or other technology products
  • Familiarity with Salesforce or another CRM
  • Experience supporting US-based customers in a B2B environment
  • Exposure to AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Copilot) in a professional setting

Compensation & Growth

  • Competitive base salary + uncapped commission
  • Opportunity to grow and advance your career with a company at the forefront of AI-powered customer experience

Nextiva DNA (Core Competencies)

Nextiva’s most successful team members share common traits and behaviors:

  • Drives Results: Action-oriented problem solvers who quickly bring clarity and simplicity to ambiguity, challenge the status quo, and lead meaningful change; celebrating wins to fuel momentum. They act swiftly and pragmatically, learning and improving as they go.
  • Critical Thinker: Data-driven, forward-thinking individuals who identify key drivers, anticipate risks, and deliver clear recommendations. They confidently leverage AI and automation to reduce friction, improve decision-making, and focus on higher-value work.
  • Right Attitude: Collaborative, competitive, and resilient team players who jump in to solve tough problems, learn from setbacks, and foster a culture of service, respect, and care for customers and teammates.

Total Rewards

Our Total Rewards offerings are designed to allow Nexties to take care of themselves and their families so they can be their best, in and out of the office.

Our compensation packages are tailored to each role and candidate's qualifications. We consider a wide range of factors, including skills, experience, training, and certifications, when determining compensation. We aim to offer competitive salaries or wages that reflect the value you bring to our team. Depending on the position, compensation may include base salary, hourly wages, incentives, or bonuses.

  • Health - Major Health insurance for you, your legal partner, and children under 25 years, including Vision and Dental coverage
  • Insurance - Life Insurance (24 times your monthly salary)
  • Work-Life Balance ⚖️ - Newly hired full-time employees at Nextiva receive 10 personal days before their first anniversary, 12 vacation days on their first anniversary, and 5 personal days annually thereafter in addition to vacation time
  • Financial Security - Enjoy a 30-day Christmas bonus, 50% vacation premium, company-matched food vouchers (1 UMA/month), and a 13% matched savings fund (capped at 1.3x annual UMA)
  • Wellness ‍- Employee Assistance Program and comprehensive wellness initiatives
  • Growth - Access to ongoing learning and development opportunities and career advancement

At Nextiva, we're committed to supporting our employees' health, well-being, and professional growth. Join us and build a rewarding career!

#LI-AL1 #LI-REMOTE

Founded in 2008, Nextiva has grown into a global leader trusted by over 100,000 businesses and 1M+ users worldwide. Headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona, and with teams across the globe, we're the future of customer experience and team collaboration through our AI-powered, conversation-centric platform.

jobs.description:
Hyperscaler & Systems Integrator Partner Manager (North America)

About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

Accounts Assistant

We're an AI-powered, creator-first platform helping creators connect, engage, and earn directly from their audiences at scale. Behind the product is a finance function that needs to be as fast and reliable as the platform itself.

🎯 The Role

We're hiring an Assistant Accountant to own the accounting engine of the finance team: the ledger, the month-end close, and the admin that keeps both clean. Our day-to-day transaction processing is supported by an outsourced bookkeeping partner. You'll own the quality of that work, the reconciliations behind it, and everything between a receipt landing and a number reaching the board pack.

Everything else in finance, reporting, forecasting and investor diligence depends on the ledger being right. You'll make sure it is: reviewing what goes in, reconciling what comes out, and closing the month on time. About a quarter of the role is finance admin. It means running the invoice inbox, chasing receipts and keeping supplier records clean, and it's what keeps the numbers right.

🚀 What You'll Do

Ledger and close

  • Review and own the ledger in Xero, including our outsourced bookkeepers' work on coding, supplier bills and daily bank reconciliations across GBP, USD and EUR accounts

  • Prepare month-end journals, accruals and prepayments, and the balance sheet reconciliations behind them, so we close by working day 5 with our Finance Manager

  • Keep intercompany balances with our US entity reconciled

  • Reconcile payroll, PAYE and pension control accounts to Rippling each month

  • Prepare the UK VAT return in Xero for review

  • Prepare year-end schedules and answer queries from our external accountants and auditors

Finance admin and communication

  • Run the invoice inbox, logging, chasing and routing supplier invoices so nothing reaches the ledger without a document

  • Chase receipts and missing context from colleagues for card spend, and keep receipt compliance high

  • Maintain supplier records and support onboarding, including verifying bank details before anything is paid

  • Be the first point of contact for finance questions from the wider team

👀 Who You Are

  • 2 to 4 years in a finance team or accounting practice, with at least one month-end close owned end to end

  • AAT qualified, or studying towards or part-qualified in ACCA, CIMA or ACA. We'll support your studies

  • Confident in Xero or similar cloud accounting software, and comfortable with large data sets in Excel or Google Sheets

  • Experience with multi-currency reconciliations and high transaction volumes

  • Clear, friendly written communication. You'll chase people across the company and keep it pleasant

  • Fintech, marketplace or payments experience is a strong plus

✨ You'll Thrive Here If

  • A fully reconciled balance sheet gives you real satisfaction

  • You chase people for answers instead of waiting

  • You see the admin as part of getting the numbers right, not a distraction from it

  • You're comfortable in a startup where things move fast around you, even if your work is methodical

  • You want to grow into a management accountant or financial controller role as the team scales

⚠️ You'll Struggle Here If

  • You want to work only on the numbers and see chasing colleagues for receipts as beneath the role

  • You need heavy supervision or detailed instructions for every task

  • You're not comfortable working with high transaction volumes daily

🌍 Why Join Fanvue?

  • Your work has immediate, visible impact. When the books are clean, the whole company moves faster, leadership gets reliable numbers, and investor conversations go smoothly
