jobs.title: Head of Strategic Accounts, UK
jobs.description:
Head of Strategic Accounts, UK

Note: Partly is headquartered in Austin, TX with offices in London, UK, Christchurch, NZ and Auckland, NZ. Wherever you're based, we'll connect you with your nearest office for onboarding, and fly you to join the full team for our quarterly "Season Openers" (we cover travel and accommodation). If you're relocating to join us, we can also assist with relocation costs.


🚀 Our Story

Partly is building the infrastructure for anyone to repair anything. We believe everything built should be repairable, and we're building frontier AI to put repair knowledge to work, starting with the $2tn automotive market.

Our model, Interpreter, is the first AI purpose-built to understand repair. Trained on 1M+ car models and 1B+ parts, it reads a repair job the way an estimator does, resolves damage into the exact purchasable part, and shows its reasoning with a confidence score. On real production jobs, an estimator working with Interpreter reaches 98.8% parts-list accuracy, against 92.1% with today's tools. It powers PartlyRepair, used by collision shops, workshops and suppliers to take the admin off the job; PartlyLabs, the agentic infrastructure enterprises use to deploy Interpreter across their own workflows; and a developer API.

Founded by ex-Rocket Lab engineers, we've raised a $50m Series B led by DST Global (Anthropic, Airbnb, Meta, TikTok, Spotify), with Blackbird Ventures, WNDR, Activant Capital, Icehouse Ventures, Square Peg, Airtree and Ecliptic Venture Capital. Hear it from the team: Why Partly exists and AI at Partly.

🖍️ This role

Repairers are Partly's flagship customer and PartlyRepair AI is our flagship product. You own Partly's relationship with the UK's largest repair groups, from the first conversation to every site ordering.

You lead the largest accounts yourself. You sit across the table from the CFOs and commercial directors of groups running hundreds of sites, and your job is to make sure being on the panel turns into volume flowing through the platform: site commitments, mandates, pricing and the rollout plan behind them.

You also run a small team of four: an AE bringing new groups onto the network, and account managers who get signed sites live and converting. The measure of success is that the commercial standard you set becomes how the whole team works.

 

💻 What will you do

Lead our largest repair groups

  • Own the senior relationship with our largest groups, including the CFO and commercial leadership

  • Take signed accounts from panel presence to genuine wallet share

  • Drive cross-sell of new products across our installed base

Land the groups still outside the network

  • Personally lead the largest unsigned groups, including insurer owned networks

  • Own the named account list and its tiering

  • Structure the terms, not just the signature: site commitments, supply mandates and pricing

  • Build a joint account plan with the supplier team where the same buyer holds both relationships

Run the rollout

  • Own the rollout plan for every strategic account: which sites go live when, who on the customer side owns each step, and what has to be true first

  • Run product rollouts into your accounts, for example invoice reconciliation, Repair AI and new ordering flows, from pilot sites to the whole group

  • Hold every signed group to a site and conversion plan, and find and fix what stops sites ordering

Build the partnerships around our repair groups

  • Identify the partnerships that make repair groups more successful on Partly

  • Make the case for each one, agree what it unlocks for the customer, and work with product and leadership to land it

  • Use partnerships to open doors into groups still outside the network

Shape the product

  • Be the voice of the largest groups in product decisions: what they need, in what order, and why it moves volume

  • Work with product on scope and timing for customer commitments, so we only promise what we can deliver

  • Turn what you learn on site into clear requirements and priorities

Lead the strategic accounts team

  • Coach on discovery, deal management and commercial negotiation, and lead by example on your own accounts

  • Set targets and account allocation, and run structured account and deal reviews

  • Build your own pipeline and performance views. Rev ops supports, it does not run your reporting

  • Run each account off its numbers: site by site conversion, where the gap is, and the one action that closes it

     

🥷 Your skills

 

Must have

  • Senior commercial ownership. Has personally owned and grown a top account at CFO and commercial director level, structured complex agreements with procurement and finance in the room, and restructured an agreement after signature to change how volume flows

  • Operational rigour on rollouts. Has taken a software or service from pilot to dozens or hundreds of sites, including integrations with the customer's systems, and kept it to plan

  • Strongly analytical. Diagnoses an account from the data: where volume leaks between jobs opened, offers seen and parts ordered, which sites drag the number, and what moves it. Builds their own analysis in spreadsheets or BI tools and uses it to run accounts, make the commercial case and hold the team to account

Strong plus

  • Product fluent. Comfortable working with product and engineering on requirements, scope and trade offs, and explaining them to a customer's operations and IT teams

  • Has run a volume motion as well as named accounts. Has managed managers or a high volume team alongside large accounts. This is what the step up to the wider repairer business needs

  • Player-coach. Has led a small team while still carrying the biggest accounts personally

  • Comfortable where the playbook is still being written

  • Automotive aftermarket, collision repair, insurance, fleet or parts distribution background

  • Has sold into multi site repair or dealer groups

We do not expect someone exceptional at all of these. We want someone clearly strong on the three must haves, and solid on the rest.

Please note: if you don't have all the skills or experience listed above but believe you could be outstanding in this role, please still consider applying. Many people count themselves out. We'd love the chance to learn more about you and why you're exceptional.

 

🎁 Benefits

  • Healthy, Catered Lunches - Enjoy fresh, healthy lunches every workday in our Auckland, Christchurch, London, and Austin offices. With no meal prep needed, you can eat, connect, and refuel with your team. (And yes, snacks and drinks are always on hand.)

  • Healthy Body, Healthy Mind - We care about performing at our peak. Every team member gets a $1,500 annual wellness allowance (or local equivalent) on a Partly-branded card. Use it on things such as gym memberships, rock climbing, physical therapy, massage, doctor visits, prescriptions—anything that you or your family need!

  • Family Comes First - Primary caregivers receive 3 months of fully paid parental leave, plus a flexible return-to-work plan (four days a week at full pay for your first three months back).

  • Workspaces That Inspire - Our brand-new, architecturally designed offices are built for collaboration and creativity, with great coffee, social spaces, and some of the best cafes just a few steps away.

  • Getting Here Is On Us - If you commute to a Partly office or coworking space (atleast 4 days a week), choose from a paid 24/7 parking spot or a commuting allowance. One less thing to think about!

  • Office-First with Flexibility - In cities where we have an office (London. Austin, Christchurch, Auckland), we default to working from the office every day. This lets us move faster, make better decisions, and build strong relationships. We also operate with a high-trust environment, so you can manage your time around your life and flex your schedule to do your best work.

  • Time Off - you can use your annual leave and sick leave from day one, no waiting to accrue it first. And if you ever go into a negative balance, that's fine too, we trust you to manage your own time off

  • We Celebrate Together - From weekly happy hours and monthly lunches to quarterly season openers and an annual global offsite, we make time to connect, celebrate, and have fun as one team.

  • Giving - We support charitable giving and will top up your donation by 33% for charities on the GiveWell list

  • Equity - You'll receive share options (ESOP) with a 4-year vesting schedule and a 1-year cliff, true ownership in Partly from day one. Your strike price is a flat $0.01 per share, and you have up to 10 years to exercise.

jobs.description:
Risk and Change Manager - Alpha Delivery PMO

WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Build the machine that builds the machine. Join TechOps at the forefront of advanced manufacturing, we’re building the production system that will enable commercial fusion. The Production lines, tooling, and processes are being developed from the ground up; you'll create the ways of working, not inherit them.

  • Work at the frontier of manufacturing technology. Bring your creativity to evaluate, qualify, and deploy processes with no industry playbook, every component you build and every process you shape goes directly into the core of the stellarator magnet technology.

  • Do work that matters, and see it grow. The hardware you build is the product and your career grows with it, from prototyping and process development through quality and industrialization, alongside exceptional colleagues from around the world.

  • Make an impact you can point to. In a small, fast-moving team, your calls on equipment, quality, and process directly shape how a world-class deep-tech company produces superconducting magnets with results visible on the shop floor, not buried in a slidedeck.

YOUR IMPACT

You keep Alpha's cost and schedule baselines honest against each other. Without a credible risk register and change process, changes slip into the program outside any controlled path, the IMS and cost forecast quietly drift apart, and a gate review surprises leadership with numbers nobody signed off on. Your job is to prevent that by making risk and change management a live, trusted function from the earliest stage of delivery, rather than something bolted on once problems have compounded.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Establish and maintain the Alpha risk register across infrastructure, manufacturing and machine workstreams, facilitating structured risk identification, assessment and assignment of mitigation owners

  • Own the change control process end to end, from intake and schedule, cost and technical impact assessment through to approval routing and the change log, working closely with the Cost Controller and Programme Schedule Manager so all baselines reflect the same accepted changes

  • Prepare risk-adjusted inputs for release gate decisions, including quantified schedule and cost exposure and mitigation status

  • Run regular risk reviews with workstream owners and escalate emerging risks early, before they reach senior leadership as surprises

  • Build risk and change governance standards that scale as Alpha and Stellaris grow in parallel, with different partners and delivery models

  • Support the PMO's wider reporting cadence alongside the PMO Analyst/Coordinator


WHO YOU ARE

  • Experienced in risk and change management on major capital programs in energy, industrial, research infrastructure or similarly complex multi-discipline settings

  • Able to build a risk and change framework from scratch, not just administer an inherited one; you know what good governance looks like before it exists

  • Confident holding the line on change discipline with internal engineers and external partners who have their own priorities, combining analytical rigor with the communication skills to make it stick

  • Comfortable working with high autonomy while program structure is still being built

  • Fluent in English; German is a strong advantage given the contractor and regulatory landscape

  • Familiar with AI tools and digital ways of working, and quick to adapt in a lean, fast-paced environment

    INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

Industrialization Engineer, Instruments

As an Industrialization Engineer, Instruments, you will play a key role in bringing our surgical instruments and accessories from design to production. You will define manufacturing strategy, develop processes and/or lines, and transfer the design to our contract manufacturers and suppliers. You will make sure that products can be built reliably and meets quality, yield and performance targets as volumes grow. Reducing the COGS of our instruments will also be a key objective of your role. You will work closely with R&D, Quality, Production team and suppliers to support the ramp-up and the continuous improvement of our instruments manufacturing lines.

Duties & Responsibilities :

• Lead the industrialization, design transfer and manufacturing ramp-up of new product or new feature introduction project related to surgical instruments, accessories and their components, in close partnership with R&D, Quality, Contract Manufacturers and Suppliers.

• Analyse the cost of the instrument, review the manufacturing processes and components, identify, evaluate and implement cost reduction opportunities.

• Drive continuous improvement of manufacturing processes using data-driven problem-solving and root-cause analysis to improve yield, quality, cost and efficiency.

• Lead manufacturing process development, validation or verification and equipment qualification activities.

• Contribute to the improvement of test strategies, and to the definition and implementation of on-line and end-of-line testing, from requirements to test design and qualification.

• Initiate, assess and lead Manufacturing Change Requests in coordination with R&D, Quality, Contract Manufacturer and suppliers. Update the technical documentation (DMR) and the risk management file (FMEA) and ensure compliance with relevant standards, regulations and Distalmotion's QMS.

• Be the voice of manufacturing during product development to ensure that products can be manufactured reliably and efficiently.

Requirements

Requirements :

• Degree in engineering (microtechnology, mechanical, industrial or equivalent).

• Minimum 5 years of experience in industrialization, manufacturing engineering or process development of complex assemblies in a highly regulated industry, ideally medical devices.

• Proven ability to lead cross-functional industrialization projects with ownership, from manufacturing process or line development to production, including coordination of suppliers and CMOs.

• Experience in manufacturing process (e.g. plastic injection molding, ultrasonic welding, machining, assembly, cleaning, sterile packaging and sealing) and equipment development and qualification.

• Experience in a manufacturing site operating in a controlled environment (e.g. cleanroom), ideally for medical devices is a plus.

• Hands-on experience in complex assembly of small precision components in high volumes, including the design of fixtures and workstations.

• Knowledge of continuous improvement methods (Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, CAPA, 8D) and strong data skills (Excel, Power BI, SPC).

(Senior) Operations Manager // AI Music Video Platform

Neural Frames is a leading AI music video generator, turning any song into a fully produced music video in minutes. We're bootstrapped, profitable, and generating more than $7M in annualized revenue. Our ambition is to build a category-defining company that helps tens of millions of audio creators visualize and promote their work.

We've got here with a small team and very little overhead. Now we're growing quickly, and the operational side of the company - finance, people admin, tooling, office, contracts - run through the founder and Founders Associate. We're looking for the person who takes that over and makes it quietly reliable.

This is a hands-on role. You'll be the one the tax firm calls, the one who makes sure a new hire is on payroll and has a laptop and every tool on day one, the one who knows when every contract and insurance renews, and the one who fixes reconciliation mess instead of filing a ticket about it. You'll work directly with the founder, alongside our Founder's Associate and with our external accountants and virtual assistant.

Tasks

  • Own finance operations: be the point of contact for our tax firm and payroll provider, run the monthly close inputs, keep Stripe invoicing, refunds and credit notes clean and reconciled, and resolve open questions before they reach the founder

  • Assemble a monthly numbers pack - revenue, cash, margin, cloud costs, payroll, headcount - from Stripe, the accountants and our internal data

  • Own people administration: contracts, probation periods, holidays, absence and time tracking, documents and compliance. Be the person the team asks about payslips, holiday balances and contract

  • Manage our virtual assistant and the work we outsource

  • Own tool access, equipment and IT: accounts, licences, laptops, security basics, and the day-one setup for every new hire from the onboarding checklist

  • Track every recurring vendor, contract, insurance and compliance obligation in one place so nothing depends on somebody remembering it

  • Handle the booking, budget and logistics behind team events and the annual offsite

Requirements

  • You have 3–6 years of experience in operations, finance operations or people operations at a small, fast-growing company, and have been the person who kept it running

  • You have personally owned the relationship with an external tax firm and payroll provider, including monthly close and the questions that come with it

  • You are hands-on with Stripe or a comparable payment system and understand invoices, refunds, credit notes and reconciliation; DATEV experience is a strong plus

  • You are familiar with Personio or a similar HRIS and know German employment administration

  • You communicate clearly in German and English

  • You are based in Berlin and can join us in the office at least four days per week

Bonus points:

  • Experience in consumer subscription or SaaS, especially with Stripe at volume and international VAT

  • Google Workspace, Notion, Slack, and Linear administration

  • You have worked in both a structured company and a scrappy startup and know what is worth copying from each

How we measure success

Within your first month, you’ve audited all recurring finance, admin, and tooling tasks currently handled by the founder, agreed on clear ownership of what you’ll take over, established yourself as the main point of contact for our tax firm, and mapped every vendor, contract, and compliance deadline.

Within 90 days, finance operations, people admin, tool access, and office management run smoothly without input from the founder or Founder's Associate. Our Founder's Associate can hand you a new hire, and you'll have them on payroll, fully equipped, and ready to go within a day.

Within a year, a new hire can be contracted, paid, equipped, and fully onboarded into our systems without any involvement from the founder. No contract renewal or compliance deadline has been missed, and the company has scaled significantly without operational processes becoming a bottleneck.

VSOPs and profit sharing, bi-weekly team lunches, regular team events, an annual summer offsite, learning and development support, productivity tools, a headphone allowance, Deutschlandticket, and a €5,000 referral bonus.

jobs.description:
Customer Success Associate

Get to Know Us

Horizon3.ai is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs. 

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

 What you will do:

As a Customer Success Associate in EMEA, you will play a key role in scaling and strengthening our international post-sales experience as part of a growing global Customer Success organization. You will serve as a strategic advisor to a portfolio of mid-market customers, partnering directly with technical and business stakeholders to drive adoption, value realization, retention, and growth.

You’ll collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support while helping shape and evolve the Customer Success experience across the EMEA region.

We are open to candidates based in the Netherlands who are willing to work in a hybrid model, at least 1 day per week in our Amsterdam office.

Responsibilities

  • Cultivate champions with security leaders—from analysts to CISOs—and guide them through the lifecycle of adoption, expansion, and advocacy

  • Deliver technical onboarding and enablement to drive adoption of NodeZero, including advanced features like Tripwires, Insights, and Rapid Response, ensuring customers realize maximum value

  • Conduct regular check-ins and quarterly business reviews to align on strategy, secure executive buy-in, and showcase business outcomes.

  • Comfortable with tools like Salesforce, Gainsight, and JIRA; detail-oriented and organized

  • English fluency required; fluency in French, Spanish, or German preferred

 

Perks of Horizon3.ai

  • Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

  • Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

  • Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

  • Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.

Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

  • Depending on experience, the compensation range for this position is: €70,000 - €85,000 OTE 80/20 split annually. The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills.

  • Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.

You Belong Here

Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, hair length or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.

jobs.description:
Staff Solutions Engineer - Embedded Finance

About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

About the team

The Merchant Services team partners with our clients to realise their full potential through the adoption of Airwallex products that drive their growth and success. We influence revenue growth across our entire product portfolio and collaborate with sales, strategy, product, and engineering teams to provide the best experience for our most valued customers. Our team works alongside commercial teams throughout the pre-sales, solution design, and API integration stages, serving as the single technical point of contact and trusted advisor for our clients. We are committed to empowering businesses with the tools our clients need to succeed in a dynamic market

 

What you’ll do

As a Staff Solutions Engineer you will own the technical pre-sales and implementation of AirWallex solutions for complex client engagements that bring our global payments and financial products to life for enterprise partners, shopping carts, and payment gateways. You will turn agreed business requirements into solution designs and actionable plans, orchestrating cross-functional teams and external stakeholders to deliver on time, on scope, and to a high quality bar. You’ll provide technical trust, ensuring that every phase from pre‑sales through go‑live and early optimisation runs smoothly.

This role is based in Amsterdam (3 days in office), with implementation coverage across EMEA.

 

Responsibilities:

  • Act as a trusted technical advisor to customers and internal teams on high-value implementations and expansions, shaping integration approaches, system configuration, and overall solution design.

  • Partner with implementation and account management teams to translate customer requirements into scalable architectures.

  • Work with sales teams on technical discovery to understand customer systems, data flows, and workflows, and recommend a best-fit integration blueprint, including when and how to leverage APIs and third-party connectors.

  • Work hands-on with customers to troubleshoot integration hurdles and guide them through complex configuration decisions, focusing on designing robust, maintainable implementations rather than writing code directly.

  • Create and maintain internal documentation, playbooks, and lightweight tooling that make it easier for the wider team to support integration-heavy use cases at scale.

  • Channel customer pain points and integration feedback into Product and Engineering, influencing the roadmap and prioritisation of features that materially improve implementation outcomes.

Who you are

We’re looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

 

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field (e.g. Business, Finance, Engineering, Information Systems) or equivalent practical experience.

  • 8+ years of experience in technical pre-sales, managing complex, multi‑stakeholder technology or financial services implementations.

  • 8+ years of client‑facing delivery or professional services experience in a high‑paced environment (e.g. SaaS, fintech, consulting, systems integration, enterprise implementation).

  • Proven track record of successfully delivering cross‑functional projects with stakeholders from diverse backgrounds and job functions, including C‑level executives, technical teams, and operations.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication and presentation skills, including the ability to lead steering meetings, write clear status updates, and influence decisions without direct authority.

 

Preferred qualifications:

  • Hands‑on experience working on API‑based payments integrations/products.

  • Experience managing strategic or enterprise engagements as part of a broader account team, including navigating commercial sensitivities while protecting technical quality and scope.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast‑moving, ambiguous environment, balancing structured methodologies with pragmatic decision‑making to keep complex projects moving forward.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. jobs.title: Senior Android Developer (Remote)
jobs.description:
Senior Android Developer (Remote)
About Finom
 
Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. Our mission is to develop an all-in-one financial B2B solution that integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a seamless, mobile-first platform.
 
We recently closed a €115 million Series C equity round (around $133 million), bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million. This significant investment follows a $105 million growth funding round from General Catalyst, a long-term backer since 2021 known for supporting companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, KAYAK, and Stripe.
 
Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain.
 
At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole.
 
Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.

We're looking for a Senior Android Engineer or Tech Lead who thinks like a product builder — someone who cares deeply about the "why" behind what they're building, not just the tickets in the backlog.

You'll be embedded in a cross-functional domain team (Backend, Mobile, ML/AI, QA, Design, and Product) and own the end-to-end development of features that genuinely matter: company accounts and cash flows, banking transactions, card issuance and management, and AI-enabled accounting. You'll help shape architecture decisions, raise the bar on engineering quality, and mentor the engineers around you.

If you're energized by working at the intersection of great mobile engineering and real product impact — this is the role.


What You’ll Do
  • Design and build new features for our Android application, used daily by business owners across Europe.
  • Architect and implement reliable, intuitive solutions for:
  • Multi-account cash flow management
  • Banking transactions and payments
  • Physical and virtual card issuance, activation, and control
  • AI-powered accounting automation
  • Build polished, responsive UIs using Jetpack Compose.
  • Take ownership of code quality, performance, and stability — automated testing and thorough code reviews are non-negotiable.
  • Collaborate closely with Backend, QA, Design, and Product — you'll be shaping solutions end-to-end, not just implementing specs.
  • Drive technical decisions within your domain, challenge assumptions when needed, and proactively identify opportunities to build better.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, tooling, and mobile best practices across the team.

    • Who You Are

    You're pragmatic and have a proven track record of shipping products that matter. You communicate clearly across disciplines and thrive in a cross-functional environment where everyone is solving the same customer problem together.

    Your experience includes:

  • Strong knowledge of Kotlin (Java knowledge is a plus) and 5+ years of commercial Android development.
  • Deep understanding of OOP, SOLID, and Clean Architecture.
  • Solid experience with presentation layer patterns — MVI, MVVM, and MVP — and the ability to choose the right one for the context.
  • Hands-on experience with our core stack:
  • Reactive programming & async: RxJava, Kotlin Coroutines / Flow
  • Dependency injection: Dagger 2, Hilt, or Koin
  • Networking: Retrofit
  • Navigation: Cicerone, Jetpack Navigation Component
  • Modern UI: Jetpack Compose
  • Practical experience with Firebase (FCM, Analytics, Crashlytics).
  • Experience with Feature-module architecture in production.
  • Confidence with Git / GitLab, including setting up and maintaining GitLab CI/CD.
  • A builder's mentality — you care about the product, the users, and the outcomes, not just the code.
  • Clear, concise communication in English across technical and non-technical audiences.

    • Nice to Have
  • Background in fintech or experience with financial products — you understand the stakes.
  • Solid grasp of mobile security best practices (especially critical in our domain).
  • Experience profiling and optimizing UI performance — reducing overdraw, improving recomposition efficiency in Jetpack Compose, and hitting smooth 60/120fps rendering.
  • Hands-on work with performance tooling: Android Profiler, Perfetto, Baseline Profiles, or similar.
  • Published apps on Google Play you're proud of.
  • An active GitHub profile with code you're happy to share.
  • Hands-on experience with AI agents and LLM tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, etc.) — setting up agent environments, writing prompts, skills, and behavioral rules.
  • Experience with AI-powered IDE tools (Cursor, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, etc.) — including agent mode, rules files configuration, and integrating AI into the daily development workflow.
  • Understanding of model capabilities and limitations — knowing which model fits which task and how to manage the context window effectively.
  • Ability to evaluate and verify AI-generated output — using automated tests, linters, and critical review to catch hallucinations and errors.
  • Awareness of AI security risks — prompt injection, data leakage, and safe handling of untrusted inputs in agentic workflows.

    • Recruitment Flow

    • Talent Partner Interview
    • First Technical Interview
    • Mobile System Design Interview
    • Team Fit Interview (peer interview)
    • Offer

    What You Will Get In Return
     
    Make a genuine impact on the product
     
    Join our upward trajectory, and grow with us. We provide the resources and opportunities for continuous personal and professional development, empowering you to make a genuine impact on our evolving product.
     
    Work in the EU
     
    Embark on this exciting journey with us and enjoy the flexibility of traveling and working remotely or in a hybrid model across Europe.
     
    Become a stock options holder
     
    Unlock your inner entrepreneur and align your aspirations with ours through our Stock Options Program. This exciting opportunity is available to every team member, from junior team members to our founders.
     
    Receive unwavering support and care
     
    Finom stands by you at every step, embodying our commitment to your well-being and success reflected in our modern, friendly, and eco-conscious corporate culture. We offer constant support and care to ensure your Finom experience is successful and fulfilling.
     
    Work & Swim program
     
    Immerse yourself in our exclusive Work & Swim Program. Spend one month in a comfortable corporate apartment in enchanting Cyprus. It's the ideal opportunity to strike the perfect work-life balance while enjoying breathtaking Mediterranean views.
     
    Equal Opportunity Statement 
     
    At Finom, we're an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We embrace diversity and invite applications from all walks of life. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability status, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

jobs.title: Robotics Engineer
jobs.description:
Robotics Engineer

Help shape the future of robotics in construction.

ABOUT XYZ REALITY

XYZ Reality created the world’s first and only engineering-grade augmented reality solution, purpose-built for the construction industry. Our holographic technology sits within The Atom, a smart, site-safe headset and hardhat, and is used on live projects to ensure schemes are delivered on time and on budget.

XYZ has grown to over 150 staff across the UK, US and Europe, and works with mission-critical organisations and construction companies to deliver major projects.

THE ROLE

Construction sites are some of the hardest environments for robot autonomy: they change every day and are full of clutter, obstacles and people. XYZ Reality’s robotics programme is extending our technology toward robots that can operate reliably in them, from autonomous data collection and construction progress capture through to executing construction tasks.

We’re looking for a Robotics Engineer to make that real. You’ll work hands-on with robot hardware in our London office, using a modern stack (ROS 2, NVIDIA Isaac Lab, learning-based control), and see your work tested in real construction environments, not just in simulation.

This is a hands-on, individual contributor role focused on robot software and algorithmic control, backed by a good working knowledge of robot hardware. If you have strong robotics fundamentals from an MSc, PhD or applied research group, love making systems work on real robots, and want your ideas to shape the direction of a programme, we want to hear from you.

This is an office-based role at our London site in Angel, Islington.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Integrate robots with XYZ’s software, bringing up ROS / ROS 2 interfaces, robot control, sensors, compute and data flows, and building repeatable tools for bring-up, configuration, logging and monitoring.

  • Establish reliable baseline control and develop task-specific behaviours for navigation, positioning and capture, training and tuning control policies in simulation and validating them on hardware.

  • Develop localisation-aware path planning, waypoint execution and obstacle handling, working with project and site teams to turn work plans and BIM-derived locations into robot missions.

  • Integrate capture payloads so images, pose, timing and mission status flow reliably into XYZ’s construction progress workflows, working with navigation, SLAM and perception colleagues.

  • Design test scenarios and measure mission completion, coverage, localisation quality, intervention, recovery and repeatability, improving the system through measured iterations.

  • Bring technical expertise and new ideas to the programme, comparing scripted, motion-planning and learning-based approaches and helping shape what comes next.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • MSc or PhD in Robotics, Controls, Computer Science, Mechatronics or a related discipline, or equivalent applied robotics experience. Industry experience is not required.

  • Hands-on experience building, programming or directly controlling a physical robot, from an academic project, research lab or industry.

  • Strong Python and C++, practical ROS experience (ideally ROS 2) and working knowledge of kinematics, coordinate frames, feedback control, state estimation, path planning and robot hardware.

  • Experience training or tuning robot control policies (e.g. reinforcement or imitation learning) using NVIDIA Isaac Lab / Isaac Sim or similar tools, with a rigorous experimental approach.

  • The right to work in the UK. We’re unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

KEY EXPERIENCE & SKILLS

  • ROS / ROS 2, Python & C++

  • Robot control, kinematics, state estimation & path planning

  • NVIDIA Isaac Lab / Isaac Sim, reinforcement or imitation learning

  • Sim-to-real transfer on physical hardware (desirable)

  • Navigation, SLAM, perception & sensor fusion (desirable)

  • Mobile or field robotics, BIM/CAD or construction technology (desirable)

BENEFITS

🏝️ 25 days annual leave + public holidays
🩺 Private healthcare with Vitality
🎄 Christmas shutdown days on top of leave allowance (2–4 per year usually)
🚇 Office located within a 5-minute walk from Angel station

🚀 Make a real-world impact by helping transform the construction industry

jobs.description:
Full Stack Developer (Onboarding & Enablement)

We turn every customer interaction into an opportunity. We connect conversations, customer data and payments with AI Agents so that companies can deliver personal customer journeys at scale: both online and in person.

“The entire customer journey. One platform”

What we value

Every CM.com colleague, connects to our 4 shared values:

Drive and Lead

You take initiative, make decisions and recognize opportunities. Making mistakes is part of moving forward.

Grow and Learn

The growth of our colleagues and our customers is our priority. You like to experiment, learn continuously and actively share knowledge and insights with others.

Together and Care

We work together and we believe that diverse perspectives lead to stronger outcomes. You value the social side of work, you show genuine interest and care about one another’s well-being.

Speed and Change

By welcoming AI Agents into our organisation, we fundamentally change how work is done. You are comfortable with change and you love working in a high paced environment.

The Role

As a Full Stack Developer in the Onboarding & Enablement team, you'll own the front door of CM.com connectivity: the self service experience where customers sign up and start messaging in minutes, without a sales call or a single email. It is one of the most important topics at CM.com today, and your team is the conductor behind it.

In today's tech market, speed wins. Customers choose the provider they can start with right now, and they value ease over a long list of requirements. Think of how quickly you can take out a phone subscription: that is the experience we want to offer. Our customers are people, but increasingly also AI agents, and neither wants to wait for a callback.

Behind that one simple interface sits a complex platform. Every channel works differently. For example: WhatsApp runs via Meta, RCS via Google and Orange, and more channels and suppliers are joining. Customers should never notice any of that. The complexity is ours, not theirs.

You will

  • Build the self service onboarding experience that takes customers from sign up to their first message in minutes

  • Turn every customer request into the right configuration across our own systems and external suppliers, fully automated

  • Make it easy to plug in new channels and supplier partnerships, so the platform grows without adding complexity for the customer

  • Drive automation across the full customer journey, for people and AI agents alike

  • Own your work from idea to production, including how it runs on our infrastructure

  • Use AI tools actively to improve your own work: experiment, automate, and share what works with your team


  • Medior to senior full stack developer with hands on experience in both front end and back end

  • Strong in Angular on the front end, and in C# and .NET on the back end

  • Solid knowledge of relational databases, such as SQL Server or PostgreSQL

  • Fluent in English and Dutch

  • Nice to have: experience with DevOps or system engineering, as the team also manages its own infrastructure

  • Genuinely curious about AI: you experiment with tools like ChatGPT or Copilot and you're open to working differently as they improve

Believe you’d be a great fit for this role, even if you don’t tick every box? Reach out to our Recruitment team! We’d be happy to connect and see if we can make it work together.

What we offer

As a CM.com club member, you’ll have the following benefits:

  • Onboarding: Join our unique 3-days Global Onboarding program in our Headquarters in Breda, a deep dive into the culture of CM.com.

  • Healthy food: Daily healthy lunches and snacks to keep you energized.

  • Time off: Recharge with 25 vacation days, plus the option to purchase 10 additional days.

  • Own your success: Become a shareholder with our Employee Share Purchase Program.

  • Your Development: We support your growth and development through initiatives like the CM Academy, Udemy courses, exclusive meetups with thought leaders, the Young Professional Program, and our own CM Business Adventure (CMBA), ensuring you’re always learning and evolving

  • Vitality: Our Vitality Team organizes a year-round vitality program to support a healthy body and mind for all colleagues. Think of stress prevention workshops, ergonomist visit, weekly bootcamps, yoga sessions and our CM sports day.

  • Together at CM.com: Weekly drinks, board game nights, karaoke throwdowns, yearly ski trip, and more! We have something for everyone.

Our diverse perspectives fuel innovation and drive us forward. We welcome everyone, regardless of age, background, or beliefs.

Before you apply

We work on-site, move fast, and expect you to bring your own thinking. Priorities shift, AI is actively changing how we work and we embrace that reality. If that sounds like a great environment to you, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Customer Solutions Engineer

Customer Solutions Engineer

Als ervaren Customer Solutions Engineer  bij Payter ben jij dé expert die klanten helpt bij complexe technische vraagstukken, het diagnosticeren van problemen en het oplossen van geëscaleerde klantvragen. Je begeleidt gebruikers door geavanceerde troubleshooting van onze producten, geeft deskundig advies en verzorgt producttrainingen als het belangrijkste technische aanspreekpunt. Als diepgaande specialist van het Payter-platform deel je best-practice advies en werk je nauw samen met diverse interne teams om complexe of unieke technische escalaties succesvol op te lossen. 

Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

  • Onderzoeken en oplossen van complexe technische problemen, vragen over softwareversies en hardware-uitdagingen, inclusief ondersteuning bij updates, transactiefouten en de doorstroom van telemetriedata.

  • Verzorgen van geavanceerde terminalconfiguraties, remote diagnostics en support bij de uitrol, evenals het oplossen van netwerkproblemen (wifi, 5G, LAN) en integraties van randapparatuur.

  • Fungeren als dé technische autoriteit op het gebied van Payter-hardware en -software, waaronder cloud-API's, TCP/IP-socketconnectiviteit en fysieke installatieprocedures.

  • Bieden van deskundig technisch advies aan gebruikers over de beste oplossingen voor integratie en dagelijks gebruik.

  • Efficiënt beheren van supporttickets en het leveren van gedetailleerde technische oplossingen via telefoon, e-mail, video of chat.

  • Nauw samenwerken met collega's en engineering-teams om een klantgerichte service te leveren, kwaliteitsstandaarden te waarborgen en operationele workflows te stroomlijnen.

  • Nauwkeurig documenteren van alle technische interacties en het ontwikkelen van best practices voor de interne kennisbank.

  • Signaleren en delen van kansen voor product- en procesverbeteringen op basis van klantfeedback, om zo de algehele gebruikerservaring te blijven optimaliseren.

Over Payter

Bij Payter zijn we pioniers en leiders op het gebied van contactloze en cashless betaaloplossingen in uiteenlopende markten, zoals elektrisch laden (EV), openbaar vervoer, retail, horeca, vending, goede doelen en parkeren. Het flexibele Payter-platform ondersteunt een breed scala aan betaaltechnologieën (waaronder NFC, EMV, Apple Pay en Google Pay), internationale bankprocessen, closed-loop betaal- en loyaliteitssystemen, en telemetrie.

Door continue innovatie en in-house ontwikkeling herdefiniëren we hoe verkopers in contact staan met hun klanten. We stellen hen in staat om de omzet te verhogen, de gebruikerservaring te verbeteren en realtime toegang te krijgen tot verkoop- en prestatiedata. Onze hoogwaardige producten ondersteunen technologieën zoals Contact & Contactless EMV, Mifare, WiFi, 5G, Bluetooth en touchscreens. Ze hebben een extreem lange levensduur, voldoen aan internationale standaarden, blinken uit in design, en zijn uiterst gebruiksvriendelijk en eenvoudig te integreren.


  • Je hebt minimaal 2 jaar ervaring in een integratie-supportrol, of 3 tot 4 jaar in een technische supportfunctie voor diverse producten.

  • Je hebt praktische kennis van HTTP, JSON/XML APIs, en TCP/IP-socketcommunicatie.

  • Je kunt goed overweg met Postman en Swagger; ervaring met softwareontwikkeling is een grote pre.

  • Je bent bij voorkeur bekend met industrieprotocollen zoals OCPP/OCPI, MDB of EMV.

  • Je hebt een brede achtergrond op het gebied van technische support, testen, documentatie en training.

  • Je beschikt over bewezen probleemoplossende vaardigheden en een proactieve gedrevenheid om te leren hoe nieuwe technologieën werken.

  • Je bent sociaal vaardig, spreekt vloeiend professioneel Engels en hebt een oprechte klantgerichte mindset.

  • Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal.

  • Je bent minimaal 3 dagen per week aanwezig op kantoor.

Voldoe je niet aan alle eisen, maar ben je er wel van overtuigd dat je de kwaliteiten voor deze functie in huis hebt? Dan nodigen we je uit om toch te solliciteren. We laten ons graag overtuigen.

Wat bieden wij?

Bij Payter geloven we dat een fijne werkomgeving de basis is voor succes. Daarom bieden wij jou:

  • Een verzorgde lunch op kantoor, zodat je samen met collega's kunt genieten van een goede pauze.

Businesses deserve better from finance. Less friction, more freedom. Since 2004, Mollie has been on a mission to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe.

Today, more than 250,000 companies trust our all-in-one platform to get paid, manage money and grow on their terms. Simple, scalable and built with real businesses in mind.

If you're ready to grow, shape the future of fintech and join an ambitious, high-performing team, this is the place for you.

Your impact

Cards is one of the most strategically important products at Mollie. It is the primary payment method operating at a global scale and the central enabler for Mollie to serve larger, more sophisticated merchants. As the accountable lead for online cards acceptance, you will own one of the highest net revenue-generating areas in the business, and your work will directly shape Mollie's ability to compete for and retain enterprise and mid-market merchants.

As the Head of Product for Cards Acquiring, you will own the end-to-end product strategy and execution for one of the most critical payment methods. You will bridge the gap between heavy technical infrastructure and high-impact commercial enablement. Leading a cross-functional team of around 20 people that includes product delivery managers, a product partnership person, a dedicated data person, and a PMM, you will scale Mollie’s cards capabilities beyond Europe, unlock new merchant categories, and ensure our proposition wins the hearts of highly sophisticated merchants. You will also work directly with payment schemes and external partners, making decisions that influence both the product roadmap and Mollie's broader positioning in the market.

The cards domain is expected to become an increasingly primary driver of Mollie's growth over time, with the potential for the online and in-person card acceptance platforms to converge and expand the scope of this role significantly. If you want to own something that matters at a company that is moving fast in the right direction, this is it.

What you'll ship

  • End-to-end product ownership: own the full cards acceptance product lifecycle—from deep technical infrastructure and processing stability to commercial enablement.

  • Go-To-Market & commercial enablement: lead the GTM strategy for new card features in tight lockstep with Product Marketing (PMM) and Commercial teams. You'll translate complex technical capabilities into crystal-clear value propositions that our sales teams can run with.

  • Global scale: drive the geographic expansion of our cards product, building out capabilities beyond Europe to support Mollie’s international growth.

  • Portfolio optimisation: Identify untapped merchant vertical opportunities and make data-driven decisions to maximise net revenue across the entire cards portfolio.

  • Team Leadership: Manage, coach, and scale a high-performing product team.

What You’ll Bring

  • Commercial & GTM Strategy: A proven track record of launching successful financial/payment products. You know how to price, position, and package features alongside PMM to win market share.

  • Partnership acumen: deep understanding of direct vs. indirect relationship strategies in the payments ecosystem and their respective commercial implications.

  • Technical depth: you aren't afraid of complexity. You can comfortably navigate the underlying technical architecture of cards acquiring, including the intricacies of the PCI compliance landscape.

  • Operational scale: experience managing operations-heavy environments and a proven ability to build scalable organisational structures that handle massive transaction volumes.

  • Customer obsession: this is non-negotiable at Mollie. You have a relentless drive to understand merchant pain points and build products that genuinely delight them.

  • Leadership: experience leading and developing cross-functional teams. You know how to cultivate a culture of high performance, accountability, and psychological safety.

Grow your way

At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.

You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step.

No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.

Procurement Specialist

Over NovoServe

NovoServe levert hosted dedicated servers vanuit meerdere datacenters in Nederland. We zijn een snelgroeiend bedrijf met een informele sfeer en internationale ambities. We zetten fors in op automatisering, om snel te kunnen opschalen en onze klanten optimaal te kunnen bedienen. Om onze snelle groei mogelijk te maken, ontwikkelen we eigen systemen voor IaaS-dienstverlening. Wij beheren een internationaal netwerk dat meer dan 7.000 fysieke servers ondersteunt, 19 Tbps aan externe connectiviteit biedt en beschikt over tientallen peering-partners. Onze netwerkinfrastructuur is verspreid over 8 datacenters op twee continenten, wat zorgt voor een hoge beschikbaarheid, veerkracht en een wereldwijd bereik.

Kern van de functie

Als Procurement Specialist ben je verantwoordelijk voor het volledige inkoopproces voor onze servers en netwerkapparatuur: van de behoefte-inventarisatie tot en met het contractbeheer. Je werkt op internationaal niveau voor onze datacenters in Nederland, de Verenigde Staten en Denemarken.

Je onderhoudt en versterkt duurzame relaties met onze belangrijkste leveranciers en blijft op de hoogte van nieuwe, opkomende spelers.

Je neemt het voortouw in de leveranciersselectie en het contracteringsproces. Hierbij zorg je niet alleen voor de beste commerciële voorwaarden, maar waarborg je ook dat alle afspraken voldoen aan de actuele wet- en regelgeving en onze langetermijnstrategie.

Naast inkoop ben je de drijvende kracht achter ons contractmanagement. Je beheert het contractregister waardoor we tijdig kunnen besluiten te verlengen of juist over te stappen naar een andere leverancier.

Dit doe je niet alleen; je werkt nauw samen met interne stakeholders om ervoor te zorgen dat de inkoop perfect aansluit op de bedrijfsdoelstellingen. Samen met Portfolio management signaleer je markt- en prijsontwikkelingen en risico's, en neem je passende maatregelen. Daarnaast organiseer je samen met interne deskundigen periodieke leveranciersbeoordelingen, bijvoorbeeld op het gebied van informatiebeveiliging, risicobeheersing en commerciële prestaties.

Hier herken jij jezelf in:

Je bent een Procurement Specialist met ervaring in zowel technologie (hardware) als commercie. Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met inkooptrajecten, bij voorkeur op het gebied van netwerk- en datacenterapparatuur. jobs.description:
Senior Fullstack-Entwickler (m/w/d) – PHP/Symfony & React

Der Plan steht, jetzt fehlst du: Bring unsere Software von Legacy-PHP auf Symfony und React.

Auf einen Blick

  • Stack: PHP 8.1 (Legacy) → Symfony · jQuery/Vanilla-JS → React · MySQL/MariaDB, SingleStore · Git, CI/CD

  • Gehalt: 52.000–62.000 € brutto/Jahr, für außergewöhnliche Profile auch mehr · unbefristet, Vollzeit

  • Arbeitsmodell: hybrid, 3 Tage Büro / 2 Tage remote

  • Standort: Berlin

  • Produkt: Eine Software für Termin- und Vorgangsmanagement in der öffentlichen Verwaltung

  • Start: so bald wie möglich oder nach Vereinbarung

Die Rolle

Das Kernprodukt unserer Kunden ist über viele Jahre gewachsen, und das sieht man dem Code an. Das Backend läuft auf PHP 8.1 ohne Framework. Im Frontend stehen jQuery und Vanilla-JS neben React, und automatisierte Tests gibt es bisher wenige.

Wohin es gehen soll, ist klar: Das Backend wird schrittweise auf Symfony umgestellt, das Frontend auf React vereinheitlicht. Bis Ende 2027 soll die Migration abgeschlossen sein. Was dafür fehlt, ist kein Plan, sondern Kapazität.

Du triffst eigenständig technische Entscheidungen, bringst dich in Architektur- und Modernisierungsfragen ein und sorgst dafür, dass die Codequalität mit jedem Release besser wird. Dabei bleibt das Produkt im Einsatz: Wartung, Support und neue Features laufen parallel zur Modernisierung.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Legacy-Module bei laufendem Betrieb schrittweise durch Symfony-Services und React-Oberflächen ersetzen

  • Fullstack-Features von der Datenbank bis zum Frontend entwickeln, teils auch als kundenspezifische Erweiterungen

  • Bestehenden Legacy-Code pflegen, debuggen und weiterentwickeln

  • Code-Reviews durchführen und die Testabdeckung ausbauen

  • Mit Entwicklungsleitung und Geschäftsführung abstimmen, welche Bereiche als Nächstes modernisiert werden

  • Zwei Auszubildende im letzten Ausbildungsabschnitt fachlich begleiten (ohne disziplinarische Führung)

  • Gelegentlich an Kundenterminen teilnehmen, etwa alle 3–4 Wochen

Nach 6 Monaten …

… setzt du Features eigenständig um, hast spürbar zur Modernisierung beigetragen, die Codequalität verbessert und bist für die Auszubildenden eine feste Ansprechperson.

Dein Profil

  • Erfahrung: etwa 4–5 Jahre in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung (ein Richtwert, keine harte Grenze)

  • PHP: fundierte Kenntnisse in modernem PHP 8.x mit objektorientierter Architektur, etwa Dependency Injection, Interfaces und SOLID

  • Symfony: nachweisbare Praxiserfahrung mit dem Framework

  • Legacy-Code: Du gehst sicher mit gewachsenen Codebasen um. Du refaktorierst, debuggst und entwickelst weiter, ohne alles neu zu schreiben.

  • JavaScript/React: solide Erfahrung im Frontend, jQuery schreckt dich nicht ab

  • Datenbanken: relationale Datenbanken wie MySQL/MariaDB oder SingleStore und sicherer Umgang mit SQL

  • Tooling: Git und Arbeit mit CI/CD

  • Sprache: Deutsch auf C1-Niveau, Englisch mindestens B1

  • Arbeitsweise: eigenständig, strukturiert, proaktiv und mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch

  • Persönlich: Du kommunizierst verlässlich, arbeitest gern im Team, übernimmst Verantwortung, hast keine Angst vor schwierigen Codestellen und gibst dein Wissen gern weiter.

  • Abschluss: Ausbildung oder FH-Abschluss zählen genauso viel wie ein Uni-Studium. Entscheidend ist deine Praxiserfahrung.

Pluspunkte: REST/API-Design und Schnittstellenentwicklung, automatisiertes Testing (PHPUnit, Jest), Docker, Deployment-Pipelines und Cloud, Software-Architektur und Design-Patterns, produktiver Einsatz von KI-Tools wie Claude Code oder Codex. Erfahrung mit Software für den öffentlichen Sektor ist nicht nötig.

Dein Team

Ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen: ein Developer Lead, ein Geschäftsführer und Projektmanager, der selbst aktiv mitentwickelt, ein externer Entwickler und zwei Auszubildende. Ihr stimmt euch täglich ab. Die Entwicklungsleitung und die Geschäftsführung übernehmen dein Onboarding persönlich.

Was wir bieten

  • Ein sinnstiftendes Produkt, das täglich in Bürgerämtern genutzt wird, in einem krisensicheren Markt

  • Echter Einfluss auf technische Entscheidungen und eine Modernisierung mit klarem Ziel

  • 30 Urlaubstage

  • Gleitzeit mit Kernzeit ab 10 Uhr, 2 Remote-Tage pro Woche

  • Weiterbildung während der Arbeitszeit, Udemy-Kurse; eigene Vorschläge sind willkommen

  • Claude-Lizenz, offen für weitere Tools

  • Hardware: Lenovo ThinkPad, offen für Vorschläge

  • UrbanSportsClub und JobRad

  • Gute Anbindung an den öffentlichen Nahverkehr

So läuft der Bewerbungsprozess

  • Technisches Interview mit Live-Projektarbeit mit dem Developer Lead und der Geschäftsführung

  • Teamgespräch vor Ort

Über das Unternehmen

Unser Kunde entwickelt seit über 25 Jahren Software für die öffentliche Verwaltung. Städte wie Berlin, München, Bonn und Dessau setzen seit Jahrzehnten auf die Lösungen des Unternehmens.

jobs.description:
Deployment Strategist, AI Solutions

Deployment Strategist, AI Solutions

London, with travel to NYC and client sites

Who A.Team is?

A.Team builds the agentic operating system for the enterprise. Every company is being told AI will change how it works, and few are seeing it happen. We’re here to change that. We build AI systems that capture what a company knows as work happens, carry it across teams and decisions, and get smarter with every outcome. We pair them with top AI talent who embed with our customers to make sure those systems get adopted and keep improving. Today we’re focused on consumer packaged goods. Global CPG marketing teams use A.Team to act on cultural trends as they happen, optimize campaigns and media spend, and turn commercial and pricing signals into clear decisions. We’re proven in production with Fortune 500 brands and partner with Google Cloud, Microsoft, Anthropic and OpenAI.

About the Role

We're looking for an experienced enterprise transformation and delivery leader to own the end-to-end success of one of A.Team's most strategic enterprise clients.

You will lead a complex, multi-workstream AI transformation program, working closely with senior client executives and A.Team's product, engineering, and delivery teams. Your responsibility is to translate business priorities into an actionable roadmap, drive execution across teams, ensure successful adoption, and deliver measurable business impact.

This is a highly visible leadership role that combines strategic thinking, hands-on execution, and executive relationship management. You will be the single point of accountability for the overall success of the client program—from defining priorities and aligning stakeholders to ensuring solutions are delivered, adopted, and generating value.

You'll work closely with the Account Executive, who owns the commercial relationship, renewals, and expansion, while you own delivery execution and client outcomes.

We're looking for someone who has successfully led large-scale enterprise transformation or technology implementation programs, can navigate complex organizations, and knows how to turn ambitious strategies into real-world results.

What You'll Do

  • Own End-to-End Client Delivery: Take full accountability for the successful delivery of a strategic enterprise client program, from defining priorities and planning through implementation, adoption, and measurable business impact. Ensure all workstreams deliver against agreed objectives, timelines, and quality standards.

  • Lead Cross-Functional Execution: Coordinate product, engineering, PMs, and AIOps teams to deliver as one integrated program. Set priorities, manage dependencies and risks, resolve escalations, and ensure clear ownership and accountability across teams.

  • Define and Drive the Deployment Roadmap: Work with client stakeholders to translate business objectives into a prioritized roadmap of AI use cases. Identify high-impact opportunities, validate them quickly with our Pathfinder team, and continuously evolve the roadmap based on business needs and results.

  • Ensure Successful Implementation: Oversee the deployment of AI solutions, from initial pilots through production rollout and ongoing operations. Proactively identify and remove blockers, manage delivery risks, and ensure solutions meet both business and technical requirements.

  • Drive Adoption and Change Management: Ensure deployed solutions become embedded in the client's day-to-day workflows. Work with business stakeholders to drive organizational alignment, overcome resistance, address training needs, and maximize adoption.

  • Deliver Measurable Business Value: Define success metrics and business cases for each initiative. Track performance, adoption, and ROI, ensuring the program delivers tangible business outcomes rather than simply shipping technology.

  • Lead Executive Stakeholder Relationships: Serve as the primary delivery counterpart to senior client executives. Build trusted relationships, align stakeholders across functions, manage expectations, lead executive reviews, and navigate complex organizational dynamics.

  • Partner with the Account Executive: Work closely with the AE, who owns the commercial relationship, renewals, and expansion. Surface new opportunities, provide evidence of delivered value, and ensure alignment between client priorities, delivery commitments, and commercial objectives.

  • Build a Scalable Delivery Playbook: Capture lessons learned, establish best practices, and develop repeatable processes that can be applied across future enterprise deployments.

Must-Haves

  • Enterprise Transformation Leadership: 8+ years of experience leading large-scale digital transformation, technology implementation, or innovation programs for major enterprises. You've owned complex programs from strategy through execution and delivered measurable business outcomes. Experience may come from management consulting, enterprise technology companies, or in-house transformation leadership. This is the most important requirement for the role.

  • End-to-End Program Ownership: Proven ability to lead complex, multi-workstream programs, coordinating cross-functional teams, managing competing priorities, resolving dependencies, and driving execution. You take full accountability for outcomes, even when teams don't report directly to you.

  • Executive Stakeholder Management: A track record of building trusted relationships with senior enterprise executives, navigating complex organizations, aligning stakeholders with competing interests, and influencing decisions. You're equally comfortable in the boardroom and working hands-on with delivery teams.

  • AI and Technical Fluency: Strong understanding of how enterprise AI and technology solutions are designed, built, integrated, deployed, and operated. You can engage confidently with engineers and technical leaders, challenge assumptions, evaluate trade-offs, and translate technical complexity into business implications. You don't need to be an engineer.

  • Business Acumen and Value Realization: Ability to translate business objectives into actionable plans, define meaningful success metrics, build compelling business cases, and demonstrate measurable value through adoption, operational improvements, and ROI.

  • Decisiveness and Problem-Solving: Strong judgment and a bias for action. You can navigate ambiguity, make difficult trade-offs, resolve complex problems, and keep teams focused on what matters most.

  • London-Based: Based in London, with the ability to work on-site with enterprise clients and travel to New York and other client locations as needed.

Nice-to-Haves

  • CPG, marketing or commercial-function experience

  • Experience driving adoption of AI or agentic tools inside large enterprises

  • Experience at an early-stage company where you built the playbook, not just ran it

  • Background spanning consulting and product or delivery leadership

jobs.title: Strategy  - Senior
jobs.description:
Strategy - Senior

Eight Advisory est un cabinet leader sur le marché du conseil financier et opérationnel, indépendant, spécialisé en Transaction, Restructuration et Transformation d’entreprises.

Nous accompagnons les dirigeants, les actionnaires, les banques et les investisseurs potentiels dans leurs décisions.

En très forte croissance depuis notre création fin 2009, Eight Advisory compte aujourd’hui plus de 1100 collaborateurs dont 129 associés et continue de se développer. Nous sommes présents en France, Belgique, Allemagne, Royaume-Uni, Suisse, Pays-Bas, USA, Espagne, Italie ainsi que dans une trentaine d’autres villes dans le monde à travers notre réseau de cabinets indépendants "Eight International".

Notre activité Strategy accompagne les dirigeants et investisseurs dans la résolution de problématiques complexes. Sa valeur ajoutée est de proposer des solutions réalistes et quantifiées, en combinant des approches stratégiques et opérationnelles. Afin d’accompagner sa forte croissance, nous recherchons actuellement des Senior Consultants et Consultantes (3 à 5 ans d’expérience professionnelle hors stage). L’activité Strategy compte aujourd’hui plus de 150 collaborateurs en Europe, issus des cabinets de conseils ou des entreprises.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Rejoindre l’équipe Strategy c’est prendre part à l’aventure entrepreneuriale du cabinet, en ayant un rôle essentiel dans le développement de l’activité. Pour maximiser notre impact chez les clients, nous adoptons des cycles de travail courts grâce à des sprints successifs. Cela favorise la rotation des équipes et accélère l'apprentissage. De plus, un programme de formation complet et un mentorat assuré par des collaborateurs(trices) plus expérimenté(e)s, permet à nos consultant(e)s de développer et approfondir rapidement les compétences du métier. Notre large portefeuille de clients vous permettra également de découvrir de nombreux secteurs d’activité et des contextes d’entreprises variés.

En nous rejoignant vous interviendrez principalement dans les contextes d’intervention suivants :

‘Deal Strategy & Exécution’ : Dans le cadre d’une transaction, en préparation ('pre-deal’) ou en exécution (‘post-deal’), vous accompagnerez des vendeurs comme des acheteurs durant tout le processus.

En préparation du deal :

  • Définition de l’Equity Story (rationnel de l’opération et stratégie de développement)

  • Réalisation de due diligence stratégique, commerciale, opérationnelle et ESG

  • Evaluation des potentielles synergies issues d’un rapprochement

  • Plan de séparation (‘Carve-out’)

Lors de l’exécution du deal :

  • Préparation de plan d’intégration (‘PMI’) et définition de la stratégie et des actions nécessaires pour garantir la continuité de l’activité ('Day 1 readiness’)

  • Mise en œuvre de plan de synergies

  • Animation et pilotage de la performance

‘Corporate Strategy & Business transformation’ : Vous participerez à la construction et à la mise en œuvre de plans stratégiques et de programmes de transformation, avec notamment :

  • Construction de plans stratégiques : plan de transformation, plan de création de valeur, repositionnement stratégique, définition de solutions et offres innovantes

  • Conception de programmes d’excellence commerciale et de développement du revenu, de nouveaux business models, de plan marketing, de plan de performance des ventes et d’amélioration de la relation client

  • Définition de nouveaux business models et innovation, de plan marketing, de plan de performance des ventes et d’amélioration de la relation client

  • Conception de projets d’excellence opérationnelle d’amélioration des performances (manufacturing, supply chain, etc.)

  • Conception de programmes de transformation digitale ou technologique

  • Mise en place des feuilles de route d’un Business Plan

  • Accompagnement des entreprises dans leurs enjeux liés aux sujets ESG

‘Turnaround & Operational Restructuring’ : Dans des contextes de sous-performance ou de crise, vous participerez à la construction et mise en œuvre de plans de retournement, avec notamment :

  • Construction et mise en œuvre de plans de retournement, avec si nécessaire la rationalisation de l'empreinte industrielle et des réseaux de distribution, la refonte de l’organisation et l’optimisation du Besoin en Fonds de Roulement

  • Mise en place et pilotage de cellules dédiées (« CRO Office ») avec notamment la construction de plans stratégiques dans des contextes de sous-performance,

  • Reprise en main de filiales ou d'activités déficitaires

En tant que Senior Consultant(e), vous serez le/la référent(e) d’un ou plusieurs chantiers sur vos missions. Vous vous verrez confier la responsabilité de l’avancement des analyses et des rapports. Vous serrez en contact direct avec vos clients dans le cadre des ateliers et des comités de pilotage. Votre rôle portera également sur l’accompagnement des équipes avec lesquelles vous serez amené(e) à intervenir.


Nous recherchons pour ces missions des candidats de formation supérieure (Bac+5 –école d’ingénieur ou école de commerce), ayant acquis 3 à 5 ans d’expérience parmi les suivantes :

  • Une expérience dans le conseil en stratégie ou au sein d’une équipe stratégie en entreprise

  • Une expérience dans le conseil durant laquelle il/elle aura développé de solides compétences opérationnelles (Supply Chain, achats, contrôle de gestion industriel, Manufacturing, logistique, excellence commerciale) avec une appétence pour l’analyse des impacts financiers

  • Une expérience opérationnelle en entreprise dans une structure reconnue pour son excellence dans les domaines opérationnels et / ou financiers

Vous êtes doté(e) de qualités relationnelles et analytiques reconnues. Curieux(se), dynamique, vous faites preuve d'esprit d'équipe et vous pratiquez couramment l’anglais dans le cadre de vos missions (la pratique d’une seconde langue étrangère serait un plus). Vous êtes motivé(e) par le challenge d’intervenir dans des contextes à forts enjeux stratégiques marqués par des enjeux marchés ou de retournement ainsi que d’élargir vos compétences sur les dimensions financières et opérationnelles. Vous avez envie de vivre une aventure entrepreneuriale en participant à la forte croissance de Eight Advisory.
