As an Instruments Manufacturing Engineer, you will play a key role across the full product lifecycle of surgical instruments, from setting up new assembly lines to driving continuous improvement once production is up and running. You will make sure every product can be built reliably and efficiently and meet yield and performance as volumes grow. Working closely with the Production team, you will provide hands-on line support and troubleshooting and help ramp up production.

Duties & Responsibilities :

· Set up and continuously optimize assembly lines to increase production capacity of surgical instruments.

· Lead manufacturing process development, validation, verification and equipment qualification activities to support production readiness and process sustainability.

· Provide day-to-day line support troubleshooting to keep production running and support production ramp-up.

· Drive continuous improvement of production, using data-driven problem-solving and root-cause analysis to identify issues and improve processes and design.

· Identify and lead value improvement initiatives that enhance quality, cost, capacity, efficiency and operational performance.

· Review field complaints related to medical devices, and contribute to root-cause analysis and corrective actions.Initiate, assess impacts on technical and quality aspects, and execute Change Requests, and associated Design Transfers to production.

· Update the technical documentation of the Device Master Records (DMR) in coordination with R&D, CMO and/or suppliers.

· Participate in the creation and the continuous update of the risk management file in coordination with R&D, CMO and/or suppliers.

· Be the voice of manufacturing during product development to ensure products can be manufactured reliably and efficiently.

Requirements

Requirements :

· Bachelor's degree in engineering (mechanical, industrial, or equivalent).

· 2+ years of experience in manufacturing engineering, industrialization, process development or production support of high-volume complex assemblies within a highly regulated industry (e.g. medical device, aeronautical, automotive).

· Demonstrated ability to analyse technical problems, propose solutions and drive improvements in a manufacturing environment.

· Knowledge of continuous improvement methodologies, including Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or structured problem-solving approaches.

· Experience in leading process validation, verification, or manufacturing process development activities.

· Experience in manufacturing equipment qualification.

· A track record of successfully bringing complex products into production.

· Knowledge of medical device quality standards and regulations (ISO 13485, ISO 14971, FDA 21 CFR 820) is a plus.

· Fluent in English and French.

Benefits

What we offer:

  • A dynamic, innovative environment with cutting-edge medical technology that is shaping the future of robotic surgery.
  • Fast-growing Company where innovation meets agility.
  • Structured onboarding program and training, ensuring a confident start.
  • High degree of autonomy and flexibility.

Meewerkstage Marketing Foto & Video Editor

Wil jij je verder ontwikkelen als editor en fotograaf, met echte opdrachten en een eigen rol in het team? Zoek jij een stage vanaf januari/ februari 2027? Dan is deze stage iets voor jou.

Binnen BAS Group komen verschillende gespecialiseerde bedrijven samen, van de handel in trucks en trailers tot onderhoud, lease, verhuur en onderdelen. Dat levert eindeloos veel beeldmateriaal op: imposante trucks, drukke werkplaatsen, internationale klanten en vakmensen aan het werk. Als meewerkstagiair Foto & Video Editor neem jij de productie van onze foto’s en video’s in handen, van opname tot eindmontage. Dit is een stage voor makers.

Wat ga je doen?

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het volledige productieproces van foto- en videocontent. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • Het voorbereiden van opnames, zoals shotlists, locaties en planning;

  • Het filmen en fotograferen van voertuigen, werkplaatsen, events en collega’s aan het werk;

  • Het monteren van bedrijfsfilms, productvideo’s, recruitmentvideo’s en interviews;

  • Het verzorgen van color grading, audiobewerking en ondertiteling;

  • Het maken van motion graphics en animaties voor intro’s, titels en uitleg;

  • Het nabewerken en retoucheren van foto’s tot een consistente, professionele beeldstijl;

  • Het opzetten en beheren van een overzichtelijk archief van beeldmateriaal;

  • Het aanleveren van video’s in verschillende formaten voor diverse marketingkanalen.

Wij bieden jou

  • Een stagevergoeding van €500,- bruto per maand voor een fulltime stage én reiskosten (voor wat, hoort wat);

  • Een inhoudelijke en uitdagende opdracht passend bij jouw ambities en opleiding;

  • De mogelijkheid om onderdeel uit te maken van ons gedreven en enthousiaste team;

  • Bij goede prestaties uitzicht op een vaste functie binnen BAS. Bij BAS zeggen we namelijk niet voor niets: ''Bij BAS heb je geen baan maar een carrière!''

  • Een vaste kruk voor tijdens onze VrijMiBo’s en volop ruimte voor gezelligheid.


  • Je volgt een mbo- of hbo-opleiding in de richting van audiovisuele media, mediavormgeving, Communication & Multimedia Design, Commerciële Economie of Communicatie en bent bij voorkeur op zoek naar een meewerkstage;

  • Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met filmen, fotograferen en monteren, bijvoorbeeld via opdrachten, freelance werk of eigen projecten;

  • Je kunt zelfstandig omgaan met camera, licht en geluid;

  • Affiniteit met trucks of automotive is mooi meegenomen, maar niet vereist.

Wij zijn BAS!

We zijn actief sinds 1962. Sindsdien vestigden wij onze naam als een betrouwbare kracht in de Automotive. Als familiebedrijf zijn wij wereldwijd actief in kopen, onderhouden en verkopen van vrachtwagens, trekkers, trailers, bouwmachines, bedrijfswagens en landbouwmachines.

Al onze kennis en ervaring verwerkten we daarnaast in de ontwikkeling van basworld.com. Hier verbinden we kopers en verkopers met elkaar en helpen we hen om snel, gemakkelijk en veilig te handelen. Onze ambitie voor BAS kent geen grenzen. Rijd jij voorop om BAS naar het volgende niveau te brengen?

Samengevat: bij BAS gaan we altijd vol gas en is geen dag hetzelfde. Met meer dan 1.000 collega’s proberen wij onszelf iedere dag een stukje beter te maken voor onze klanten. Daarbij staan Brabantse nuchterheid, passie, teamwork en ondernemerschap voorop.

jobs.title: Web & Mobile Full Stack Developer
jobs.description:
Web & Mobile Full Stack Developer

The mission
Help build fair, engaged and high-performing teams.
We believe everyone deserves a fair opportunity to develop and be rewarded for the value they bring. That’s why we build software that helps organizations set clear expectations, define what a role entails, assess performance fairly, support employee growth, and make compensation transparent and explainable. From clear roles to fair rewards, all within one continuous process. Will you join us in driving this change?

Please note: for this role, it’s important that you already live in the Netherlands and are able to work from our Utrecht office at least three days a week.

The opportunity
As our new Web & Mobile Full Stack Developer, you’ll help build and improve our SaaS platform across all surfaces: mobile, web and backend. You’ll work on our React Native mobile app as we scale it into a fully independent experience for mobile-first markets. You’ll contribute just as actively to our web platform, from intuitive user interfaces in React to scalable APIs and backend services in Node.js.

Your average week in Utrecht:

  • Building and shipping new features in our React Native mobile app (around 50% of your time)

  • Building and shipping new features on our web platform, with React on the frontend and Node.js on the backend (around 50% of your time)

  • Shaping features together with product and design to improve the user experience

  • Working in structured weekly sprints with your team

  • Writing clean, scalable and maintainable code in TypeScript, React, React Native, Node.js and MongoDB

  • Building and improving performant, secure REST APIs

  • Contributing to technical discussions and architecture decisions, including our mobile strategy

  • Reviewing pull requests to keep quality high

  • Improving developer workflows, CI/CD and automated testing

  • Owning features from idea to deployment, across mobile and web

In short: your work directly makes our platform faster, smarter and more scalable, helping our customers grow and pushing Learned to the next level 🌱

The team
You’ll join a development team of 6 developers in Utrecht, working closely with 11 colleagues in Sri Lanka through a buddy system that keeps lines short. The team is led by Alex, our CTO. We’re an international company of 55 people (7+ nationalities) serving 350+ customers, increasingly at enterprise level. With the EU Pay Transparency Directive coming up, demand for our product is growing fast, and so is our roadmap.

Your growth

  • Learning every day from experienced, senior colleagues across mobile, web and backend

  • Hands-on experience building AI features into a product used by hundreds of companies

  • A personal development budget of €1,000 per year

  • An open feedback culture: we practice what we preach


The musts

  • You already live in the Netherlands and can work from our Utrecht office at least 3 days a week

  • Around 3+ years of experience as a Full Stack Developer

  • At least 1 year of experience building production apps in React Native

  • Solid experience with TypeScript, React and Node.js (or comparable stacks), including REST APIs

  • Experience building or integrating AI features in a product (e.g. LLM features, agents or retrieval)

  • You enjoy switching between mobile, frontend and backend, and owning features end-to-end

  • You communicate clearly and confidently in English

  • You’re proactive, take ownership and love learning together through feedback


The nice-to-haves

  • Experience with MongoDB or similar databases

  • Experience with CI/CD, automated testing and cloud infrastructure

  • Experience publishing apps to the App Store and Google Play

Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Italy, Spain, Germany, Denmark and Finland already love running on Tebi.

About the role:

Restaurant owners trust other restaurant owners. They listen to the chef down the street, their wine supplier and their accountant long before they listen to an ad. That's why our events work. When we launched in Berlin, we hosted a four-hands dinner with two local merchants and a well-known food creator. We believe that’s what builds credibility, trust, and ultimately a warm prospect list.

We’re hiring an Events & Community Manager to turn that into a program that runs in several markets at the same time. You’ll plan and run our partner and owned events, and find new ways to grow Tebi through the hospitality community in each city, neighbourhood and market. You’ll work closely with our local sales teams so every event and partnership turns into real conversations.

This is a hands-on role. One week you'll be hosting a merchant dinner in Milan, the next you'll be setting up a distributor breakfast in Amsterdam. You'll report to the Head of Marketing and work closely with our Marketing team to extend these programs to our channel ecosystem, plus align closely with the General Managers and Account Managers in each market.

What you'll be doing:

  • Run events across markets: Plan and deliver partner and owned events in 2–3 markets at a time, from intimate merchant dinners and industry breakfasts to city launches. You own the calendar, budget, venues, suppliers, guest lists and the plan for the night.

  • Build the playbook as you go: Turn each event into templates, checklists and supplier lists, so we can launch a city campaign in weeks, not months. Improve them after every event.

  • Build local partner networks: Find the people operators already trust: drinks distributors, wholesalers, food creators, hospitality associations, accountants and the advisers who help new venues open. Build partnerships that bring us introductions and referrals, not just logos.

  • Put our merchants front and center: Work with our best merchants as hosts and anchors, so prospects hear about Tebi from the people they respect.

  • Turn connections into pipeline: Agree with local Sales and Account Management who to involve, how to follow up and who owns what conversations. Track every event in HubSpot from invite to demo to signed merchant.

  • Grow Tebi through the community: Find new ways to reach operators through the people and places they already trust, in each city, neighborhood and across borders. Keep guests and partners engaged after events, so one introduction leads to the next.

  • Open new community channels: Test new ways to grow through our close-knit industry, such as an affiliate or referral program for partners, sharing useful insights from our merchants, and showing up in the forums and groups where operators talk shop.

  • Capture the stories: Work with our creative team and relevant freelancers to turn events and partner moments into social content, case studies and sales material.

How we'll measure success:

  • Events delivered each quarter across markets, on time and on budget

  • Demos, pipeline and new merchants from each event and partnership

  • Introductions, referrals and leads from partners, affiliates and community channels

  • Cost per demo compared with our other channels

What you’ll bring:

  • Have built something people show up for: an event series, a supper club, a community, a program. You can point to what it led to, not just how many people came

  • Feel at home in hospitality. You've worked in or around restaurants, bars or food and drink brands, and you're comfortable leading a room full of operators

  • Are high agency. You own your calendar, your relationships and your results, and you don't wait to be told what to do

  • Build your own playbook when there isn't one, and you enjoy doing the work as much as planning it

  • Know the difference between a real community and a guest list

  • See growth opportunities beyond events, and are curious enough to test them

  • Can run several markets at once without dropping details, and are happy to travel regularly

  • Track what you do: comfortable with a CRM (HubSpot a plus), UTMs and simple reporting

  • Speak fluent English. Dutch, German, Italian, Spanish or a Nordic language is a plus

Typically this means 3–5 years in events, community, field marketing or partnerships, but we care more about what you've built than how long you've been doing it.

This role isn't for you if:

  • You'd rather plan the program than run it

  • You need a fixed playbook and a clear org chart to get going

  • You're not willing to roll up your sleeves on the night

Benefits:

  • Start-up Equity

  • Competitive Salary

  • Lunch Provided in Office

  • Team building events

  • Unlimited time off

What is Restaurant Software?

Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it.

From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy.

How we use AI at Tebi

We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed.

At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it.

We believe artificial intelligence will transform healthcare more profoundly than any technology since the internet, and we’re building that future today, not tomorrow. While the German healthcare sector has historically focused on the risks of new technologies, we see an unprecedented opportunity to solve the industry’s most pressing challenges with AI. With most German acute hospitals now using the Recare platform, we take our leadership responsibility seriously: we’re helping clinics achieve what once seemed impossible, from automation of administrative workflows with the Recare AI platform to unlocking billions in value through predictive analytics. The potential is real, the technology is ready, and the time is now.

As a senior member of the AI team, you will work on building cutting-edge agentic systems that work reliably in production environments where privacy and correctness are top priorities. This is a hands-on role: you will own key AI initiatives end to end and work across products, since the hardest problems here span more than one team.

  • Safeguarding health data: Embed security best practices and uphold compliance to protect sensitive health information.

What we’re looking for

jobs.title: Manufacturing Process Engineer
jobs.description:
Manufacturing Process Engineer

About OLIX

AI is growing faster than any technology in history and the explosion in demand has created a massive infrastructure gap; we can no longer build chips or power stations fast enough to keep up. The industry is still leaning on a ten-year-old hardware blueprint that has reached its limit. A new paradigm that is faster and more efficient will be the biggest economic opportunity of the next century and create the most important company of the next decade. The OLIX Decode Accelerator 1 (DX-1) is the first accelerator architected specifically for decode. Rack-scale co-design of logic, data movement, packaging, optics and interconnect enables a step change in system level performance.

The Role

As a Manufacturing Process Engineer at OLIX, you will be responsible for turning our optical interconnect technology for co-packaged optics (CPO) into scalable, manufacturable, and reliable hardware. You will work closely with our development team in London to establish high-throughput, high-yield manufacturing processes, then transfer those processes to our manufacturing partners and support them through ramp.

This is a hands-on, high-impact role. The lines you build are how our optical interconnect reaches production. The role involves extensive travel (up to 50% of the time), including to our manufacturing partner sites.

Responsibilities

  • Establish and qualify robust, high-throughput, high-yield manufacturing lines for our optical interconnect technology

  • Work with our manufacturing partners to establish high throughput, high yielding manufacturing lines and support those partners through qualification and volume ramp

  • Specify, commission and qualify production equipment

  • Develop new and improved manufacturing processes, and drive continuous improvement in throughput and yield

  • Improve process capability through statistical process control

  • Represent OLIX to the management, engineering and production teams at our manufacturing partners

  • Collaborate across R&D, Process Engineering, Equipment Engineering, Characterisation & Test and Production, within OLIX and at our partners, to hit project milestones

  • Contribute to strategic IP development and patents

  • Ensure compliance with site and factory protocols and safety regulations

Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Materials Science, Physics, Electrical Engineering, Chemistry or a related field

  • Experience with process development in high-volume, high-technology manufacturing (e.g. semiconductors, electronics or display technologies), including New Product Introduction (NPI) and scaling to volume

  • Experience working in controlled or cleanroom environments

  • Proven track record of designing DoEs and executing structured experiments

  • Experience applying statistical process control, yield improvement and throughput optimisation in production

  • Ability to interpret complex experimental data, troubleshoot process issues and drive systematic improvements

  • Excellent teamwork, documentation and communication skills

Nice to Have

  • Experience transferring processes to contract manufacturers or foundries

  • Failure analysis experience

  • Patent or IP contributions

Compensation & Equity

  • Competitive Salary: Commensurate with your experience, skills, and location

  • Equity & Ownership: Meaningful stock options. You’re not just joining the mission; you’re owning a piece of it

  • Proximity Bonus: We value your time. To minimise your commute and maximise your life, we offer an annual Living-Local Bonus if your residence is within 20 minutes of the office

  • Retirement Benefits: Employer-contributed retirement plans to help you build long-term financial security

Due to U.S. export control regulations, candidates’ eligibility to work at OLIX depends on their most recent citizenship or permanent residency status. We are generally unable to consider applicants whose most recent citizenship or permanent residence is in certain restricted countries (currently including Iran, North Korea, Syria, Cuba, Russia, Belarus, China, Hong Kong, Macau, and Venezuela). Applicants who have subsequently obtained citizenship or permanent residency in another country not subject to these restrictions may still be eligible.

jobs.title: Customs AI Integration & Automation Engineer (France)
jobs.description:
Customs AI Integration & Automation Engineer (France)

About Customs Support Group

Customs Support Group (CSG) is the European market leader in customs services, operating across 15 countries. CSG is owned by private equity and a fast-growing, dynamic, data-driven company, dedicated to expanding its presence through strong organic growth and strategic acquisitions. Its key priorities include digital transformation, operational excellence and customer experience, all aimed at driving growth and enhancing efficiency.

The Role

You will take our AI stack and lead its development and customisation for the market.

This is a builder and do-er role. You will design, test and implement practical and compliant agentic AI solutions on top of foundation models document understanding, classification support, retrieval over our own procedures and tariff material, and agents that carry multi-step operational work end to end.

You are not being asked to train models from scratch. You are being asked to make models that already exist behave reliably enough that operations staff trust them with customs declarations, where being wrong has consequences.

Working closely with Operations, Transformation, IT and Group teams, you will turn business needs into scalable solutions.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop and customise AI solutions for the market, from prototype through to production ownership.

• Be curious and prepared to self-learn to use generative-AI to build agents that make a difference to our business

• Identify automation and decision-support opportunities across customs and business processes, and size them honestly before building.

• Design solutions using generative AI and large language models — retrieval, tool calling, structured extraction from customs documentation, and agentic workflows where they genuinely fit.

• Own the evaluation. Define how we know a solution is working before it ships, and how we know a change has not made it worse. This is treated as core to the role, not an afterthought.

• Manage pilots and implementation, and set the criteria for killing a pilot as clearly as the criteria for scaling it.

• Monitor performance, inference cost, latency and business impact.

• Collaborate with local teams, Group functions and technology partners.

• Contribute to privacy, security and AI governance compliance, working with Group Legal and IT Security. You should understand how the EU AI Act applies to what you build, and be able to produce the documentation that goes with it.

.

Requirements

Essential

• 1-2 years AI engineering, software engineering or intelligent automation, including LLM or AI features that real users depended on.

• Strong Python and SQL, with production code ownership. Not familiarity.

• Demonstrable experience integrating large language models into production systems — prompt and context design, retrieval-augmented generation, structured output, and handling failure gracefully.

• Practical experience with at least one major cloud AI platform (Azure AI, AWS Bedrock, or Google Vertex).

• Solid full stack backend engineering fundamentals — APIs, data pipelines, testing, CI/CD. Most of this job is

• Strong communication skills — you will spend real time with operations staff who are experts in customs and not in AI.

Desirable

• Agent orchestration frameworks and standards (LangGraph, MCP, Temporal or equivalent), and experience with long-running or multi-step agent workflows.

• Observability and cost control for inference at volume.

What success looks like in your first year

• By month three: You understand our customs processes well enough to challenge what we ask for, and you have shipped one small, useful thing.

• By month six: At least one AI solution is live, measured against a baseline, and demonstrably better than what it replaced.

What We Offer

• An international and fast-evolving environment, with peers in other Customs Support Group markets working on the same problems.

• Professional growth opportunities, including a budget for conferences, certification and model/compute costs for your own experiments.

How to apply

Send us your CV and a short note a few paragraphs is plenty describing one system you have put in front of real users. We are most interested in what went wrong with it and what you did about that.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Backend Engineer

About Payflows

At Payflows, we build software that helps large companies manage and automate their payment workflows. It’s not the flashiest part of a business, but it’s one of the most critical: invoices, approvals, payments, and controls. When these things slow down, the whole company feels it.

But our ambition goes further than just building a better workflow tool.

We believe the future of finance operations is not faster clicking: it’s no clicking at all 🫳 🎤

Finance teams shouldn’t spend their days moving data from one screen to another. Software should do the operational work, and humans should focus on reviewing, approving, and making the decisions that matter.

That’s the direction we’re building toward: an agent-driven finance platform, where intelligent agents handle the repetitive tasks, and users stay in control.

We started in 2022 with a small team and a rough first version of the product. Three years later, we’re working with major companies across France, the UK, and the US while choosing to keep our team small and human-sized.

We moved fast, shipped a lot, and not everything was built in a perfect way. But it helped us learn quickly, sign real customers, and prove that the problem we’re solving truly matters.

In 2024, investors trusted us with a $25M Series A. That gives us the chance to keep growing while also strengthening our foundations and building the system that will power this agent-driven future.

Today, we’re about 35 people from many different countries, and we’re looking for a few amazing humans to join the next chapter. 🤗

🚀 What you’ll actually do

You’ll help build a product that real finance teams rely on every day.

For us, engineering is not just about clean code, it’s about reliability, clarity, and trust, especially when money and automation are involved.

In a typical week, you might:

  • Design and implement new services for a product feature.

  • Refactor an early service to make it more robust.

  • Investigate a performance or production issue.

  • Work with product and frontend to shape a new feature.

  • Review code and help teammates improve.

  • Build backend tools that our AI agents use to perform real finance operations.

  • Design safe, deterministic workflows where agents propose actions and humans review them.

Your time will be split between building new features and improving what already exists. Both matter.

You won’t just build endpoints. You’ll help shape the execution layer that our agents rely on: the APIs, data models, and workflows that let them act safely in production.

You’ll work closely with product, frontend, and customer-facing teams. We expect engineers to take ownership of parts of the system and help make them more reliable over time.

💻 Our current tech reality

Our stack evolves based on our challenges, but we care more about good design than trendy tools 🙏

Python is our core language. It helps us move fast, keep the code readable, and fits naturally with our AI-driven approach. A growing part of the system is built around agents that use our backend as a set of reliable, deterministic tools.

  • Core language: Python

  • Backend: FastAPI + Pydantic

  • Data: PostgreSQL

  • Infra: AWS, serverless when it makes sense

  • Performance: some Rust for critical paths

  • Architecture: multi-service backend, simple enough to reason about

Some parts of the system are clean and well-tested. Others were built quickly and need love. That’s the phase we’re in.

Over the next year, we’ll focus on:

  • Turning core workflows into reliable tools for our agents

  • Simplifying services

  • Improving tests and observability

  • Making performance more predictable

  • Cleaning up early code

We know we’re not perfect, but we care a lot about improving step by step.


✨ Who’s going to thrive with us

You’ll probably feel comfortable here if:

  • You like building products people actually use.

  • You are autonomous and take ownership of what you ship.

  • You take initiative and lead by example.

  • You’re curious and enjoy figuring things out.

  • You’re pragmatic about trade-offs.

  • You communicate with kindness and clarity.

This role is a great fit if you’re excited by the idea of:

  • Building systems that are used by AI agents, not just humans.

  • Designing reliable, safe automation in production.

  • Working on a product that is still early and evolving quickly.

You don’t need to know everything about AI. But you should be curious about it and excited to work in a system where agents are part of the core product 🤖

🧩 What you’ll get from this role

  • Real ownership over parts of the system.

  • Direct impact on customers and product decisions.

  • A small, human team where your work is visible and meaningful 🤝

  • A mix of feature work, system design, and technical improvements.

  • Exposure to real scaling and production challenges.

  • The chance to help build an agent-driven product from the inside.

We offer:

  • Competitive salary and equity.

  • Flexible remote setup (we prefer people to come into Paris or London office twice per week. At a minimum we’d ask you to be at an office 3 days per month, onboard in Paris for your first few weeks, and work CEST timezone).

  • A high-autonomy environment where you have real ownership and space to make an impact.

  • Plenty of room to grow, take responsibility, and shape parts of the product.

  • A culture based on trust, ownership, and clear communication.

This isn’t a huge corporate environment. In exchange, you get autonomy, responsibility, and the chance to shape a product that’s still early in its story—and help build what finance operations will look like in the next decade 🚀

jobs.title: Senior Reinforcement Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Reinforcement Learning Engineer
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology.

The Opportunity 

We are looking for a Senior Reinforcement Learning Engineer to join our Motion Intelligence team. You should bring deep expertise in reinforcement learning and policy optimisation, grounded in real-world robotics experience, and be excited to push the boundaries of autonomous robots. We are looking for someone who can provide senior-level RL and learning-based control guidance across the team — shaping how we train, deploy, and maintain learned policies on physical robots operating in demanding industrial environments.
Beyond RL expertise, we value engineers who take pride in writing clean, maintainable code, simplifying complex systems through thoughtful design, and championing sound interfaces and architecture.

At ANYbotics, we develop tailored software solutions that enable our legged robots to execute inspection and maintenance tasks with precision and consistency. This role sits at the intersection of cutting-edge RL research and production robotics — from sim-to-real policy transfer and reward engineering through to reliable deployment on mission-critical systems in the field. You’ll work across the full lifecycle — from early development prototyping through to mission‑critical, production deployments.

 
The Market & Our Technology 

ANYbotics transforms industrial plants in the energy, process, and utility sector by introducing robotics to a wide range of novel applications that so far were beyond reach. Our customers are large asset operators and industrial service providers pioneering the use of robotics technology for inspection and maintenance. Our mobile robot ANYmal uses legs for extreme mobility in complex environments, camera- and LIDAR-based sensing for full autonomy and obstacle avoidance, and AI for high-quality and consistent inspection results. We develop numerous customised hardware systems, including the entire robotic platform, actuators, sensors, inspection payloads, charging systems, and all related ANYbotics electrical hardware.


Your Impact
  • Lead the design, training, and deployment of reinforcement learning policies for robot motion — bridging the gap from simulation to reliable real-world performance
  • Provide senior technical guidance on RL and learning-based control across the team, mentoring engineers and establishing best practices for policy development workflows
  • Own and evolve the RL training infrastructure and sim-to-real pipeline, ensuring reproducibility, scalability, and fast iteration cycles
  • Shape the technical vision for internal ML tooling and experiment management (e.g. training dashboards, automated evaluation pipelines), driving efficiency and rigour across the team's learning workflows
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders to identify how to expand the robot's autonomous operational envelope
  • Triage field issues related to locomotion, recognise failure patterns, and rapidly improve policy robustness based on real deployment data
  • Write, deploy, and maintain efficient Python and C++ software for the learning and locomotion stack

    • Your Profile
  • PhD in robotics, machine learning, computer science or a related field with a strong focus on reinforcement learning; alternatively, an equivalent track record of RL research and deployment in robotics Or
  • Master's degree from a top-tier technical university (e.g. ETH Zurich, EPFL) in robotics, machine learning, computer science or related field and 5+ years of professional experience
  • Proven track record of shipping ML models to the field and maintaining those solutions over time
  • Solid grounding in robot control fundamentals and autonomous systems, including: motion control, state estimation, path planning and actuation
  • Experience using robotic simulation tools such as Gazebo or Isaac Sim
  • Strong understanding of sim-to-real transfer, domain randomisation, reward shaping, and policy robustness techniques
  • Proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks (PyTorch); working knowledge of C++
  • Strong knowledge of Linux systems and middleware frameworks for integrating learned components into a larger software stack
  • Pragmatic and solution-oriented mindset — comfortable balancing research exploration with production delivery
  • Excellent communication skills in English

    • Bonus Points
  • Experience training and deploying RL policies on physical robots — not just in simulation
  • Development of scalable and modular robot architectures of motion control systems
  • Experience with navigation systems and autonomous mobile robot operation in unstructured environments
  • Interest in agentic engineering toolchains
  • Experience leading software architecture design and software engineering best practices
  • A solid grasp of physical systems, specifically multibody dynamics, electromechanical drive physics, energy optimization, and contact physics, to ensure learned policies respect hardware limits and transfer successfully from simulation to the real world
    • We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary, an attractive employee stock ownership plan, and a job in the city of Zurich.

The team’s mission is to accelerate the secure evolution of agentic AI systems at OpenAI. As a Security Engineer on the Agent Security Team, you will be at the forefront of securing OpenAI’s cutting-edge agentic AI systems. Your role will involve designing and implementing robust security frameworks, policies, and controls to safeguard OpenAI’s critical assets and ensure the safe deployment of agentic systems. You will develop comprehensive threat models, partner tightly with our Agent Infrastructure group to fortify the platforms that power OpenAI’s most advanced agentic systems, and lead efforts to enhance safety monitoring pipelines at scale.

We are looking for a versatile engineer who thrives in ambiguity and can make meaningful contributions from day one. You should be prepared to ship solutions quickly while maintaining a high standard of quality and security.

We’re looking for people who can drive innovative solutions that will set the industry standard for agent security. You will need to bring your expertise in securing complex systems and designing robust isolation strategies for emerging AI technologies, all while being mindful of usability. You will communicate effectively across various teams and functions, ensuring your solutions are scalable and robust while working collaboratively in an innovative environment. In this fast-paced setting, you will have the opportunity to solve complex security challenges, influence OpenAI’s security strategy, and play a pivotal role in advancing the safe and responsible deployment of agentic AI systems.

You’ll be responsible for:

  • Architecting security controls for agentic AI – design, implement, and iterate on identity, network, and runtime-level defenses (e.g., sandboxing, policy enforcement) that integrate directly with the Agent Infrastructure stack.

  • Building production-grade security tooling – ship code that hardens safety monitoring pipelines across agent executions at scale.

We’re looking for someone with:

  • Strong software-engineering skills in Python or at least one systems language (Go, Rust, C/C++), plus a track record of shipping and operating secure, high-reliability services.

  • Deep expertise in modern isolation techniques – experience with container security, kernel-level hardening, and other isolation methods.

Staff Product Manager

About Us:

Future is building a personalized guidance system for lifelong health. We help people understand what to do next for their body, goals, and stage of life — then support them in turning those decisions into sustained behavior change. By combining AI, human expertise, personal health data, and accountability, Future helps members improve performance today while building the resilience, capacity, and healthspan they need for decades to come.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

We’re hiring a Staff Product Manager to own the core marketplace experience. We’re rethinking things from the ground up—you won’t be inheriting a roadmap, a backlog, or a set of conventions. You’ll be building the product from the ground up alongside the CPTO.

This role requires someone who thinks in systems. A marketplace is not a single product—it’s an ecosystem. You’ll need to hold the consumer experience, the practitioner experience, the matching logic, the trust and safety layer, the business model, and the growth loops in your head simultaneously, and make smart tradeoffs between them every day.

You will report directly to the CPTO and work alongside a small, senior engineering team. There are no layers between you and the work, and no layers between you and the decisions that shape the company.

WHAT YOU’LL OWN:

Product Strategy & Vision

  • Define the product vision and strategy for the marketplace, grounded in deep user understanding, competitive analysis, and a clear-eyed view of the business model.
  • Own the roadmap end-to-end. Decide what to build, what to kill, and what to sequence—with conviction, not consensus.
  • Develop and maintain a strong point of view on where the wellness and longevity market is heading and how our product should evolve to lead, not follow.
  • TRUE 0→1 product thinking: identify the fastest and cheapest ways to validate core assumptions before committing significant engineering investment.

Marketplace Systems Thinking

  • Design and optimize both sides of the marketplace: the consumer journey (discovery → trust → booking → retention) and the practitioner journey (onboarding → activation → growth → advocacy).
  • Develop frameworks for marketplace health: supply/demand balance, liquidity metrics, matching quality, and network effects.
  • Own the cold-start playbook. Figure out how to bootstrap supply and demand in new verticals and geographies.
  • Think critically about marketplace trust and safety—credential verification, reviews, dispute resolution—as a product surface, not an afterthought.

Execution & Shipping

  • Partner with engineering and design to ship continuously. Write clear, opinionated specs. Run structured discovery. Make scope decisions that keep velocity high.
  • Instrument everything. Define success metrics for every feature. Run experiments. Kill things that aren’t working.
  • Balance competing priorities across consumer, practitioner, and platform workstreams while maintaining a clear view of the overall system.

Business & Growth

  • Own the business logic of the marketplace: pricing models, take rates, subscription tiers, transaction economics.
  • Partner with growth and marketing on acquisition loops, activation funnels, and retention strategies for both sides of the marketplace.
  • Use data to identify the highest-leverage opportunities. Build the instrumentation and dashboards needed to operate with clarity.

AI as a Force Multiplier

  • AI should be part of your daily operating system as a product manager.
    • Research synthesis: distilling user interviews, market data, and competitive intel at speed.
    • Spec and strategy drafting: using AI to accelerate writing, then applying your judgment to sharpen it.
    • Data analysis: querying, visualizing, and interpreting data with AI assistance.
    • Prototyping: rapidly generating UI concepts, user flows, and copy variations.
    • Workflow automation: building personal and team workflows that eliminate toil.
  • Bring a perspective on how AI should be woven into the product itself—personalized recommendations, intelligent matching, automated practitioner tools.
  • Raise the AI fluency bar for the entire team. Share what’s working. Push others to adopt.

WHO YOU ARE:

Experience & Background

  • 7+ years of product management experience, with significant time on marketplace, platform, or multi-sided products.
  • You’ve been a startup founder, a founding PM, or an early employee who built 0→1 products with limited resources. You know what it’s like to ship when there’s no playbook, no established process, and no safety net.
  • You’ve operated at the Senior, Staff, or Principal level—or you’ve functioned at that altitude regardless of your title (common for founders and early-stage operators).
  • Proven ability to ship products that drive measurable business outcomes, not just features.

Domain Passion

You are passionate about wellness, longevity, and preventive health. This isn’t a box you’re checking—you have a personal connection to this space. Maybe you’ve seen the healthcare system fail someone you love. Maybe you’ve gone deep on your own health optimization. Maybe you’ve worked in healthtech and know firsthand how much better it could be.

You stay current on trends in functional medicine, longevity research, consumer health, and the evolving practitioner landscape.

Working Style

  • Exceptional product taste. You see what’s working, what’s not, and what’s missing—and you care about the details.
  • Clear, precise communicator—in writing, in specs, in conversation, and in a room with engineers.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and pace. You don’t need permission to act. You don’t wait for perfect information.
  • Strong analytical chops. You pull your own data, run your own analyses, and let evidence shape your decisions.
  • Low ego, high ownership. You do what needs to be done—whether that’s writing a spec, responding to a user complaint, or fixing a broken onboarding email.

NICE TO HAVE:

  • Direct experience in health, wellness, longevity, or consumer health—and an understanding of the regulatory, trust, and compliance dynamics of the space.
  • Experience building or scaling a marketplace through cold-start, supply/demand balancing, and network effects.
  • Experience building AI-native products (not just AI features bolted onto existing workflows).
  • Technical depth—you can read code, write SQL, or prototype in no-code/low-code tools.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS:

We believe great people should be well paid and meaningfully invested in what they’re building. We hire individuals who raise the bar, and we compensate accordingly — with competitive salary, meaningful equity, and benefits designed to support your life and growth.

  • Base Compensation: $185,000-220,000 The salary range is set based on multiple considerations including business needs, market demands, talent availability, experience, and unique skills and attributes. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future.

  • Equity: Meaningful early-stage equity package with standard 4-year vesting and 1-year cliff.

  • Health Coverage: All employees who meet the eligibility requirements receive Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus life and disability coverage

  • Retirement: 401(k) plan with tax-advantaged savings options

  • Remote-First: Work from anywhere in the continental U.S. We’re a distributed team that values async communication, deep focus time, and intentional in-person gatherings.

Über uns

Lexaru ist ein junges GovTech-/LegalTech-Startup, das Verwaltungsprozesse mit modernen Anwendungen digitalisiert. Unsere Produkte unterstützen Sachbearbeiter:innen im Verwaltungsalltag und tragen zu effizienter Verwaltung und besseren Services für Bürger:innen bei.

Wir entwickeln Fachanwendungen für Kommunal- und Landesverwaltungen und verbinden moderne Produktentwicklung mit KI-gestützten Funktionen in sicheren und nachvollziehbaren Systemen.

Unterstützt werden wir unter anderem durch das Legal Tech Colab der TU München und die Plattform AI Nation.

Was wir dir bieten

Du arbeitest remote-first mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und direktem Austausch mit den Gründern. Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Themen und gestaltest gesellschaftlich relevante Produkte für die öffentliche Verwaltung mit.

Wir unterstützen deine fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung durch praktische Erfahrung, regelmäßiges Feedback und eigene Projekte.

Deine Entwicklung gestalten wir gemeinsam mit dir – durch technische Spezialisierung, wachsende Verantwortung oder Führungsaufgaben.

Deine Aufgaben

Produkt & Entwicklung

Du entwickelst Full-Stack Features und vollwertige interne Tools von der Idee über Architektur, Implementierung und Testing bis zum Rollout. Dazu gehören die Gestaltung einfacher UI/UX und das notwendige Backend Engineering. Du baust schnelle MVPs und entwickelst ausgereifte Funktionen für den produktiven Einsatz.

AI / LLM

Du konzipierst und entwickelst LLM-basierte Funktionen und agentische Workflows und integrierst sie in unsere Produkte. Dabei nutzt du Prompt- und Context Engineering, RAG, Tool Calling und strukturierte Modellausgaben. Du triffst Architektur- und Modellentscheidungen, entwickelst geeignete Evaluierungen und stellst durch Guardrails, Logging und Monitoring einen zuverlässigen Betrieb sicher. Qualität, Laufzeit und Kosten verbesserst du anhand messbarer Ergebnisse.

Architektur & Betrieb

Du wirkst an der Architektur unserer Plattform (Services, Datenmodell, Security) mit, verantwortest gemeinsam mit uns Deployment, CI/CD und Monitoring und achtest auf Security, Performance, Kosten und Stabilität im produktiven Betrieb.

Zusammenarbeit & Produktdenken

Du arbeitest eng mit den Gründern und Kunden zusammen, übersetzt Nutzerbedürfnisse in technische Lösungen und klare User Stories und bringst eigene Ideen ein. Du wirkst an der Priorisierung mit und triffst pragmatische technische Entscheidungen.

Dein Profil

Das bringst du mit

  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Kenntnisse in modernen Backend-Technologien wie Node.js oder Django.

  • Du hast Erfahrung mit relationalen Datenbanken, idealerweise PostgreSQL, einschließlich Schema-Design und Grundlagen der Performanceoptimierung.

  • Du hast praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und im Betrieb LLM-basierter Anwendungen, einschließlich RAG, Tool Calling und strukturierter Modellausgaben. Du kannst KI-Workflows eigenständig entwerfen, integrieren und ihre Qualität durch systematische Evaluation und Fehleranalyse weiterentwickeln.

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert und zuverlässig, kommunizierst klar und bringst Aufgaben zu Ende. Du bringst eigene Ideen ein und übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Themen.

Unser Bewerbungsprozess

Wir sind ein Startup und arbeiten überwiegend remote. Optional kannst du auch vor Ort aus Hamburg, London oder Prag mit uns arbeiten.

Aktuell bauen wir Fenie auf, eine innovative KI-Assistentin speziell für Kosmetikstudios und Unternehmen aus der Beauty-Branche. Fenie hilft die Beauty Branche dabei, ihre Kundenkommunikation zu automatisieren.

Wir suchen einen Head of Sale (m/w/d), der Vertrieb im Blut hat und gemeinsam mit uns wachsen möchte.

Aktuell bieten wir kein fixes Grundgehalt, da wir uns noch in der Growth-Phase befinden. Die Zusammenarbeit erfolgt daher auf selbstständiger Basis, (siehe unten unter „Vergütung“).

Damit bietet gleichzeitig bewusst einige Vorteile für diejenigen, die an unserem Wachstum partizipieren möchten.

Du kannst ein eigenes Vertriebsteam aufbauen und zusätzlich an dessen Provisionen mitverdienen. Dazu kommen deine eigene Provision sowie wiederkehrende Provisionen, die deutlich höher ausfallen als bei vergleichbaren Jobangeboten.

Bei unserem zweiten Startup verdienen unsere Kollegen, die Head of Sales Mitarbeiter aktuell zwischen 6.000 und 7.000 € im Monat, ein realistischer Einblick dafür, was nach einer kurzen Zeit möglich ist.

Was du mitbringen solltest

  • Mindestens 1 Jahr Erfahrung im Vertrieb

  • Du hast bereits nachweislich Erfahrung darin, potenzielle Kunden aktiv anzusprechen und für ein Produkt oder eine Dienstleistung zu gewinnen

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Einwandbehandlung und Follow-ups

  • Absolut Zuverlässigkeit

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du kontaktierst Kosmetik, Beauty- und ähnliche Studios telefonisch durch Cold Calling. Eine freundliche und meist lockere Zielgruppe.

  • Du stellst Fenie potenziellen Kunden vor

  • Du erklärst einfach und verständlich, welchen Mehrwert KI im Alltag bietet

  • Du baust auf Wunsch ein Team auf uns leitest dies

  • Du arbeitest neue Vertriebsmitarbeiter ein

Was dich bei Fenie erwartet

  • Ein schnell wachsendes AI-Startup

  • 100 % Remote, innerhalb Europa

  • Die Möglichkeit, das gesamtes Vertriebsteam für den deutschen Markt zu leiten

  • Flexible Zeiteinteilung innerhalb unserer Vertriebszeiten zwischen 9 und 17 Uhr

  • Hohes Provisionsmodell durch hohe Margen im Softwaregeschäft

Dann werde Teil unseres M/Teams und arbeite gemeinsam mit uns an innovativen KI-Lösungen. Bei uns bekommst du die Möglichkeit, moderne Technologien auszuprobieren, eigene Ideen einzubringen und Schritt für Schritt Verantwortung für eigene Themen zu übernehmen.

  • AI Solution Architecture: Du unterstützt uns bei der Konzeption von KI-Lösungen und technischen Architekturen und lernst, wie KI sinnvoll in bestehende Systeme und Prozesse integriert werden kann.

  • Produktmanagement & Projektarbeit: Du unterstützt bei der Planung und Weiterentwicklung unserer KI-Produkte und übernimmst mit wachsender Erfahrung eigene Aufgaben und Themen.

  • Consulting & Kundenprojekte: Du hilfst dabei, Kundenanforderungen zu verstehen und daraus passende Lösungsideen zu entwickeln. Perspektivisch kannst du auch bei Workshops und Präsentationen dabei sein und eigene Themen vorstellen.

Uns ist nicht wichtig, dass du schon alles kannst. Viel wichtiger ist uns, dass du Lust hast, dich intensiv mit neuen Technologien auseinanderzusetzen und gemeinsam mit uns zu lernen.

  • Du studierst in einem technischen oder IT-nahen Studiengang, zum Beispiel Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Science, KI oder etwas Vergleichbarem.

  • Du hattest bereits erste Berührungspunkte mit Softwareentwicklung, IT-Systemen oder KI-Anwendungen.

Vielleicht hast du schon erste Erfahrungen mit Python, JavaScript oder TypeScript, Git oder APIs gesammelt. Auch Berührungspunkte mit KI-Entwicklungstools wie Cursor oder Claude Code sowie Themen wie RAG oder KI-Agentensysteme sind willkommen.

jobs.title: (Senior) GEO Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
(Senior) GEO Manager (m/w/d)

At idealo, we've built a strong SEO foundation. Now, we're looking to take the next step. As AI-powered search experiences such as ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, and Gemini increasingly influence how people research products and make purchasing decisions, we want to ensure idealo becomes a trusted and frequently cited source within these new shopping journeys.

As our GEO Manager, you'll take ownership of developing Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) as an additional growth discipline alongside our established SEO activities. Combining your technical SEO expertise with hands-on experience in AI search optimization, you'll develop our GEO strategy, establish meaningful visibility monitoring, and drive experimentation to understand what makes content and data discoverable, relevant, and citable by generative AI systems.

You'll work closely with our SEO team and collaborate across Product, Engineering, Content, Brand, and Communications to turn emerging opportunities into scalable solutions.

About your new role

  • GEO Strategy & Development: You develop and drive idealo's GEO strategy and experimentation roadmap, building on our existing SEO foundation. You identify opportunities across generative search platforms and AI-assisted shopping journeys, translating emerging developments into actionable initiatives aligned with our broader SEO and business objectives.

  • AI Visibility & Performance Monitoring: You establish and continuously improve a GEO monitoring framework covering platforms such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews. You define relevant KPIs, including mention and citation rates, share of voice, sentiment, and positioning within AI-generated answers, and develop dashboards that make performance and progress transparent to different stakeholders.

  • Technical GEO Optimization: You leverage your technical SEO expertise to improve how generative AI systems discover, interpret, and reference idealo's content. This includes optimizing structured data (Schema.org), semantic relationships, product and offer information, and identifying technical opportunities to strengthen our visibility and accessibility across AI-powered search experiences.

  • Experimentation & Competitive Analysis: You design, implement, and evaluate GEO experiments, analyze idealo's visibility against relevant competitors, and translate findings into concrete optimization measures. You continuously assess emerging GEO tools, methodologies, and platform capabilities to improve our approach.

  • AI Shopping & Content Optimization: You explore how idealo's product, pricing, and offer data can become a valuable information source for AI agents and agentic commerce. Together with Content Marketing, you assess existing content and develop answer-focused, well-structured formats that strengthen relevance, authority, and citation potential.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing: You connect technical SEO and GEO requirements with Product and Engineering initiatives and collaborate with Brand and Communications/PR on authority-building and digital PR opportunities. You actively share your expertise, communicate findings to stakeholders, and contribute insights from the evolving AI search landscape to idealo's long-term SEO strategy.


Skills & Requirements

  • 3-5 years of hands-on SEO experience, with a clear focus on technical SEO. 

  • Strong technical SEO fundamentals: site architecture, crawlability, indexing, Core Web Vitals, JavaScript SEO, and experience running full technical audits. 

  • Practical understanding of how generative search systems retrieve, summarize, and cite content.

  • Experience with data analysis, KPI definition, and translating data into recommendations. 

  • Hands-on proficiency with core SEO tools (Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs or Semrush, Screaming Frog or similar crawler). 

  • Familiarity with structured data, semantic models, and entity-based SEO. 

  • Experience with GEO/AI visibility tools (e.g., Profound, AirOps, Rankscale, Peec AI, Otterly). 

  • Strong AI mindset: willing to test new GEO tools and methods and share learnings with the team. 

  • Excellent communication skills, able to present technical findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders across Engineering, Product, Content, Brand, and Communications/PR. 

  • Experience in e-commerce, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, SQL or reporting automation with tools such as n8n are a plus.

At idealo you can expect

  • You want to further your education? We take your personal development goals seriously and, in addition to our idealo Learning Hub, eLearning offerings (e.g., Udemy), coaching & mediation, we also offer you the opportunity to benefit individually from additional learning and development budget.

  • And what about the office? Our office in the heart of Berlin offers free organic breakfast, excellent free lunch (vegan and vegetarian), as well as free coffee, lemonades and after-work beer, in addition to the "standard foosball". It also has a fabulous rooftop terrace with view of the whole of berlin where you can network with colleagues from our group of companies.

  • In need of additional support in any areas of your life? We offer free counseling and support in all areas of life (professional, private, family, health, etc.) in cooperation with the pme-Familienservice.

  • You want full flexibility on your way to work and beyond? No problem with a job bike or Deutschlandticket - and it's environmentally friendly, too!

  • Want to keep yourself fit? We offer many different fitness and sports options, such as an Urban Sports or Gympass membership, to suit your personal needs.

  • And what else is there? Of course, success must be celebrated! In addition to team events, you can also expect big company events and other moments of organized connection with others in the company and your team throughout the year!

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels.

This role will help shape how customers feel when they use Trainline, strengthening our position in the UK market while driving innovation across a number of exciting pricing and value experiences. You’ll partner with fellow Product Designers in the Value space as part of a larger Product and Design community, sharing ideas, craft and learning as you go.

  • From early discovery through to experimentation and delivery, use insight, craft and data to continuously improve outcomes, playing a key role in shaping how customers experience Trainline when it matters most

  • Collaborate with other Product Designers in the Value space and the wider Product and Design community, helping keep experiences coherent and raising the quality bar together

  • Share clear, compelling stories that bring colleagues together around complex problems and help shape priorities

  • Explore how AI-enabled tools and workflows can improve the speed and effectiveness of how we design

We’d love to hear from you if you have... 🔍

  • Significant experience leading Product Design or UX within complex, consumer-facing digital products

  • Experience designing journey-based, real-time or service-oriented experiences, particularly where clarity and trust are critical

  • Strong hands-on design skills, including high proficiency in Figma and a genuine passion for craft and quality

  • A history of using research, insight and data-informed experimentation to improve outcomes

  • Confidence designing across channels, ideally with a focus on mobile apps and strong interaction and information design skills

  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to align partners around complex problems

Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits. 

We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one! 

We're operating a hybrid model and ask that Trainliners work from the office a minimum of 60% of their time over a 12-week period. We also have a 28-day Work from Abroad policy.

Our values represent the things that matter most to us and what we live and breathe everyday, in everything we do:

  • ✔️ Own It - We focus on every customer, partner and journey

We know that having a diverse team makes us better and helps us succeed. And we mean all forms of diversity - gender, ethnicity, sexuality, disability, nationality and diversity of thought. That's why we're committed to creating inclusive places to work, where everyone belongs and differences are valued and celebrated.

DevOps / Infra Lead
jobs.description:
DevOps / Infra Lead

🌍 Our Vision & Mission

At Payflows, we give finance teams the tools to reclaim their time and energy. Our platform weaves together banking connectivity, payments, AI, and procurement so they can ditch the busywork and focus on what really moves the needle.

🤝 Why Join Us?

We’re a small, mighty team who’ve earned our stripes at Airbnb, Luko, BNP Paribas, and Facebook. It’s not always easy—things move fast, and we expect a lot—but if you’re hungry for impact, you’ll find it here.

🛠️ We’re builders at heart. We move fast, think deeply, ship often — and we’re always hungry to learn more. You'll collaborate closely with product and tech to craft elegant backend systems that scale as fast as we do.

🚀 What You’ll Do

You'll own the infrastructure for a product that real finance teams rely on every day.

For us, infrastructure is not just about uptime; it's about reliability, security, and trust - especially when money and automation are involved. The platform has to be boring in the best possible way: predictable, observable, and safe to deploy to.

  • In a typical week, you might:

    • Evolve our infrastructure-as-code to add a service, a queue, or a whole new environment.

    • Improve our CI/CD pipelines so engineers ship safely and fast, dozens of times a day.

    • Investigate a production issue: a latency spike, a failing deploy, a database under load.

    • Strengthen observability with dashboards, alerts, and traces, so we catch problems before customers do.

    • Harden our security, secrets management, and access controls.

    • Tune cost and performance across our AWS footprint.

Your time will be split between building new platform capabilities and making what already exists more reliable. Both matter.

You'll help shape the foundation that everything else stands on: the pipelines, environments, and guardrails that let engineers and our AI agents act safely in production.

You'll work closely with backend, frontend, and the AI team. We expect you to take ownership of the platform and make it more reliable over time, not wait for tickets.

💻 Our current tech reality

Our stack evolves based on our challenges, but we care more about good design than trendy tools

We're an AWS shop, and we lean on managed services and infrastructure-as-code so the system is reproducible and easy to reason with. A growing part of our world is making the backend a set of reliable, deterministic tools that AI agents can call, which raises the bar on reliability even further.

  • Cloud: AWS

  • Infra-as-code: Pulumi (Python)

  • Compute: ECS + Lambda, serverless when it makes sense

  • Data: PostgreSQL on RDS/Aurora

  • CI/CD: GitLab CI

  • Orchestration: Airflow (MWAA)

  • Observability: Grafana Cloud, CloudWatch, Sentry

  • Auth & identity: Cognito, IAM

  • Edge & frontend: API Gateway, ALB, AWS Amplify for the web app

Some of this is clean, version-controlled, and reproducible. Other parts grew fast and live a little too much in people’s heads instead of in code. Closing that gap is a big part of why this role exists.

Over the next year, we'll focus on:

  • Making every environment reproducible from code

  • Better observability and alerting, fewer surprises

  • Tightening the security and compliance posture that comes with handling enterprise finance data

  • Faster, safer deploys

  • Keeping AWS costs sane as we scale


🧑‍💻 What we’re looking for

  • 5+ years of experience with Python or any other OOP language

  • Backend expertise: APIs, microservices, architecture best practices

  • Databases & SQL: Data modeling, query optimization

  • Git lover: Comfortable with version control and code reviews

  • Pragmatic engineering mindset: Build, test, refine, simplify—smart shortcuts when time is tight

🧩 Bonus points if you’ve worked on:

  • B2B SaaS or finance/ERP tools

  • BaaS APIs or payment infra

  • Serverless, AWS, event-driven architecture exposure

✨ Who's going to thrive with us

You'll probably feel comfortable here if:

  • You think in systems and instinctively automate yourself out of repetitive work.

  • You treat infrastructure as code, not as pets.

  • You stay calm during incidents and are genuinely good at root-causing.

  • You care about security, because you're handling other people's money.

  • You are autonomous and take ownership of what you ship.

  • You take initiative and lead by example.

  • You're pragmatic about trade-offs.

  • You communicate with kindness and clarity.

You don't need to know everything about AI - but you must be curious about it and excited to build the reliable foundation that agents run on 🤖

🧩 What you'll get from this role

  • Real ownership over the platform the whole company runs on.

  • Direct impact on reliability, security, and how fast every engineer can ship.

  • A mix of platform building, system design, and reliability work.

  • Exposure to real scaling and production challenges.

  • The chance to help build the foundation of an agent-driven product from the inside.

jobs.title: Medior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Medior Software Engineer

Ben jij een Software Engineer die graag zelfstandig bouwt aan slimme, schaalbare software? Wil je technische uitdagingen oplossen, meedenken over nieuwe functionaliteiten en jezelf blijven ontwikkelen binnen een ervaren productteam? Dan is deze functie bij BAS World iets voor jou!

Bij BAS World ontwikkelen we digitale producten waarmee klanten wereldwijd trucks, trailers, machines en onderdelen kunnen kopen en verkopen. Onze software ondersteunt internationale handelsprocessen en wordt dagelijks gebruikt door klanten en collega's over de hele wereld.

Als Medior Software Engineer werk je binnen een van onze productteams aan betrouwbare en schaalbare software. Je pakt zelfstandig technische vraagstukken op, denkt mee over de beste oplossingen en bent betrokken bij het volledige ontwikkelproces: van het begrijpen van het probleem tot het bouwen, testen en onderhouden van de oplossing.

Je werkt nauw samen met andere Engineers, Product Owners en collega's vanuit de business. Daarbij krijg je de ruimte om technische keuzes te maken, nieuwe ideeën aan te dragen en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Medior Software Engineer werk je aan digitale producten die direct bijdragen aan de groei van BAS World. Je schrijft niet alleen code, maar denkt ook actief mee over hoe we onze software en processen kunnen verbeteren.

Je werkt binnen een van onze vijf productpijlers: Operations, Parts & Tyres, Buyer, Seller of Platform Engineering. Samen met jouw team ontwikkel je oplossingen die waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten en collega's.

Jouw werkzaamheden:

  • Je ontwerpt, ontwikkelt en onderhoudt schaalbare en betrouwbare software;

  • Je pakt zelfstandig nieuwe functionaliteiten en technische vraagstukken op, van analyse tot implementatie en beheer;

  • Je werkt samen met Product Owners, Engineers en collega's vanuit de business om klantbehoeften te vertalen naar technische oplossingen;

  • Je denkt mee tijdens de discoveryfase, onderzoekt verschillende oplossingsrichtingen en test ideeën waar nodig met prototypes;

  • Je schrijft leesbare, testbare en onderhoudbare code en draagt bij aan de kwaliteit, beveiliging en betrouwbaarheid van onze software;

  • Je voert code reviews uit, werkt samen via pair programming en deelt actief kennis met collega's;

  • Je onderzoekt en verhelpt incidenten en denkt mee over structurele oplossingen;

  • Je signaleert technische verbeterkansen en experimenteert met nieuwe technologieën en moderne engineeringtools.

Je krijgt de vrijheid om zelfstandig aan oplossingen te werken, maar staat er nooit alleen voor. Je leert van ervaren collega's, deelt jouw eigen kennis en werkt samen aan producten die dagelijks wereldwijd worden gebruikt.

Wat maakt deze functie zo interessant?

Bij BAS World werk je niet alleen aan technische oplossingen, maar denk je ook mee over de ontwikkeling van onze digitale producten. Je krijgt de ruimte om kritische vragen te stellen, ideeën te testen en invloed uit te oefenen op technische keuzes.

Je werkt in een productgedreven organisatie waar we continu zoeken naar manieren om onze software slimmer, sneller en betrouwbaarder te maken.

Of je nu nieuwe functionaliteiten ontwikkelt, bestaande systemen verbetert of experimenteert met AI en cloud-native technologie: je krijgt volop mogelijkheden om jezelf technisch verder te ontwikkelen en steeds meer verantwoordelijkheid te nemen.

Wij bieden jou

  • Een aantrekkelijk salaris dat past bij jouw kennis en ervaring;

  • 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om extra dagen bij te kopen;

  • Een goede pensioenregeling;

  • Veel zelfstandigheid en verantwoordelijkheid binnen een ervaren productteam;

  • De mogelijkheid om te werken aan digitale producten die wereldwijd worden gebruikt;

  • Volop ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen via interne en externe opleidingen;

  • De vrijheid om te experimenteren met AI, cloud-native technologie en moderne engineeringtools;

  • Directe samenwerking met ervaren Engineers, Product Owners en andere technische specialisten;

  • De keuze tussen een MacBook of Windows-laptop;

  • Een informele, internationale werkomgeving met korte lijnen en ruimte voor eigen initiatief.


Jouw specificaties

We zoeken een Software Engineer die zelfstandig kan werken, graag technische uitdagingen aangaat en verder kijkt dan alleen het schrijven van code.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Je hebt ervaring als Software Engineer en kunt zelfstandig nieuwe functionaliteiten en technische oplossingen ontwikkelen;

  • Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor je werk, van het ontwerp tot een betrouwbare werking in productie;

  • Je schrijft leesbare, testbare en onderhoudbare code;

  • Je denkt mee over technische keuzes en weet jouw ideeën en oplossingen duidelijk uit te leggen;

  • Je werkt graag samen met collega's, staat open voor feedback en deelt actief jouw kennis;

  • Je bent nieuwsgierig naar nieuwe technologieën en denkt graag mee over verbeteringen;

  • Je werkt minimaal vier dagen per week vanuit ons kantoor in Veghel, zodat je nauw kunt samenwerken met jouw team.

Daarnaast heb je ervaring met meerdere van de volgende technologieën en werkwijzen:

  • PHP, Laravel en/of andere moderne frontend- en backendtechnologieën;

  • Cloud-native softwareontwikkeling, bij voorkeur binnen AWS;

  • API's, data-uitwisseling en gedistribueerde systemen;

  • CI/CD, geautomatiseerd testen en databases;

  • Softwarearchitectuur, observability, security en schaalbaarheid.

Je hoeft niet overal expert in te zijn. We vinden het vooral belangrijk dat je een goede technische basis hebt, zelfstandig kunt werken en gemotiveerd bent om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen.

Interesse?

Wil jij bouwen aan digitale producten die wereldwijd worden gebruikt en jezelf verder ontwikkelen als Software Engineer? Solliciteer dan direct en ontdek jouw mogelijkheden bij BAS World!

Wij zijn BAS!

BAS is een internationaal familiebedrijf dat sinds 1962 actief is in de automotive-sector. Met meer dan 1.000 collega's zijn we wereldwijd actief in de handel en het onderhoud van vrachtwagens, trekkers, trailers, bouwmachines, bedrijfswagens en landbouwmachines.

Via ons platform basworld.com brengen we kopers en verkopers van over de hele wereld samen. Onze ambitie is om uit te groeien tot de toonaangevende wereldwijde marktplaats voor gebruikte commerciële voertuigen en machines.

Binnen BAS World werken onze Product- en Tech-teams dagelijks aan de ontwikkeling en verbetering van onze digitale producten. We werken productgedreven en volgens agile principes, waarbij we nieuwe ideeën onderzoeken, testen en ontwikkelen om zo snel mogelijk waarde toe te voegen voor onze gebruikers.

Bij BAS houden we van aanpakken, samenwerken en kansen benutten. Brabantse nuchterheid, passie, teamwork en ondernemerschap vormen de basis van onze organisatie. Samen blijven we groeien en onze digitale dienstverlening verbeteren!

jobs.title: Meewerk Stage Continuous Improvement (Power BI & Power Automate)
jobs.description:
Meewerk Stage Continuous Improvement (Power BI & Power Automate)

Ben jij analytisch sterk en wil je impact maken binnen een internationale organisatie? Dan moeten we jou hebben!

Jouw rol
Bij Heras krijg je de kans om als stagiair bij te dragen aan het Nimble-programma: een strategisch verbeterprogramma gericht op het vereenvoudigen en automatiseren van bedrijfsprocessen. Als stagiair werk je aan het verbeteren van processen binnen domeinen zoals sales, projecten in nieuwbouw en finance. Je analyseert hoe processen vandaag werken en vertaalt dit naar slimme oplossingen met behulp van Power BI en Power Automate. Je levert concrete procesverbeteringen, procesbeschrijvingen, automatiseringen en Power BI dashboards voor operationele en financiële sturing aan alsmede werkende Power Automate flows. Tenslotte lever je een meetbare bijdrage aan efficiëntie (bijv. tijdbesparing of minder fouten).

Jouw werkzaamheden

  • In kaart brengen van huidige processen en knelpunten.

  • Automatiseren van handmatige processen met Power Automate.

  • Ontwikkelen van dashboards en rapportages in Power BI (zonder daadwerkelijk programmeren).

  • Verbeteren van datakwaliteit en inzicht in KPI’s.

  • Samenwerken met business teams en IT-specialisten.

Benieuwd naar de ervaringen van een stagiair bij Heras? De eerste indruk: dynamisch in plaats van stoffig - Heras Nederland

Wie zijn wij?
Heras is een vooraanstaand Europese totaalleverancier van permanente perimeter protection oplossingen. Wij opereren vanuit meer dan 24 landen en hebben meer dan 1100 hoogopgeleide experts in dienst. Opgericht in 1952, vervult en overtreft Heras de beveiligingsbehoeften van klanten in heel Europa. Het is dankzij deze staat van dienst, samen met het blijvend groeiende vakmanschap van onze medewerkers, dat wij ons experts in perimeter protection kunnen noemen. 

Onze cultuur, werksfeer & waarden
Wij hebben binnen Heras een informele, open en toegankelijke cultuur. We zijn trots op ons werk, producten en dienstverlening. We hebben een no-nonsense mentaliteit, tonen ondernemerschap, zijn energiek en werken allemaal gedisciplineerd volgens de drie kernwaarden; betrokkenheid, betrouwbaarheid en deskundigheid. Heras is gewaardeerd op een Ecovadis Zilveren Ster en dat plaatst ons bij de duurzaamste 15% bedrijven van Nederland. Onze doelstelling is streven naar Goud in de komende jaren en volledig CO2 neutraal zijn in 2050. Wil je hier meer over weten? https://www.heras.nl/over-heras/kwaliteit-en-veiligheid/


Jouw profiel

  • Je volgt een HBO- of WO-opleiding (bijv. Bedrijfskunde, Technische Bedrijfskunde, IT, Data of Finance)

  • Je zoekt een 3e of 4e jaars stage waarbij de nadruk ligt op meewerken of bouwen van dashboarding

  • Je hebt interesse in procesverbetering en data

  • Je hebt basiskennis van of affiniteit met Power BI en/of Power Automate

  • Je bent analytisch, proactief en communicatief sterk

  • Onze voorkeur gaat uit naar een kandidaat die de Nederlandse taal goed beheerst

  • Hoewel het niet zelf programmeren beterft vindt je het wel leuk om zelf oplossingen te verzinnen en te testen

Wat bieden wij jou?
Bij Heras bieden wij jou een meewerkstage binnen een zeer dynamische omgeving waarbij elke dag anders is met veel variatie en afwisseling. Je draagt je steentje bij aan een veilige omgeving en helpt om onze samenleving te beschermen. Tenslotte zijn er volop mogelijkheden om jezelf te ontwikkelen en door te groeien. Wij bieden het volgende:

  • Stagevergoeding van €500,- bruto o.b.v. fulltime

  • 2 verlofdagen per maand

  • Flexibiliteit en vrijheid

  • Reiskostenvergoeding van 0,23ct per kilometer tussen 5- en 60km enkele reis
