jobs.title: Project Engineer
jobs.description:
Project Engineer

Project Engineer

Wil jij technische projecten van begin tot eind begeleiden? Krijg jij energie van het organiseren van complexe technische projecten en vind je het leuk om verschillende partijen met elkaar te verbinden? En wil je werken aan innovatieve oplossingen op het gebied van energieopslag en vermogenselektronica? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!

Wat ga je doen?

Als Project Engineer begeleid je projecten binnen AEP Hybrid Power vanaf de technische overdracht na opdracht tot en met de oplevering. Jij bent de verbindende schakel tussen de klant, engineering, productiepartners, leveranciers en service.

Je zorgt ervoor dat technische eisen, planning, budget, documentatie en testen goed op elkaar aansluiten. Je houdt overzicht, signaleert mogelijke problemen op tijd en zorgt ervoor dat acties en afspraken worden opgevolgd.

Je taken omvatten onder andere:

• Overnemen en structureren van projecten na opdracht, inclusief scope, specificaties, planning, budget en risico’s
• Vertalen van klant- en contracteisen naar duidelijke technische specificaties en werkpakketten
• Opstellen en bewaken van projectplanningen, actielijsten, mijlpalen en technische opleverpunten
• Coördineren van engineering, inkoop, productie, testen en documentatie met interne en externe partners
• Afstemmen van verschillende technische interfaces, zoals converters, ultracapacitorsystemen, besturingen, koeling en beveiligingen
• Organiseren en begeleiden van technische project overleggen en design reviews met klanten en leveranciers
• Bewaken van wijzigingen, technische risico’s, kosten en gevolgen voor de planning
• Voorbereiden en begeleiden van functionele tests, FAT, SAT en commissioning
• Zorgen voor complete projectdocumentatie, zoals tekeningen, datasheets, handleidingen, testprotocollen en opleverdossiers
• Fungeren als technisch aanspreekpunt voor klanten en partners tijdens de uitvoering van het project
• Evalueren van afgeronde projecten en verbeteringen aandragen voor onze producten en processen

Kortom: jij zorgt ervoor dat een technisch project van opdracht tot oplevering goed georganiseerd en beheerst verloopt.

Wie zijn wij?

Binnen AEP zijn we actief in verschillende technische markten, waaronder hybride energie. Met AEP Hybrid Power richten we ons op innovatieve oplossingen op het gebied van energieopslag en vermogenselektronica.

In jouw rol werk je aan projecten waarin verschillende technische disciplines samenkomen. Denk aan converters, ultracapacitors, besturingstechniek, elektrische installaties en energieopslag.

Je werkt nauw samen met collega's van engineering, productie, sales en service, maar hebt ook regelmatig contact met klanten, leveranciers en productiepartners. Hierdoor ben je betrokken bij het volledige traject van een project en zie je jouw werk uiteindelijk letterlijk in de praktijk terug.

Wat vragen we jou?

• Een afgeronde hbo-opleiding in Elektrotechniek, Energietechniek, Mechatronica, of vergelijkbaar

• Kennis van vermogenselektronica, elektrische installaties, DC-systemen, AC-netten en/of energieopslag is een sterke pré
• Ervaring met technisch projectmanagement, engineeringprojecten of commissioning is gewenst
• Enkele jaren relevante werkervaring is mooi meegenomen. Ben je een sterke starter met passende stages of projecten? Ook dan komen we graag met je in gesprek
• Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk. Duits is een pré
• Je vindt het leuk om incidenteel klanten en productiepartners in binnen- en buitenland te bezoeken
• Je bent gestructureerd, planmatig en houdt goed overzicht
• Je bent technisch analytisch en weet complexe vraagstukken te vertalen naar duidelijke acties
• Je bent communicatief sterk en weet verschillende partijen op een prettige manier met elkaar te verbinden
• Je bent proactief, oplossingsgericht en wacht niet af wanneer er actie nodig is

Wat kan jij van ons verwachten?

Binnen AEP kom je terecht in een technische en groeiende organisatie waar je veel ruimte krijgt voor eigen inbreng. Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om mee te werken aan innovatieve projecten binnen de energietechniek en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen.

Verder kan je het volgende van ons verwachten:

• Een salaris tussen €3000 - €5000, o.b.v. een fulltime dienstverband, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring

• Een veelzijdige technische functie met veel ruimte voor eigen inbreng

• Werken aan innovatieve oplossingen binnen de energietechniek

• Ruimte voor persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling

• Een functie waarin je zowel op kantoor, in onze testomgeving als bij klanten werkt

• Laptop en telefoon van de zaak

• 25 vakantiedagen, 8% vakantiegeld en een goede pensioenregeling

• Een verzorgde lunch wanneer je op kantoor bent

• Een gezellig en technisch team met korte communicatielijnen

Interesse?

Wil je meer weten na het lezen van deze vacature of ben je enthousiast geworden? Dan zien wij je sollicitatie graag tegemoet!

jobs.title: Enterprise Sales Executive, Consumer Products and Services - US-Based
jobs.description:
Enterprise Sales Executive, Consumer Products and Services - US-Based

About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary:

As an Enterprise Sales Executive on Toptal’s Consumer Products & Services (CP&S) team, your mission is to win new enterprise clients and secure new business bookings. You will build your own pipeline, open doors into organizations where Toptal does not currently do business, develop opportunities, and close new commercial deals. This is a pure hunter role for accomplished sales professionals who thrive on creating opportunities, competing for business, and turning new relationships into meaningful revenue.

You will lead the end-to-end new-client acquisition process, from identifying target accounts and engaging decision-makers to shaping solutions, negotiating commercial terms, and securing the first revenue booking. Working closely with internal subject matter experts and key stakeholders, you will develop compelling solutions, navigate complex buying processes, and close new business. You will partner with Client Partners to ensure a seamless transition following the initial booking, allowing you to remain focused on what you do best: opening new doors and winning new clients.

We are looking for exceptional business developers who combine deep Consumer Products & Services industry expertise, executive credibility, and consultative selling skills with the urgency, persistence, and competitive drive of a true hunter. You understand the business and technology challenges facing consumer products, retail, and services organizations, and know how to translate those challenges into compelling commercial opportunities. You leverage your industry knowledge and relationships to navigate complex enterprise sales cycles, engage senior decision-makers, and create demand where none exists. You take ownership of your results, thrive on winning new clients, and do not wait for opportunities to come to you.

Consumer products and retail organizations are under pressure to move faster than their current operating models allow. AI has shifted from experimentation to execution, and companies across this sector are actively rethinking how work gets done across brand and marketing, commercial operations, supply chain, and digital commerce. Toptal’s CP&S team already partners with some of the world’s largest consumer products organizations to help address these challenges. You will bring together our capabilities across technology, AI, marketing, management consulting, managed services, and specialized talent to help new clients accelerate strategic initiatives and achieve measurable business outcomes.

Success in this role is measured by new enterprise logos acquired and new business booked. This is a high-accountability, high-reward opportunity for individuals who want direct ownership of their commercial results and the opportunity to build a substantial business through their own efforts.

This is a remote position with a strong expectation of regular, in-person client engagement and field activity. Candidates based on the US East Coast, or within commutable distance of a major East Coast metropolitan area, are strongly preferred. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Applicants must be authorized to work in the US at the time of hire. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

You will be responsible for building and converting a pipeline of net-new enterprise clients across Consumer Products & Services. You will identify high-potential organizations, develop access to decision-makers, uncover business challenges, and create opportunities for Toptal to compete and win. You will lead the sales process from initial engagement through securing the first revenue booking, working closely with internal subject matter experts and key stakeholders to shape compelling solutions, navigate complex buying processes, and close new business.

Your focus is exclusively on acquiring new clients. You will not inherit an existing book of business or carry ongoing account management and expansion responsibilities. Following the initial revenue booking, new clients transition to Client Partners and the appropriate delivery teams.

  • Hunt and win new enterprise clients. Own new-logo acquisition and secured bookings across consumer products, retail, and services organizations, with direct accountability for identifying, developing, and closing new business.
  • Build your own pipeline. Proactively identify target accounts, develop prospecting strategies, leverage your CP&S industry network, and create new opportunities through consistent, disciplined outreach. Partner with SDRs to accelerate prospecting without depending on them to generate your pipeline.
  • Open doors at the executive level. Establish relationships with senior business and technology leaders, economic buyers, and key decision-makers within organizations where Toptal does not have an established commercial relationship.
  • Create demand and shape opportunities. Engage prospective clients around their strategic priorities, identify business problems worth solving, and position Toptal’s capabilities in ways that create compelling reasons to act. Bring informed perspectives on the commercial, operational, and technology challenges shaping the consumer products and retail industries.
  • Lead and close complex sales pursuits. Own the full sales cycle, including qualification, discovery, stakeholder alignment, solution positioning, proposal development, negotiation, procurement, contracting, and securing the initial revenue booking.
  • Compete and win. Develop winning strategies to displace incumbent providers, differentiate Toptal from traditional consulting and technology services firms, and navigate competitive enterprise buying processes.
  • Sell the full breadth of Toptal’s capabilities. Work with internal subject matter experts and key stakeholders to bring together specialized talent, technology, AI, marketing, consulting, and managed services solutions addressing client challenges across digital commerce, supply chain, customer experience, commercial operations, and business transformation.
  • Maintain a high-quality, self-generated pipeline. Build sufficient qualified pipeline to consistently deliver new-logo and bookings targets. Maintain accurate opportunity intelligence, forecasting, and disciplined sales execution.
  • Take ownership of commercial outcomes. Drive opportunities forward with urgency, navigate obstacles, negotiate effectively, and remain personally accountable for securing booked revenue.
  • Execute clean client transitions. Ensure commercial commitments, initial booking details, and relevant client context are transferred to Client Partners and delivery teams, allowing you to return your focus to new-client acquisition.
  • Build a strong market presence. Spend meaningful time in front of prospective clients, developing relationships through executive networking, CP&S industry events, referrals, and direct engagement.

We are seeking people who enjoy the hunt as much as the win. You should be energized by breaking into new accounts, creating opportunities from scratch, and securing business that would not exist without your efforts.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Onboard with Toptal, learning our business model, value proposition, and capabilities.
  • Familiarize yourself with our sales methodologies, prospecting tools, and commercial processes.
  • Understand our CP&S industry strategy, target client profiles, priority segments, and markets.
  • Meet the Industry, Sales Development, and internal subject matter experts and stakeholders who will support your success.
  • Become familiar with our contracting, legal, and commercial processes.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Develop a targeted new-logo acquisition plan with your CP&S Industry GM, identifying priority accounts, executive buyers, and initial pursuit strategies.
  • Begin actively prospecting into new consumer products, retail, and services accounts, leveraging your existing industry relationships while building new ones.
  • Establish a consistent cadence of outbound activity, executive outreach, and new-business development.
  • Coordinate with SDRs to expand target-account coverage and accelerate opportunity creation.
  • Begin discovery conversations with prospective clients and build your initial qualified pipeline.
  • Develop a strong understanding of how to position Toptal’s technology, AI, marketing, consulting, managed services, and talent capabilities against the priorities and challenges facing CP&S organizations.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Establish a measurable pipeline of qualified net-new CP&S enterprise opportunities, including a meaningful contribution from your own prospecting and relationship development.
  • Build relationships with economic buyers and senior decision-makers across priority target accounts.
  • Lead active sales pursuits, working with internal subject matter experts to develop differentiated solutions and competitive proposals tailored to consumer products, retail, and services organizations.
  • Demonstrate the ability to qualify, advance, and close opportunities through complex enterprise buying processes.
  • Secure initial new-logo wins and revenue bookings, building momentum toward your commercial targets.
  • Maintain an accurate, well-managed pipeline with clear next steps, close strategies, and forecasts.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Establish a track record of acquiring new enterprise CP&S clients and securing initial revenue bookings.
  • Build and sustain a healthy pipeline of new-logo opportunities sufficient to support continued bookings performance.
  • Demonstrate consistent self-sourced opportunity creation alongside effective use of SDR and cross-functional support.
  • Successfully navigate competitive pursuits, executive negotiations, procurement, and contracting to close business.
  • Demonstrate the ability to move from one successful acquisition to the next, maintaining momentum without becoming involved in ongoing account management.
  • Show measurable progress against defined new-logo and bookings targets.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Consistently deliver against new-logo acquisition and bookings expectations.
  • Establish a repeatable, high-performing approach to originating and closing new enterprise business across Consumer Products & Services.
  • Maintain a strong pipeline of qualified new-logo opportunities through direct prospecting, executive relationships, industry referrals, and coordinated business development.
  • Build a reputation as a highly effective hunter and closer who can create opportunities, navigate complex enterprise buying environments, and win competitive deals.
  • Develop a network of executive relationships and market connections across CP&S that supports continued new-client acquisition.
  • Be recognized for your industry knowledge, commercial judgment, competitive drive, personal accountability, and ability to deliver measurable new-business results.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree is required.
  • 7–10+ years of demonstrated success in enterprise new-business development and sales, ideally within consulting, technology services, professional services, or managed services.
  • Extensive experience selling into Consumer Products & Services organizations particularly within Retail, Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG), Food, and Grocery segments, with a demonstrated understanding of industry dynamics, business priorities, and enterprise buying environments.
  • A proven track record as a true new-business hunter. You have personally originated, developed, and closed enterprise clients rather than relying on inherited accounts, established relationships, or account * expansion to deliver your results.
  • Consistent achievement or overachievement of new-logo and new-business bookings targets, with the ability to demonstrate your individual contribution to pipeline creation and closed business.
  • Demonstrated ability to build a territory and qualified pipeline from scratch, including direct prospecting, executive networking, account penetration, and competitive displacement.
  • Experience originating and closing complex, high-value enterprise engagements, ideally with organizations generating $2B+ in annual revenue.
  • Proven success selling consultative, service-oriented solutions involving technology, consulting, managed services, or other complex professional services offerings.
  • Strong understanding of the challenges facing consumer products and retail organizations including digital commerce, brand and marketing transformation, supply chain modernization, operational efficiency, customer experience, and AI-enabled business transformation.
  • Ability to engage credibly with C-suite executives and senior business and technology leaders within CP&S organizations, develop executive sponsorship, and navigate complex stakeholder environments.
  • Strong business acumen and the ability to uncover client challenges, shape commercial opportunities, and translate business priorities into compelling solutions.
  • Demonstrated success leading full-cycle enterprise sales pursuits, including opportunity qualification, solution development, competitive positioning, pricing, negotiation, procurement, and contracting.
  • Experience navigating complex enterprise procurement, legal, and commercial processes within large consumer products, retail, or services organizations.
  • Strong understanding of emerging technologies, including AI, and the ability to discuss their practical application to enterprise business challenges within Consumer Products & Services.
  • Experience collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to shape and win complex engagements while retaining personal ownership of the sales outcome.
  • Strong commercial discipline, including pipeline management, forecasting accuracy, opportunity prioritization, and consistent execution.
  • Resilience, persistence, competitive drive, and the ability to create momentum in environments where opportunities must be earned rather than provided.
  • An entrepreneurial mindset, intellectual curiosity, sound judgment, and the ability to operate independently in a fast-paced, high-accountability environment.
  • Regular or periodic travel to meet and engage with Toptal clients and customers both inside and outside of your geographic location.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Essential Job Functions

  • Regularly and reliably attend scheduled virtual team meetings on camera.
  • Work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Use all required digital collaboration tools.
  • Prioritize and self-manage workflows and deadlines.

US FLSA Classification: Full-Time/Exempt

This position receives a base salary and is also eligible to earn monthly commissions based on revenue generated from engagements sold. For candidates who meet the qualifications and job requirements listed above, Individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. In the US, Toptal’s benefit offerings include participation in a 401(k) retirement plan; medical, dental, and vision health insurance plans; basic life insurance coverage and short-term and long-term disability coverage; access to flexible spending, dependent care, and health savings accounts; access to telehealth virtual doctors; an employee assistance program; and flexible paid time off.

Compensation

jobs.title: Technical Threat Investigator, Threat Intel Engineering
jobs.description:
Technical Threat Investigator, Threat Intel Engineering

About the Team

Security is at the foundation of OpenAI’s mission to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity.

The Threat Intelligence team protects OpenAI’s technology, people, research, and infrastructure by proactively identifying and disrupting adversaries who seek to compromise our systems or misuse our models. We investigate sophisticated threats, build tooling to scale and augment analysis, and deliver intelligence that shapes security strategy and equips leadership with timely, risk-aware insights. We combine technical depth, investigative rigor, and strong cross-functional partnerships to uncover threats and drive impact across OpenAI’s security and research organizations.

About the Role

As a Technical Threat Investigator at OpenAI, you will help protect the company from sophisticated adversaries targeting OpenAI and the broader ecosystem, as well as those attempting to misuse our models in support of cyber operations.

This is a deeply investigative role. You will independently conduct complex, end-to-end investigations into capable threat actors to understand their behavior, infrastructure, emerging techniques, and how AI is integrated into their workflows. You’ll use these insights to proactively identify malicious activity and drive detection, disruption, enforcement, and safety improvements across the company.

You’ll translate your investigative findings into durable solutions that scale impact. You’ll build and own lightweight tooling, automate where it matters, and create AI-assisted workflows to make investigations faster, more repeatable, and more effective over time.

In this role, you will:

  • Conduct deep, end-to-end investigations into sophisticated threat actors interacting with OpenAI’s models, products, and broader ecosystem.

  • Think like an adversary — model attacker behavior, anticipate misuse patterns, and proactively hunt for, identify, and disrupt malicious activity.

  • Leverage internal telemetry, OSINT, vendor data, and in-house safety systems to produce high-confidence findings on adversarial use of our models in cyber operations, platform abuse, and threats targeting OpenAI.

  • Translate investigative findings into concrete improvements across detection, enforcement, intel, and safety pipelines.

  • Build tooling, scripts, automations, and agentic workflows that scale investigative throughput and reduce manual effort.

  • Prototype solutions in ambiguous and emerging problem spaces, including new product surfaces, novel attacker behaviors, and areas where existing coverage may be limited.

  • Partner closely with teams across Security, Safety Systems, Product Policy, and Integrity to operationalize findings and drive meaningful outcomes.

  • Produce clear, high-signal written outputs and recommendations that inform decision-making across technical and executive stakeholders.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

  • Experience in threat intelligence, incident response, offensive security, or a closely related field.

Obsidian Security is the leading SaaS security platform, trusted by global enterprises like Snowflake, T-Mobile, and Algolia. We protect 200+ organizations across North America, Europe, the Middle East, Southeast Asia, Australia, and New Zealand, including many of the world’s largest Fortune 1000 and Global 2000 companies.

Founded in 2017 and backed by top investors like Greylock, Obsidian was built to close a critical gap: securing SaaS apps where business happens—Microsoft 365, Salesforce, and hundreds more. The company does this by offering a complete SaaS security platform to reduce risk, detect and respond to threats, and prevent breaches at the source. Obsidian was built by leaders who redefined endpoint and identity security at CrowdStrike, Okta, Cylance, and Carbon Black. Now, they’re transforming how SaaS is secured.

With AI driving rapid SaaS growth and complexity, agentic AI tools gain privileged access to sensitive data through integrations, creating new risks most security tools miss. Obsidian uniquely detects anomalous OAuth token activity and manages integration risks. Major announcements are on the horizon. Recognizing that SaaS security needs to evolve, Obsidian enables growing organizations to start with a lightweight, prevention-focused browser extension and expand coverage over time.

With global momentum, a growing partner ecosystem including SentinelOne, Databricks, and Google Cloud, and a major fundraise ahead, Obsidian is scaling rapidly toward long-term growth and IPO readiness.

We are hiring a Sr Technical Marketing Manager - Alliances & Competitive Strategy to own two of the highest-leverage narratives at Obsidian: why we are better together with our strategic partners, and why our architecture solves problems no one else can.

This role sits at the intersection of alliances marketing and technical product marketing, and it owns competitive intelligence for the company. You will define how Obsidian shows up alongside our strategic technology alliances, building the joint value propositions, launch narratives, and enablement that turn partnerships into pipeline and supporting the GTM models that bring those alliances to market. At the same time, you will go deep with Product and Engineering to understand how the platform works, from our knowledge graph to our data depth and detection architecture, and elevate that "how" into a durable "why": why Obsidian is uniquely positioned to secure third-party applications and AI agents where alternative architectures structurally fall short.

You will be the positioning authority the field, our partners, and our executives turn to for evidence-based answers on how we win, both in architecture and in direct competition.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who can think strategically, move quickly, and help shape how we scale both partner marketing and competitive positioning at Obsidian.

About You

  • Zusammen mit dem Projektmanagement planst du die Umsetzung hinsichtlich Timeline und Budget und koordinierst die erforderlichen Aufwände im Team.

Wirtschaftsinformatiker/in (Vollzeit) (m/w/d)

Wir suchen neue Mitarbeiter (m/w/d) im IT-Management, Digitalisierung & Prozesse, die uns mit ihrer fachlichen Expertise unterstützen. Du möchtest in einer der führenden Steuerkanzleien in Düsseldorf tätig sein und die Kanzlei bei Digitalisierung, Automatisierung und stabilen IT-Prozessen unterstützen?

Wir suchen Wirtschaftsinformatiker/in (Vollzeit) (m/w/d), die unser Team in Prozessaufnahme, Systemeinführung, Schnittstellenanbindung und im IT-Betrieb zuverlässig unterstützen. Während der Einarbeitung lernst du unsere digitale Arbeitsweise, das Dokumenten- und Fristenmanagement sowie unsere Automatisierungs- und DATEV-Systeme kennen.

Deine täglichen Aufgaben:

  • Betreuung der eingesetzten SaaS-Anwendungen (User-/Lizenzverwaltung, Konfiguration, Berechtigungen)

  • Einrichtung, Installation und Konfiguration von Standard-Software

  • Dokumentation und Konzeption digitaler Geschäftsprozesse (SOPs, Checklisten)

  • Planung und Einführung neuer Software- und IT-Lösungen

  • Verbinden von Standardlösungen über Schnittstellen

  • Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Automationen für wiederkehrende Aufgaben (z. B. Zapier/Mirror/ähnliche Tools)

  • Anwenderschulung und -betreuung (First/Second Level), Erstellung von Leitfäden

  • Fehleranalyse und Störungsbeseitigung über Ticketsystem

  • DATEV-Support-Themen in Zusammenarbeit mit den Fachbereichen und Dienstleistern

Zusätzliche Aufgaben (je nach Erfahrung)

  • System- und Rechteverwaltung, Basis-Administration (Benutzer, Endgeräte)

  • Mitarbeit an IT-Sicherheits- und Compliance-Standards (Richtlinien, Backups)

  • Auswahl und Steuerung externer Dienstleister; Lizenz- und Asset-Management

  • Ausbau von Low-Code/No-Code-Automationen

  • Prozessoptimierung und Projektmanagement in enger Abstimmung mit Fachabteilungen

Vorteile, auf die du dich freuen kannst:

  • Klare Strukturen und Prozesse:
    Bei uns findest du eine eindeutige Aufgabenverteilung, standardisierte Abläufe und dokumentierte Prozesse. Du erhältst praxisbewährtes Fachwissen und kannst dich auf eine planbare Einarbeitung verlassen. Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten sind klar definiert und nachvollziehbar. 

  • Attraktive Vergütung:
    Du erhältst von Beginn an ein überdurchschnittliches, festes Gehalt. Zusätzlich gibt es je nach Stelle transparente und messbare Bonusregelungen für besonders gute Leistungen.

  • Professionelle Mandate:
    Du arbeitest in einer der führenden Kanzleien in Düsseldorf und hilfst bei der Betreuung von renommierten Mandanten. Du arbeitest mit strukturierten und professionellen Mandanten aus dem Mittelstand und aus etablierten Branchen. Dadurch hast du ein stabiles, planbares Umfeld in deiner täglichen Arbeit.

  • Sicherer Arbeitsplatz
    Jede Person, die wir einstellen, soll langfristig mit uns wachsen. Wir haben nur unbefristete Arbeitsverträge in Vollzeit. Durch unser kontinuierliches Wachstum und die stabile Auftragslage bieten wir dir eine langfristige Perspektive mit hoher Arbeitsplatzsicherheit.

  • Hochmodernes Büro:
    Du arbeitest bei uns in einem voll verglasten Büro mit atemberaubender Aussicht über Düsseldorf und mit den neuesten Geräten. Unser Büro ist klar strukturiert, technisch auf dem neuesten Stand und bietet dir eine ruhige, professionelle Arbeitsatmosphäre mit Blick über den Rhein und Medienhafen.

  • Digitale Arbeitswelt:
    Wir arbeiten vollständig digital, sind von DATEV als Digitale Kanzlei ausgezeichnet und nutzen automatisierte Prozesse, damit du dich auf deine Kernaufgaben konzentrieren kannst. Wir sind eine innovative Kanzlei im Bereich Digitalisierung.

  • Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten: vorhanden

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung (z. B. IT-Systemkaufmann/-frau, Informatikkaufmann/-frau) oder Studium (Wirtschaftsinformatik o. ä.)

  • Mindestens 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung in Support, IT-Administration oder Software-Implementierung

  • Erfahrung mit Integrations-/Automation-Tools (z. B. Zapier, Mirror/Make o. ä.) und Routine im DATEV-Umfeld

  • Sicherer Umgang mit MS Office; Erstellung/Pflege von Formularen und Dokumenten

  • Sehr gute Ausdrucksform in Wort und Schrift; hohe Verlässlichkeit und Diskretion

  • Strukturierte, vorausschauende und sorgfältige Arbeitsweise; souverän in dynamischen Situationen

jobs.title: Sales Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
Sales Operations Analyst

Metaview is an AI company focused on recruiting. We build AI agents that help world-class companies hire with radically more speed and precision. We automate the toil, and augment the human for companies like Brex, Affirm, Deel, and Navan.

Founded by Siadhal and Shahriar after their experiences scaling Uber and Palantir, we’ve raised $110m from top-tier investors including Google Ventures and Insight Partners.

It’s still day 0: Now is the time to re-engineer how work gets done with AI at the core, and our toughest challenges still lie ahead. We’re looking for people seeking the hardest, most fulfilling work of their lives.

How we work

Four principles guide us:

  • Velocity. Optimize for rate of learning. Take action, get feedback, get better.

  • Hospitality. Sweat the experience. Delight customers, candidates and colleagues, even when it’s inconvenient.

  • Transparency. Public unless private. Share context openly within the company so people and agents can take initiative.

  • End-to-end. Deliver outcomes, not tasks. Step beyond your job description and see the work through.

The role

As a Sales Ops Analyst, you’ll be a foundational operational partner to our EMEA sales and customer success teams. You’ll keep the go-to-market engine moving—resolving systems issues, delivering the data and insights needed to make decisions, and removing the day-to-day blockers that slow our customer facing teams down. In doing so, you’ll help build the infrastructure, processes, and operating rhythm that allow our EMEA go-to-market motion to scale with speed and precision.

Key ownership areas:

  • Troubleshoot and resolve GTM systems issues for EMEA sales and customer success teams during UK business hours.

  • Handle data requests and reporting for go-to-market stakeholders, including sales and engagement leadership.

  • Establish and manage deal desk processes, oversee deal flow, and give sales reps the operational support they need.

  • Build dashboarding and business intelligence infrastructure using a BI tool rather than relying solely on Salesforce dashboards or manual Google Sheets reporting.

  • Manage Chargebee access and provide billing system support, reducing the need for sales reps to work directly in Chargebee and lowering the risk of errors.

  • Create scalable processes for recurring data requests, systems troubleshooting, and cross-time-zone handoffs.

  • Document and continuously improve go-to-market operations workflows.

Early priorities:

  • Establish documented, repeatable deal desk workflows with clear handoff procedures.

  • Implement dashboarding infrastructure that enables deeper insights and reduces reliance on manual reporting.

  • Create reliable systems for resolving recurring data requests and operational issues.

What you bring

  • Strong sales operations acumen, including familiarity with sales operations, deal desk workflows, revenue systems, and the full sales funnel.

  • The ability to identify operational bottlenecks, diagnose their root causes, and design scalable systems and processes.

  • Technical fluency with business tools such as Salesforce, Chargebee, BI tools such as Hex, and data platforms.

  • Comfort moving between systems, understanding data flows, and implementing operational solutions without heavy engineering support.

  • The ability to translate business questions into useful reporting, dashboards, and clear operational recommendations.

  • High ownership and autonomy, with sound judgment about when to solve independently and when to escalate.

  • A proactive approach to supporting sales and customer success teams, anticipating needs before they become blockers.

  • Clear communication, strong attention to detail, and comfort operating in a fast-moving environment.

What we offer

  • The best co-workers you’ll ever have, in an environment that fosters cohesion, collaboration, and performance.

  • Supreme rate-of-learning as we re-orient how the world works with AI.

  • High compensation, through cash and equity.

  • All the benefits you’d expect and more.

jobs.title: Software Engineer II, Security
UK Communications Executive
jobs.description:
UK Communications Executive

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

This is an opportunity to build your career in communications at a fast-growing fintech that's reshaping SME finance. You'll be part of iwoca's external communications team, helping drive coverage across our expanding product portfolio, working on data-led campaigns and supporting our work with government and policymakers.

Our comms function works across the business to position iwoca as a leading voice in SME finance. You'll collaborate closely with Product, Commercial, and Executive teams to translate business priorities into compelling narratives that drive both brand awareness and customer acquisition.

The role

We're looking for a Communications Executive with up to two years' experience to join our UK comms team. Working alongside the team, you'll help publish our major data-driven campaigns, own the communications for a couple of our newest products, and support our public affairs and policy work. You'll also help with the BAU media activities that keep iwoca front-of-mind with key journalists and stakeholders.

Examples of the type of work you'll be doing:

1. Support data-driven PR campaigns

Working with the team, you'll run several established data-driven campaigns:

  • Top 25 UK Cities for SME Jobs: Our annual ranking combines ONS employment data, business figures, and economic indicators. You can refine the methodology if needed, analyse the latest data, and craft narratives for regional and national media.

  • SME survey research: Twice a year you'll help commission original survey research, working with established research partners to design questionnaires capturing timely SME sentiment. You'll help ensure we generate "business news" coverage that responds to real economic issues.

  • You'll be comfortable working with raw datasets - not just presenting finished analysis. Spotting surprising findings, identifying regional variations, understanding which angles interest journalists versus policymakers.

2. Start shouting about our new products

You'll eventually own the communications for a couple of iwoca's newest products, working directly with Venture Leads to drive awareness and customer acquisition. Here are a few we've just launched that you could be working on:

  • Credit Compass: Our credit-building tool helping SMEs improve their scores. You'll identify customer success stories, translate credit score trends into compelling narratives, and position this as iwoca's answer to the credit access gap.

  • SME Insurance: Help launch this proposition to market - identifying angles around why SMEs need this product and announce new strategic partners as and when we secure them.

  • iwoca Credit Card: You'll be involved from the ground up - understanding competitive positioning, identifying what's newsworthy in a crowded market, building a launch campaign that breaks through.

  • iwocaPay (launched in 2020): Our instant payment solution - you'll help scale awareness as this product continues to grow, finding ongoing news hooks beyond what we've already done in recent years.

  • For each product, you'll get under the hood with the Venture Leads - understanding commercial objectives, customer pain points, competitive landscape - then translating that into comms plans that drive both coverage and business outcomes. You'll own two products, with the split decided once you're in the job.

3. Support our public affairs and policy work

iwoca works with government and policymakers to make the case for better access to finance for small businesses. You'll support this work, engaging with relevant government departments, industry bodies and ministers where relevant. This could include:

  • Tracking policy and regulatory developments that affect SMEs and SME lending.

  • Helping draft consultation responses, policy briefings and position papers.

  • Using our lending and survey data to build the evidence behind our policy positions.

  • Preparing briefing materials for meetings with officials, industry bodies and ministers.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Up to two years' experience in communications, PR, public affairs, policy, journalism or a related field. Internships and placements count, and we welcome recent graduates.

  • Excellent writing skills with the ability to craft data-driven stories, press releases, briefing materials, and media pitches that cut through.

  • Ability to work at pace across multiple projects simultaneously, with strong organisational skills.

  • You'll need to be confident managing and analysing data with either Excel or Google Sheets.

  • A genuine interest in the economy, policy and politics, and how they affect small businesses.

Bonus:

  • Some experience in, or a strong interest in, tech, fintech, financial services or B2B technology.

  • Experience in public affairs, policy or government relations, or an understanding of how policy is made.

  • Any exposure to product launches or translating complex propositions into accessible narratives.

  • Experience pitching to journalists or securing coverage in relevant press.

  • Comfortable working with senior stakeholders.

  • Commercial awareness and understanding of what drives media coverage in fintech and SME finance.

  • Familiarity with media monitoring tools (e.g., Signal AI, Cision) and ability to analyse coverage data to inform strategy.

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

jobs.title: Senior Stack Scientist
jobs.description:
Senior Stack Scientist

Senior Stack Scientist

About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy develops fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power. Our redesigned fuel cell is more compact, has higher power density and costs less to produce. We build high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to help address climate change and the move toward decentralised energy.

As Senior Stack Scientist, you will own the scientific understanding of how our stacks perform and age. You will connect cell-level electrochemistry with stack-level design, operating conditions and manufacturing, and turn that understanding into stacks with higher power density, longer life and repeatable performance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead stack-level performance and durability investigations, from short stacks to full-size stacks.

  • Define and run stack test campaigns: polarisation, EIS, cell voltage monitoring, durability and accelerated stress tests under realistic duty cycles.

  • Analyse water management, thermal behaviour, gas distribution and cell-to-cell uniformity, and identify what limits performance.

  • Investigate stack degradation and failure modes, including post-mortem analysis, and lead root-cause work with the materials, process and design teams.

  • Develop and validate stack models (electrochemical, thermal, fluidic) to guide design choices and operating strategies.

  • Set the operating windows, conditioning and break-in procedures, and the diagnostic methods used in development and production.

  • Translate results into clear requirements for flow fields, bipolar plates, MEAs, sealing and compression.

  • Mentor junior scientists and engineers, and present results to internal stakeholders and partners.

Skills and Experience Required

  • PhD or MSc in electrochemistry, chemical engineering, mechanical engineering, materials science, physics or a related field.

  • 12+ years of experience in fuel cell stack development or testing (PEM preferred).

  • Strong grasp of stack physics: water and heat management, reactant distribution, contact resistance and compression.

  • Hands-on experience with stack test benches, cell voltage monitoring, EIS and durability/AST protocols.

  • Solid understanding of MEA, GDL and bipolar plate degradation mechanisms.

  • Experience with modelling and data analysis tools (e.g. Python, MATLAB, COMSOL or similar).

  • Ability to turn complex data into clear, actionable recommendations.

  • Team player who can also work autonomously in a fast-moving environment.

  • Management experience

  • English is mandatory; French or German is a plus.

Start date: Immediately

As a Zurich-based AI scale-up of around 30 people, we support leading European brands in e-commerce, telecommunications, banking, insurance and energy.

Get future-proof. In our 12-month traineeship you learn, at the intersection of marketing, analytics and AI, how modern marketing is measured and optimized with algorithms.   • You are at the start of your career, eager, like taking responsibility and want to learn fast

  • A completed or soon-to-be-completed degree in business, data science, marketing or a related field

  • Fluent in German and English is a must, Italian is a plus

✨ Future-proof skills: AI, marketing and analytics in one program

✨ A permanent contract from day one, plus a fixed salary increase and equity in Nexoya (ESOP) once you complete the traineeship

✨ A real AI-first culture. Experiment, automate and share what you build, and work with MCPs, coworkers and agents

✨ A team you’ll love working with, an office just a few minutes’ walk from Zurich main station and the flexibility to work from home 3 days/week

jobs.title: Junior adviseur bedrijfsovernames
jobs.description:
Junior adviseur bedrijfsovernames

Ben jij het zonnetje in huis? En heb jij al affiniteit met de wereld van bedrijfsovernames?

Lees dan vooral verder! Wij zoeken namelijk een junior adviseur bedrijfsovernames. Je bent - samen met een senior collega - verantwoordelijk voor het gehele overnameproces van MKB bedrijven.

Wat is je takenpakket?

  • Je stelt anonieme overname profielen en informatiememoranda op en controleert ze

  • Je spreekt met geïnteresseerden, nadat deze door je collega’s gekwalificeerd zijn

  • Je voert onderhandelingsgesprekken met geïnteresseerden

  • Je maakt de deal en het begeleidt het LOI-proces

  • Je onderhoud korte lijnen met jouw klant (de ondernemer die zijn bedrijf gaat verkopen). Die voelt dat jij aan z’n kant staat.

We hebben specialisten op elk gebied van het bedrijfsovernameproces; waardebepalingen, juridische afwikkeling en het informeren van geïnteresseerden. Dit is dus allemaal al geregeld en hoeft dus niet alles zelf te doen. Ondanks dat dit niet bij jouw verantwoordelijkheden hoort, krijg je hier wel alles van mee. We werken namelijk als een team. Mocht je ervaring en interesse hier liggen, dan kunnen we je takenpakket hiermee uitbreiden.


Wie is onze ideale kandidaat?

  • Je hebt affiniteit met overname processen

  • Je communiceert op een natuurlijke en informele wijze met diverse partijen

  • Je hebt affiniteit hebt met cijfers en je kunt uit de voeten met jaarrekeningen en financiële rapportages

  • Je vind het leuk jezelf te verplaatsen in MKB ondernemers uit diverse sectoren en van allerlei niveau’s

  • Je hebt overredingskracht en geeft tegengas aan je klant wanneer het nodig is

  • Je hebt een winnaarsmentaliteit en gaat daarvoor graag “the extra mile”

  • Je kunt gemakkelijk tussen cases schakelen: bij een fulltime dienstverband werk je doorgaans aan 10-15 cases tegelijkertijd

Over Take 5

Over het algemeen zijn ondernemers ongeduldige mensen. Het liefst is alles gisteren al gebeurd. Wij kennen het overnameproces. We zijn hierin deskundig en ervaren. Dat wil zeggen: we hebben alle expertise in huis om een MKB’er zo goed mogelijk mee te nemen en we doen dit al een hele tijd.

Het verkopen van een bedrijf doen MKB ondernemers maximaal 1-2 keer in hun leven. Ze staan hun kindje af. Dit is een emotioneel en spannend proces. Wij zijn toegewijd en pro-actief. We zijn streng op de kwalificatie en nemen alleen genoegen met het beste voor de ondernemer.

We zijn authentiek en gelijkwaardig. Dat wil zeggen: we gaan naast een ondernemer staan en nemen die stap voor stap mee. We gebruiken ons karakter en eigenaardigheden om de connectie met de ondernemer te maken. Hoe lekkerder je zelf in je vel zit, hoe beter je iemand kunt helpen.



Wat wij je bieden

  • Een hecht team waar jouw werk direct zichtbaar impact heeft

  • Een omgeving waar keihard werken en keihard lachen hand in hand gaat

  • De ruimte om te mogen zijn wie je bent

  • Veel verantwoordelijkheid en geen hiërarchisch gedoe

  • Ruimte om te groeien in wat je nog niet kan maar wel wil leren

  • Een werkomgeving waar ‘doen waar je energie van krijgt’ het aller-belangrijkste is

  • Salaris en arbeidsvoorwaarden, daar komen we uit

Belangrijk om te weten: voor deze functie zoeken we iemand die in loondienst komt. Daar tegenover staat dat je alle verantwoordelijkheden en voordelen krijgt die horen bij ondernemerschap. In de kern hebben wij geen programma om mede-eigenaar te worden. Mochten we er samen, na jarenlange gebleken geschiktheid, achter komen dat dit wel de juiste koers is, dan kan het alsnog. Dit is echter niet het initiële doel bij indiensttreding.

Wat we zoeken

  • Je hebt minimaal een HBO opleiding afgerond (de richting is niet zo belangrijk)

  • Positiviteit en een drive om te winnen

  • ⁠Je geeft zelfstandig gas, maar vindt samenwerken net zo belangrijk

  • Je vindt het leuk om op een informele manier met veel verschillende ondernemers te schakelen

  • Je bent empathisch en innemend

  • Je hebt geen plankenkoorts

  • Je bent in staat om minimaal 2 dagen per week te werken op ons kantoor in Bergen op Zoom


Of je nu starter bent of ervaren: wie je bent is belangrijker dan wat je kunt. De wil om keihard gas te geven en dat met een enorme lach is het belangrijkst.

Klaar om samen met ons op avontuur te gaan? Wil je samen met ons een van de belangrijkste stappen voor ondernemers waarmaken, en zelf óók groeien? Dan kunnen we niet wachten om van je te horen.

Solliciteer met de knop op deze pagina. Zet je plankenkoorts maar aan de kant, want we doen het graag anders. Natuurlijk verwachten we echt geen Steven Spielberg kwaliteiten, maar blaas ons vooral omver met je persoonlijkheid

Tot snel!

jobs.title: Physician Assistant of Verpleegkundig Specialist
jobs.description:
Physician Assistant of Verpleegkundig Specialist

Wat ga je doen?

Bij Cardiologie Centra Nederland, locatie Dokkum draai je zelfstandig spreekuur en ben je medisch inhoudelijk verantwoordelijk voor je eigen patiëntenpopulatie. Je stelt zelfstandig diagnose- en behandelplannen op, verricht risicostratificatie en begeleidt patiënten met uiteenlopende, complexe cardiologische beelden, zoals:

  • Pijn op de borst (angina pectoris) en ischemische hartziekten;
  • Hartritmestoornissen (o.a. atriumfibrilleren);
  • Hartfalen, hypertensie en hypercholesterolemie;
  • Hartkleplijden.

Je combineert medisch-technische zorg met leefstijlgeneeskunde en langdurige opvolging. Waar nodig spar je op gelijkwaardige basis met de aanwezige cardiologen; de lijnen zijn bij ons kort en de sfeer is collegiaal. En omdat de inzet van een PA of VS bij onze locatie in Dokkum nieuw is, bieden we een kans: jij bouwt actief mee aan de vormgeving van deze rol en de polikliniek. Jouw visie, klinische blik en initiatief zijn hierin leidend.

De locatie in Dokkum is gevestigd binnen het Sionsberg Netwerk Ziekenhuis. Je komt te werken in een toegankelijk en informeel team, waarin we echt voor elkaar klaarstaan. Bovendien biedt het werken in Dokkum rust en ruimte: gratis parkeren voor de deur, geen files en een prachtige omgeving. Bij CCN denken we mee over jouw ontwikkeling. Mocht jij jouw werk bijvoorbeeld op de cardiologie willen afwisselen met ervaring binnen bijvoorbeeld de traumatologie. Dan is dit zeker bespreekbaar na de opstart van deze nieuwe rol binnen onze poli cardiologie.

Over ons: onze zorg klopt!

We zijn een organisatie van zelfstandige behandelcentra voor hart- en vaatziekten die zich onderscheidt door poliklinische zorg perfect af te stemmen op de behoeften van de patiënt en de verwijzer. We geloven in de kracht van complete zorg onder één dak. Onze patiënten kunnen dicht bij huis terecht voor de meest hoogwaardige cardiologische zorg, en jij speelt daarin een belangrijke rol.

We werken met geavanceerde hartritme-analyses (holtermonitoring), begeleiden patiënten op afstand via ons innovatieve e-health programma Hartwacht, en voeren poliklinisch elektrische cardioversies (ECV’s) uit. Met een eigen PM-technicus én een eigen spoedpolikliniek in huis is de dynamiek hoog.

Daarnaast beschikken we binnenkort over onze eigen CT coronairen. Met deze modernste apparatuur brengen we lokaal, snel en non-invasief de kransslagaders in beeld, een fantastische kwaliteitsimpuls voor jouw diagnostische werk.

Wie ben jij?

  • Je hebt de Master Physician Assistant (MPA) óf Master Advanced Nursing Practice (MANP) afgerond en beschikt over een geldige BIG-registratie;
  • Je hebt aantoonbare klinische ervaring binnen de cardiologie (of een zeer sterke affiniteit om je hier in te verdiepen);
  • Je bent communicatief sterk, werkt graag autonoom en zoekt de samenwerking op.

Wat bieden we jou?

Bij CCN krijg je een salaris conform CAO Zelfstandige Klinieken Nederland (ZKN), een fulltime dienstverband bestaat uit een 40-urige werkweek. De CAO zorgt voor een aantrekkelijk pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden. We willen het beste voor jou, het team en de patiënt. Wij bieden je onder andere het volgende:

  • Een salaris tussen €5.295,- tot €7.901,- conform FWG 65 (cao ZKN) o.b.v. 40 uur per week. We schalen je in op basis van jouw ervaring;
  • Vakantiegeld (8,33%), een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33% en deelname aan de pensioenregeling bij PFZW;
  • Een jaarcontract voor 16-32 uur per week, met duidelijke intentie op een volgend contract voor onbepaalde tijd;
  • Een gezonde werk-privébalans: wij bieden uitsluitend regelmaat. Je draait dus géén diensten in de weekenden of avond/nacht;
  • 160 uur vakantieverlof en 72 PLB-uren o.b.v. een fulltime dienstverband;
  • Reiskostenvergoeding van €0,23/km (er zijn parkeermogelijkheden bij deze locatie) of een NS business card voor woon-werkverkeer;
  • Vakinhoudelijke en professionele ontwikkeling met onze interne klinische lessen en andere opleidingsmogelijkheden. We denken hierbij graag met je mee wat bij jou past;
  • Extra secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden, zoals deelname aan onze fietsregeling, zodat je met belastingvoordeel een nieuwe fiets kan kopen. En voordeel op jouw ziektekostenverzekering met onze collectieve zorgverzekering bij IZZ of Zilveren Kruis Achmea.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Revenue Operations
jobs.description:
Senior Manager, Revenue Operations

We’re on a mission to back the UK’s small businesses like no one else 🚀

Small businesses are the backbone of the economy, and we’re here to help them win. We’ve built a platform that uses clever data to get them the funding they need in minutes, not weeks.

At Funding Circle, we have the restless energy of a fintech start-up with the stability of a public company. It’s a unique mix that gives Circlers the autonomy to take ownership and the scale to make an impact that truly counts.

We’re a high-performing team that chooses to lift each other up. We challenge, we champion, and we have each other’s backs - because we know that when we stand together, we move faster and build better.

The impact is real: Last year alone, the businesses on our platform generated £7.2bn for the UK economy 📈 Come and join a mission that matters!

[Read our Impact Report] | [See our Trustpilot]

The role ⚡

📍 London (Hybrid) | 🤝 3 days in the office | 💰 Competitive Salary + Benefits

Bringing together our RevOps & AI automations team, you will be improving capabilities for all of the customer facing teams. You’ll work across a mix of AI and traditional GTM tools to help our sales teams work faster and more effectively than ever before.

  • Own the KPI suite, the dashboards and the weekly performance reporting for Sales, Service and Collections. Set the analytics standard across the customer-facing teams, and ensure that every metric earns its place and drives business outcomes.

  • Own the RevOps build roadmap and act as both product manager and builder on it: AI-assisted quality assurance and coaching tooling, call transcription and conversational intelligence on Amazon Connect Contact Lens, and the automations that take manual work off managers. You will line-manage a specialist AI & Automation manager, so this is about setting direction and shipping alongside, not delegating and reviewing.

  • With your unique perspective across the customer-facing teams, you will identify and prioritize initiatives for the team that drive real business value. Saying ‘no’ to really good ideas, to make space for the truly great ones.

  • Identify and execute operational efficiency gains across sales and contact-centre processes. Drive team adoption of tools and best practices to directly increase conversion and productivity.

  • Act on customer insight and drive improvements to customer journeys across the teams. This isn't just producing the reports, you will own the next action and the outcome.

  • Lead a high-performing RevOps team while scaling the function into strategic new focus areas across the revenue engine.

What we’re looking for 🌱

  • A track record of unlocking actionable insights that drive revenue growth, with the ability to translate data into business strategy.

  • You know the technology and the shortest path to value. You are nbhands-on with the CRM (ideally Salesforce), reporting, data analytics and AI and you can point to real results.

  • You’ve worked closely with Sales and Marketing teams to drive results. You understand what drives customer behaviour and how to get the most out of the sales funnel.

  • You’ve built with and on top of AI, producing systems that drive real business outcomes.

  • You’ve got experience getting frontline teams to change how they work, and making it stick.

  • You can own and prioritise your own roadmap alongside business-critical change, with a small team and a broad remit.

  • You’ve demonstrated the ability to manage multiple high-level stakeholders.

  • Proven ability to get the best from a small, expert team.

We’re building a place where everyone truly feels they belong. Even if your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every requirement, we'd still love to hear from you.

Why join us? 💜

We back you to build an incredible career and by joining us, you'll be part of one of The Sunday Times Best Companies to Work For 2026! As a flexible-first employer, we use a "best of both" approach. We’ll see you in our London office to collaborate – with barista coffee and subsidised Just Eat lunches on us!

Our Circler Proposition focuses on five areas:

  • Flexibility: We provide a benefit allowance you can tailor to your own life and family.

  • Health: This includes private medical and dental, health assessments, and access to a digital GP.

  • Wealth: We offer life assurance, share schemes, and financial coaching.

  • Development: You get a dedicated annual learning allowance to help you level up.

  • Lifestyle: We have electric car and cycle-to-work schemes, plus season ticket loans.

We also have award-winning parental leave policies. We're here to support you through the big life moments, from fertility treatments to new additions to the family.

Ready to join a mission that matters? We’d love to chat!

jobs.title: Commercial Account Executive (UK)
jobs.description:
Commercial Account Executive (UK)

About Us

At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale.

With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world.

Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement. We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater.

About LangChain

At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale.

Today, LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, and Agent Builder are used by teams shipping real AI products across startups and large enterprises. Millions of developers trust LangChain to power AI teams at companies like Replit, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, and 35% of the Fortune 500.

With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world.

About the role:

Location: Hiring in London,UK

We're looking for a Commercial Account Executive to join our growing GTM team and help drive adoption of LangChain's products. In this role, you'll support the sales process by helping technical teams at innovative companies discover, evaluate, and adopt LangChain's solutions.

This is a great opportunity to learn and grow in a high-impact environment where you'll work alongside experienced sales, engineering, and customer success professionals. jobs.title: Staff Engineer, EU Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Staff Engineer, EU Infrastructure

About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

About the Team

Our Infrastructure teams build the foundation that engineers at Wolt, Deliveroo, and DoorDash build on: the compute, cloud, and networking capabilities that enable Engineering teams to develop, deploy, and run services at global scale. The EU Compute team has a specific focus on provisioning, scaling, and the efficient operation of GPU infrastructure for AI and ML workloads. This is an emerging space with plenty of greenfield opportunities.

We're looking for a Staff Engineer to be a hands-on technical leader for this infrastructure work that crosses team and brand boundaries. You'll set direction for the platform, turn complex problems into deliverable plans, write and review production code, and help other engineers make sound decisions. It's an exciting time to join: we're building a global platform and the choices made now will shape how engineers across the company ship for years.

What you'll be doing

You'll own some of the hardest infrastructure problems in the company and make the platform easier to operate and safer to build on. We're determined to build great platform products and user experiences, and you'll be pivotal in making this reality.

Day-to-day in this role you'll:

  • Set technical direction for shared AWS and Kubernetes infrastructure, balancing reliability, security, developer experience, and cost.
  • Lead substantial initiatives from design through rollout and operation, coordinating dependencies and decisions across Wolt, Deliveroo and DoorDash, focusing on workloads targeting GPUs.
  • Evolve Kubernetes clusters, cloud networking, identity, and infrastructure provisioning to support growing and varied workloads.
  • Build reusable Terraform patterns and self-service tooling that help teams provision infrastructure safely and consistently.
  • Improve deployment and operational practices, including GitOps, observability, capacity planning, incident response and recovery.
  • Use production signals and developer feedback to find platform friction, choose where to invest and measure whether changes actually help.
  • Assist with supporting the platform, with deep focus on GPU infrastructure, as well as broad focus on compute in general.
  • Gracefully sunset legacy infrastructure and tooling, and create strategies to reduce toil.
  • Mentor engineers through design reviews, implementation and incidents, raising the quality of infrastructure work across teams.

Our humble expectations

  • Deep experience building and operating Kubernetes and AWS infrastructure in production. Familiarity with GPU workloads and orchestration is a plus.
  • Strong software engineering skills: you use Go, Python or a similar language to build maintainable tools and automation.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code (we use Terraform) and with designing systems that other engineering teams depend on.
  • A track record of leading complex technical work across teams, including architectural decisions, delivery, and operational follow-through. You have the breadth to collaborate and design across team and domain boundaries, and the depth to have hands-on impact.
  • Strong judgment on trade-offs in distributed systems, networking, security, reliability, and cloud cost.
  • Clear communication, and the ability to bring people together around a practical technical direction.

What we offer

  • Scope and influence. Shape infrastructure used globally, while staying close to the engineering. Your work will help product teams ship services with greater ease and confidence.
  • Real problems at global scale. Multi-cluster Kubernetes, AI / ML workloads, cloud networking, GitOps, and progressive delivery across a global company.
  • Autonomy and ownership. Set direction and see it through from design to operation, with the backing of a global engineering organisation spanning Europe and the US.
  • Growth. Room to expand your scope, whether through deeper technical leadership or broader cross-domain influence.
  • Great people. Work with talented engineers and leaders in a diverse, international environment, mentoring and learning from others.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

jobs.title: Data Privacy Analyst - Regulatory Compliance
jobs.description:
Data Privacy Analyst - Regulatory Compliance

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

The Compliance team’s mission is to keep iwoca a safe and trusted lender for UK small businesses, and to make the compliant path the easy path for the teams we work with.

We make sure iwoca meets its regulatory obligations, particularly the financial crime, sanctions and data protection requirements that apply across our suite of products and services.

We are the second line of defence for the UK business. We advise the people building and running the business on what the rules require, set the policies and standards they work to, and test whether what happens in practice matches them. We work alongside the product teams so that each product meets its obligations and can grow.

Data protection is central to what we do. We hold the data privacy function for the UK business and own how iwoca handles personal data end to end: the lawful basis for how customer, applicant and third-party data is used; data subject access requests and other individual rights; personal data breaches; retention and deletion; records of processing; marketing and consent; the privacy review of new products and features; and the governance of automated decisioning and AI tooling.


How we work:

  • We enable rather than block. The answer is rarely just “no” — it’s what it would take to get to yes, and what the firm is accepting if it goes ahead anyway.

  • We go to the source. Positions are grounded in the actual rule, regulation or guidance, and we can show where they come from.

  • We’re proportionate. Controls match the risk in front of us. We don’t build process for its own sake.

  • We’re close to the business. We work directly with Tech, Data, Credit, Operations and Legal, and we want to be in the room early rather than at the end.

The role

As Data Privacy Analyst you will run iwoca’s day-to-day UK data protection work and help the business apply UK GDPR, the Data Protection Act 2018 and PECR in practice. Your primary focus will be the statutory core: data subject access requests, data protection impact assessments, legitimate interests assessments, personal data breaches and records of processing.

The role is not only to run that work but to improve it. A significant part of the job is identifying where our privacy operations could be automated, supported by AI or otherwise improved, assessing what each option would take and what it would mean for compliance, and specifying it well enough for our Tech and Data teams to deliver.

There is real room for the role to grow: as you build credibility, so does the scope, towards owning areas of the framework outright, leading on AI and automation governance, and taking a larger advisory remit across the business.

You will report to the Data Privacy Manager and work closely with the Head of Compliance who also acts as iwoca’s DPO, so you will have experienced support on the harder judgement calls. This is a hands-on role and the work is visible — much of it goes to senior stakeholders or to the regulator.

Impact and influence

  • Individual rights and data breaches. Own data subject access requests from intake to response — scoping the search, applying exemptions and meeting the statutory deadline — along with erasure, rectification and objection requests. Triage and investigate suspected personal data breaches, assess them against the 72-hour notification test, and keep the breach register accurate.

  • Privacy assessments and advice. Assist with DPIAs, legitimate interests assessments and other privacy reviews on new products, features, suppliers and data flows. Be an accessible first point of contact for teams across iwoca with a data protection question, and give them an answer they can act on, early enough to shape what they build.

  • Records, policies and reporting. Keep the record of processing activities accurate as the business changes, hold the retention and deletion schedules to account, review data processing agreements with suppliers, help maintain our data protection policies and standards, and produce the privacy reporting that goes to senior stakeholders.

  • AI and automated decisioning. Help assess AI tooling and automated decision-making across lending and operations: what personal data goes in, what lawful basis supports it, what the model does with it, and what rights customers have over the outcome. That includes the risks specific to these systems — decisions taken without meaningful human involvement, bias in outcomes, unreliable model output — and recommending how we address them.

  • Automation and improvement. Identify the manual steps in our privacy operations that should not be manual, assess the options, and set out the requirements and compliance implications clearly enough for Tech and Data to deliver them.

The requirements

Essential skills

  • Experience. Experience in data protection or privacy operations, or in a compliance, legal, risk or operational role where data protection was a real part of the job.

  • Data protection knowledge. A solid practical understanding of UK GDPR, the Data Protection Act 2018 and PECR, and of how the ICO expects firms to apply them. Familiarity with the changes made by the Data (Use and Access) Act 2025 is an advantage.

  • Privacy operations and assessments. Hands-on experience of statutory work: DSARs, DPIAs, legitimate interests assessments, breach handling, ROPA maintenance or data processing agreement review. You may not have done all of these — but we want to see that you have done some of them properly.

  • AI and automation. A real interest in, and working understanding of, how data protection law applies to AI and automated decision-making. Enough technical fluency to see where a manual process could be automated, set out what is needed, and hold your own in a conversation with engineers.

  • Stakeholder management: Comfortable dealing directly with product, engineering, marketing, credit and operations teams, and able to give a non-specialist a clear answer they can act on rather than a legal summary.

Bonus:

  • Sector experience. Financial services or fintech, ideally in lending or payments.

  • Credentials. A privacy or AI qualification such as CIPP/E, CIPM, or ICO-recognised practitioner certificates — or working towards one.

  • Practical tooling. Experience using Claude Code, LLMs or privacy management platforms.

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

jobs.title: AI platform engineer
