AI platform engineer

Wil jij werken op het snijvlak van cloud, platform engineering en AI? Bij Itility krijg je de ruimte om te bouwen aan een platform dat onze engineers en klantenteams helpt slimmer, efficiënter en veiliger te werken. Je ontwikkelt niet alleen nieuwe functionaliteiten, maar denkt ook actief mee over hoe we AI en automation kunnen inzetten om onze dienstverlening verder te verbeteren.


Wat jij gaat doen

Je bouwt mee aan de verdere ontwikkeling van ons platform en vertaalt behoeften vanuit onze klantenteams naar concrete, herbruikbare oplossingen. Je werkt aan features vanuit de roadmap, maar signaleert ook zelf waar verbeteringen mogelijk zijn.

Een belangrijk onderdeel van je werk is het toepassen van AI en automation. Je ontwikkelt bijvoorbeeld AI-agents die informatie verzamelen en analyseren, engineers ondersteunen bij troubleshooting of binnen duidelijke kaders zelfstandig acties uitvoeren. Je zorgt ervoor dat deze oplossingen niet bij een proof of concept blijven, maar daadwerkelijk in productie worden gebruikt.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • Het ontwerpen en ontwikkelen van nieuwe platformfunctionaliteiten.

  • Het doorontwikkelen van onze centrale dashboard- en beheeromgeving.

  • Het bouwen van AI-agents, agentic workflows, API's en integraties.

  • Het ontwikkelen en verbeteren van Terraform-modules en andere automatiseringen.

  • Het inrichten van human-in-the-loop-processen, approvals en guardrails.

  • Het analyseren en automatiseren van terugkerende operationele werkzaamheden.

  • Het ondersteunen bij incidenten, troubleshooting en wijzigingen wanneer dat nodig is.

Je krijgt de ruimte om zelf verbeterkansen te signaleren, ideeën uit te werken en oplossingen te realiseren. Daarbij houd je altijd rekening met security, betrouwbaarheid en beheersbaarheid.

Waar kom je terecht?

Je maakt deel uit van het Platform Team binnen onze MSP-organisatie. Dit team ontwikkelt en beheert de centrale diensten waarop onze klantenteams vertrouwen. Het platform vormt de basis voor onze cloud-, data- en AI-dienstverlening en helpt engineers om hun werk efficiënt, veilig en consistent uit te voeren.

Binnen het team werken we met onder andere:

  • Microsoft Azure en AWS voor cloud-, data- en AI-foundations.

  • Terraform voor Infrastructure as Code en herbruikbare infrastructuurmodules.

  • LogicMonitor voor centrale monitoring.

  • Puppet voor configuration management.

  • Centrale dashboards en tooling voor het beheer en de ontsluiting van onze platformdiensten.

We blijven investeren in de verdere ontwikkeling van dit platform. Daarbij willen we AI en automation een steeds grotere rol geven, zodat onze engineers minder tijd kwijt zijn aan repetitieve werkzaamheden en meer ruimte hebben voor complexe vraagstukken en innovatie.


Daar hoort natuurlijk ook een aantrekkelijk arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket bij. Naast een salaris dat past bij jouw ervaring, achtergrond en potentie, kun je rekenen op:

  • Een variabele bonusregeling gebaseerd op jouw persoonlijke ontwikkeling en gezamenlijke successen;

  • Laptop en telefoon;

  • Hybride werken;

  • Gebruik van gym op kantoor

Dit ben jij

Je bent in de eerste plaats een hands-on engineer. Je vindt het leuk om zelf oplossingen te ontwerpen en te bouwen, maar kijkt ook verder dan het individuele ticket. Je neemt initiatief, zoekt actief de samenwerking met de teams die ons platform gebruiken en signaleert waar processen en diensten beter kunnen.

Je denkt in herbruikbare oplossingen en vraagt jezelf regelmatig af hoe werkzaamheden slimmer kunnen worden ingericht. Daarbij verlies je security, betrouwbaarheid en beheersbaarheid niet uit het oog.

Je brengt mee;

  • Een bachelor of masterdiploma in Informatica, Software engineering, Data Science/ AI of vergelijkbaar,

  • Ervaring met CI/CD en moderne software-ontwikkelmethoden.

  • Een proactieve houding, eigenaarschap en de motivatie om zelf verbeterkansen te signaleren en te realiseren.

Nice to have;

jobs.title: Tender Manager
jobs.description:
Tender Manager

Do you want to take ownership of how tenders are won, rather than simply contributing to them?

Valcon is looking for an experienced Bid Manager to take the lead across the entire bid and tender process. From identifying and qualifying opportunities to defining the strategy, coordinating decision-making, managing stakeholders, safeguarding quality and evaluating results. The primary focus will be on European public tenders.

This is explicitly not a traditional bid writing role. Rather than spending your days writing proposals yourself, you ensure that the right people deliver the strongest possible content at the right time. You create structure, challenge subject-matter experts, safeguard the strategy and quality, and keep stakeholders aligned throughout the process. But in case of emergency it is important for you to also be able to write a tender yourself, which occasionally will happen.

The principle is simple: don’t write it yourself – enable the team to write it better.

What will you do?

As Bid Manager, you will be responsible for the end-to-end management of bids and tenders. You will oversee the full tender pipeline and take the lead on complex bid processes involving multiple disciplines, seniority levels and stakeholder interests.

Your responsibilities include:

  • Centrally identifying, qualifying and prioritising relevant tenders and commercial opportunities;
  • Organising and facilitating Go/No-Go decisions and according to the required approval process;
  • Developing and safeguarding the bid strategy;
  • Translating it into a clear plan and structured tender process;
  • Independently leading multidisciplinary bid teams consisting of partners, managers, consultants, subject matter experts and in some cases external stakeholders;
  • Managing timelines, progress, compliance and quality throughout the entire bid process;
  • Organising reviews and critically assessing contributions before submission;
  • Safeguarding legal and procedural requirements, particularly for European public tenders;
  • Reporting on the tender pipeline, results and performance to the CRO;
  • Evaluating completed bids and systematically translating lessons learned into improvements;
  • Further developing governance, processes, tooling, knowledge management and reporting within the Tender Desk;
  • Using data, technology and AI to make the bid process smarter, more efficient and more effective;
  • Training and coaching colleagues who contribute to bids and helping to increase bid management maturity across the organisation;
  • In case of emergency, it is important to also be able to write tenders yourself.

As Bid Manager, you ensure that the overall process works: that the right people contribute, deadlines are met, decisions are made and strategy, quality and content come together.

You are a Bid Manager, not a Bid Writer

That distinction is important.

At Valcon, consultants, partners and subject-matter experts provide the content and contribute to the actual writing of bids. Some colleagues will be specifically trained to participate regularly in tender processes, while others may have limited experience with public tenders.

Your role is not to take over their writing. Instead, you ensure the team understands what is required, why it matters and when it needs to be delivered.

You are therefore a project manager, strategist, quality gatekeeper and challenger at the same time.

You are comfortable challenging an experienced consultant or partner when their contribution is not yet strong enough. You ask the right questions, keep the team focused on the agreed strategy and know how to create momentum without relying on formal authority.

Strong stakeholder management is therefore essential. You need to be able to lead complex projects and influence senior stakeholders, partners and consultants across the organisation.

Building the Tender Desk

In addition to managing individual bids, you will have another important responsibility: further professionalising Tender Management within Valcon.

A foundation is being created, but the way of working is still developing. This means you are not stepping into a fully established function where everything has already been defined.

Instead, you will have the opportunity to further shape the processes, standards, governance, tooling and knowledge-sharing structure behind successful tender management.

A modern approach to Bid Management is essential. Valcon aims to integrate data and AI into the bid process and is looking for someone who actively embraces these developments. You understand how technology can support opportunity identification, knowledge management, collaboration, quality and efficiency, and you are keen to explore how AI can become an integral part of the bid management process.

What do we offer you?

  • Personal development: a tailor-made growth path with training, courses, certification and mentoring by experienced colleagues.
  • An innovative work environment: collaborate with a team of experts pushing boundaries in data, technology, and consulting.
  • Inspiring work culture: a supportive, flexible, and no-nonsense environment that fosters your growth and fully allows you to be yourself.

Additionally, we offer:

  • Competitive employment benefits, including bonuses and expense allowance.
  • A company car or mobility budget.
  • A workplace that prioritizes and respects your work-life balance (for example by offering you the option of taking a sabbatical or expand the amount of holidays per year).
  • An affordable sports membership that allows you to participate in 50 different sports offered by over 10,000 partners.
  • The opportunity to work remotely from abroad for 10 days per year.
  • A vibrant community that organizes both professional and social events.

What do you bring to the table?

You are an experienced bid or tender management professional who is ready for a role in which strategy, leadership and coordination carry more weight than writing proposals yourself.

Ideally, you bring:

  • A demonstrable track record of contributing to successful bids and winning significant opportunities.
  • Significant experience in Bid Management and/or Tender Management within a complex professional environment;
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to create structure, organise decision-making and manage multiple workstreams and deadlines;
  • Strong senior stakeholder management skills and the ability to influence without formal authority;
  • The ability to assess tenders and commercial opportunities from a strategic and commercial perspective;
  • Experience within consulting, professional services or another knowledge-intensive environment is a strong advantage;
  • Affinity with data, AI and modern bid management tooling;
  • Experience coaching colleagues and helping teams adopt new ways of working;

Who are you?

You have the seniority and confidence to take the lead while still knowing how to bring people with you.

You can move comfortably between strategic discussions and operational delivery and thrive in an environment with senior professionals who each bring their own expertise, priorities and perspectives to a bid.

You are analytical and commercially minded, but also pragmatic. You ask challenging questions, make decisions when needed and are comfortable questioning whether the quality of a tender is genuinely good enough.

At the same time, you enjoy building and developing: teams, processes and a Bid Management capability that is still evolving.

Ready to apply?

Has the above sparked your interest and are you ready to join our innovative and impactful environment? And do our core values - Together, Joy, Curious, Can do, and Integrity - resonate with you?

Our recruitment team would be happy to hear from you! Please apply directly or get in touch with our recruitment team ----- to schedule a coffee meeting at our office first.

Enterprise Sales Executive, Healthcare and Life Sciences - US-Based

About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary:

As an Enterprise Sales Executive at Toptal, you will be a key driver of growth within our Healthcare and Life Sciences (HLS) industry vertical. In this role, you will identify, develop, and close opportunities with enterprise provider, payer and life sciences clients by helping them solve complex business challenges across a broad range of capabilities, including technology, marketing, management consulting, and AI-enabled transformation. You will develop tailored solutions that help clients accelerate strategic initiatives and achieve measurable business outcomes.

This role is designed for true hunters who thrive in a high-performance, client-facing environment. It is ideal for individuals who are passionate about building a book of business from the ground up, forging executive relationships, and creating long-term client value. Success in this role is measured by your ability to convert new enterprise relationships into durable revenue and to establish Toptal as a core services provider embedded in your clients’ critical initiatives.

This is a remote position with concentrated field work across the US. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Applicants must be authorized to work in the US at the time of hire. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Job Summary:

Healthcare and Life Sciences organizations are transforming due to regulatory changes, and pressure to perform far outpacing their current abilities. AI has shifted from experimentation to execution, and companies across this sector are actively rebuilding how work gets done, across therapeutic development, care delivery and healthcare financing. Toptal’s Healthcare and Life Sciences (HLS) vertical already partners with some of the largest organizations in the world on exactly this work.

This role exists to bring expanded coverage to the US, where our client concentration and opportunity density are highest, and to convert that density into new enterprise relationships. You will report directly to the General Manager of the Healthcare and Life Sciences (HLS) industry vertical.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

You will be responsible for building a targeted portfolio of accounts via identifying, prioritizing, and developing your own book of business rather than inheriting an existing one. Once you have signed net new customers, you will partner with Client Partners to deepen and expand those strategic relationships over time. Net new accounts typically involve mid-level stakeholders across one or two business units and call for a disciplined, transactional approach, matching skills to immediate needs with speed and precision. As relationships mature, accounts become more complex, with deeper engagement across multiple business units and senior executive relationships. These accounts demand a highly consultative, strategic approach that includes navigating cross-functional priorities, aligning to evolving client business objectives, and demonstrating credibility at the C-suite level. Success will require the ability to adapt your engagement style to the maturity and complexity of each account, while consistently driving value and long-term growth.

  • Own and build a portfolio of enterprise Healthcare and Life Sciences (HLS) accounts, with direct accountability for new logo acquisition, revenue growth, and client outcomes.
  • Prospect, pitch, negotiate, and close new opportunities in close partnership with our Sales Development Representatives (SDRs), while expanding the relationships you establish.
  • Define and execute account strategy, including opportunity creation, pipeline development, and multi-year growth planning.
  • Lead solution development and deal execution in partnership with Industry GMs, Practice Leaders, Pursuits, and Delivery teams.
  • Partner with Client Partners to drive coordinated account expansion and maximize total account value as accounts mature.
  • Shape industry solutions that apply Toptal’s technology, marketing, consulting, and AI capabilities to the operating model challenges facing healthcare and life sciences organizations.
  • Maintain disciplined pipeline and account intelligence to support accurate forecasting and informed decision-making.
  • Lead strategic conversations with prospective and existing clients, while exercising discretion and independent judgment.

Your portfolio will ramp over your first 9-12 months, after which you will be measured against an annualized gross sales target of $3.5M, aligning with our broader portfolio strategies.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Onboard with Toptal and meet your TopPal.
  • Learn the core of Toptal’s model, our value proposition, and our deep capabilities.
  • Familiarize yourself with the tools and resources needed to be successful.
  • Dive into our sales methods, our selling processes, and playbooks.
  • Become familiar with our contracting and legal methodologies, templates, tools, and processes.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Meet key Toptal stakeholders who will support your success and the success of the overall team.
  • Learn about the Industry Go-To-Market Strategy, our key sales plays, and our client engagement model.
  • Work with the Healthcare and Life Sciences (HLS) General Manager to establish a portfolio strategy and build account plans.
  • Shadow key calls and client meetings.
  • Begin to meet with clients, leveraging your existing industry network and relationships, to articulate Toptal’s capabilities and identify where we can help organizations.
  • Begin prospecting and actively engaging target accounts within your portfolio.
  • Meet with SDRs, Client Partners, and cross-functional team members to align on joint account strategies.
  • Collaborate with Pursuits and Delivery teams to understand how we design engagements.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Exercise discretion and independent judgment in the negotiation of contracts, work collaboratively with clients, and help them engage with Toptal’s capabilities and specialists.
  • Begin shaping industry solutions that resonate with your target accounts, including AI-enabled approaches, demonstrating your comfort and ability in working with ambiguity and directly working to innovate alongside your clients.
  • Establish credibility with client stakeholders through informed, consultative engagement tied to their priorities and current initiatives.
  • Own your pipeline and forecast with confidence.
  • Develop proposals and close your first set of deals.
  • Actively contribute to team rituals, best practice sharing, and win/loss reviews.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Have an initial base of active clients while continuing to build your overall portfolio.
  • Expand your buyer network and deepen executive engagement across your accounts.
  • Drive net new opportunities by introducing additional capabilities and displacing incumbent providers.
  • Shape and influence client priorities, aligning Toptal’s solutions to critical business objectives.
  • Execute against a defined growth plan tied to measurable outcomes.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Have built a list of incredible client accounts, advising them on how to utilize our capabilities to address their priorities and key business challenges.
  • Establish and expand a strong executive network across your portfolio, building a foundation of advocates and sponsors.
  • Begin to mentor new members of the team, teaching them about Toptal, our model, and how to successfully grow their territory.
  • Be recognized for your subject matter expertise in the Healthcare and Life Sciences (HLS) industry, leveraging your existing industry network and relationships as well as your proven consultative selling skills to drive meaningful results for your clients and the overall industry team.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree is required.
  • 7-10+ years of experience in professional services, ideally gained at a leading consulting firm, with a strong foundation in enterprise account management and solution selling. For instance, experience in a Director, Principal, or Client Service Partner role at a top consulting firm.
  • Extensive experience in consultative customer engagement and selling of service-oriented or outcome-based solutions, particularly within the Healthcare and Life Sciences (HLS) industry, with focus in any or all of the Provider, Medical Device, Bio-Pharma and Payer subsegments.
  • Demonstrated success building a book of business from the ground up, i.e. self-sourcing, prospecting, and developing new enterprise relationships rather than relying on an inherited portfolio.
  • Proven track record managing a $5M+ annualized gross portfolio and closing $250K+ complex, multi-phase deals with enterprise clients with $2B+ in annual revenue.
  • Must be comfortable engaging C-level executives on industry trends impacting Healthcare and Life Sciences (HLS).
  • A well-rounded understanding of Healthcare and Life Sciences (HLS) industry challenges and trends, including how AI is reshaping care delivery and therapeutic design models, and the ability to have an informed discussion about how Toptal’s technology, marketing, and management consulting capabilities can address the challenges they face
  • Exposure to hybrid talent models or alternative consulting delivery models.
  • Ability to build and execute account plans that lead to consistent portfolio growth and a healthy pipeline.
  • Proven success in collaborative prospecting, running virtual and on-site sales calls, and leading sales pursuits backed by a multidisciplinary team.
  • Experience negotiating complex service agreements with procurement and legal departments within enterprise accounts.
  • Ability to partner effectively across multiple internal teams to shape innovative solutions that drive client success.
  • Willingness and ability to travel to client sites, conferences, and team events (25–40%).
  • Passion for solving client problems with creativity and urgency.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • High level of intellectual curiosity, grit, and entrepreneurial spirit.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Essential Job Functions

  • Regularly and reliably attend scheduled virtual team meetings on camera.
  • Work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Use all required digital collaboration tools.
  • Prioritize and self-manage workflows and deadlines.

US FLSA Classification: Full-Time/Exempt

This position receives a base salary and is also eligible to earn monthly commissions based on revenue generated from engagements sold. For candidates who meet the qualifications and job requirements listed above, Individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. In the US, Toptal’s benefit offerings include participation in a 401(k) retirement plan; medical, dental, and vision health insurance plans; basic life insurance coverage and short-term and long-term disability coverage; access to flexible spending, dependent care, and health savings accounts; access to telehealth virtual doctors; an employee assistance program; and flexible paid time off.

As a key member of this rapidly expanding team, you’ll have the opportunity to take meaningful ownership—driving cutting-edge AdTech integrations, launching and managing strategic partnership programs, and helping scale Reddit’s developer ecosystem.

jobs.title: Senior Compiler Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Compiler Engineer

About OLIX

AI is growing faster than any technology in history and the explosion in demand has created a massive infrastructure gap; we can no longer build chips or power stations fast enough to keep up. The industry is still leaning on a ten-year-old hardware blueprint that has reached its limit. A new paradigm that is faster and more efficient will be the biggest economic opportunity of the next century and create the most important company of the next decade. The OLIX Decode Accelerator 1 (DX-1) is the first accelerator architected specifically for decode. Rack-scale co-design of logic, data movement, packaging, optics and interconnect enables a step change in system level performance.

The Role

We’re searching for Senior Compiler Engineer to join the team building the ML backend (compiler, run-time, and debugger) for our next-generation hardware that connect PyTorch, Tensorflow, JAX, and MXNet down to our low-level kernel drivers. Your mission will be to create seamless support for a broad ecosystem of large AI models, and ensure we are pushing the limits of their performance envelope by closely partnering with hardware and modelling teams to understand device trade-offs.

Responsibilities

  • Project Ownership: Own and deliver projects on your team's roadmap that unlock key high-impact technical and business milestones that drive the success of Olix.

  • Architect & Build: Design and implement our compiler, runtime, and debugger for PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, and MXNet on custom hardware.

  • Optimise Performance: Apply advanced techniques (layout, fusion, scheduling, tiling) to eliminate bottlenecks and maximise throughput.

  • Mentor & Encourage Standards: Lead code reviews, coach peers, and uphold best practices in ML backend and performance engineering for your team.

  • Guide Team Direction: Stay ahead of GPU, AI accelerator trends; propose and prototype innovations.

Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering with a focus on C/C++ programming.

  • Deep expertise in ML framework internals, compilers, low-level programming, and optimisation techniques.

  • Deep expertise in optimising Tensorflow, PyTorch or JAX deep learning models.

  • Deep expertise with multiple toolchains like LLVM, OpenXLA/XLA, MLIR, TVM.

  • Practical experience applying machine learning in high-performance computing contexts.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to think critically and creatively.

  • Experience in high-pace, dynamic work environments.

  • Excellent teamwork and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, telecoms engineering, mathematics, or a related field.

  • Personal projects are a key differentiating factor and hold more weight than other requirements.

Compensation & Equity

  • Competitive Salary: Commensurate with your experience, skills, and location

  • Equity & Ownership: Meaningful stock options. You’re not just joining the mission; you’re owning a piece of it

  • Proximity Bonus: We value your time. To minimise your commute and maximise your life, we offer an annual Living-Local Bonus if your residence is within 20 minutes of the office

  • Retirement Benefits: Employer-contributed retirement plans to help you build long-term financial security.

Due to U.S. export control regulations, candidates’ eligibility to work at OLIX depends on their most recent citizenship or permanent residency status. We are generally unable to consider applicants whose most recent citizenship or permanent residence is in certain restricted countries (currently including Iran, North Korea, Syria, Cuba, Russia, Belarus, China, Hong Kong, Macau, and Venezuela). Applicants who have subsequently obtained citizenship or permanent residency in another country not subject to these restrictions may still be eligible.

Thought Machine is looking for a talented Finance Systems Engineering Manager and will report into the Group Finance Director. The Manager will sit at the crossroads of accounting logic, systems architecture, and Generative AI. The business uses Workday Financials and needs someone experienced in usage of the system to continue with process improvements, maintain the system and support the Finance function. jobs.title: Marketing Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Marketing Operations Manager

About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

We're looking for a Marketing Operations Manager to join our Marketing Operations, RevOps team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help build the operational infrastructure needed to support our upmarket expansion into Mid-Market and Enterprise segments and be part of our Marketing Ops team as we scale our spend management platform across growth companies in Europe. If you're excited about designing account-based go-to-market systems, establishing AI enablement across operational workflows, and solving complex cross-functional challenges, and are passionate about marketing operations, RevOps, and systems architecture, then this is the opportunity for you!

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You’ll report to our Associate Director, Marketing Operations and work closely with teams in Marketing Operations, RevOps, and Sales Ops. Our team is highly collaborative and dedicated to powering how the marketing team runs—from campaign operations and reporting cadence through to AI adoption and process improvement. You’ll also have the chance to partner with teams across Data, BAT (Business Automation & Tools), CX Ops, and Engineering to ensure success and maintain a single account truth across systems.

What you’ll be doing

As a Marketing Operations Manager, you will:

  • Build and refine marketing operational frameworks – Lead initiatives to continuously improve campaign workflows, request intake, approval processes, team governance, MQL→MQA routing logic, and SDR/BDR handoff processes.

  • Own account intelligence and reporting cadence – Design account scoring models for Mid-Market and Enterprise, maintain executive dashboards, integrate intent/firmographic/behavioral signals into segmentation, and manage account assignment logic.

  • Drive AI adoption across Marketing Ops – Translate AI capabilities into operational reality by building processes, governance, and enablement that accelerate execution and scale output within the team.

  • Ensure tooling health and systems ownership – Manage HubSpot workflows, automations, and integrations while coordinating with BAT and Engineering on tech stack builds, QA standards, and enterprise tooling requirements.

  • Enable team capabilities and documentation habits – Upskill Marketing and Marketing Ops teammates through shared standards, QA checklists, repeatable guides, templates, and onboarding resources to raise the operational floor.

What you bring

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • HubSpot Fluency – A solid understanding of designing workflows, routing logic, and automation in HubSpot, including its limitations and when to extend outside the platform.

  • Account Operations Mindset – Track record of building ABM operational processes, MQL-to-MQA scoring rules, multi-stakeholder buying committee motions, and AI/automation adoption that sticks.

  • Sales Ops Partnership – Ability to collaborate seamlessly with Sales Ops on account strategy, territory strategy, handoff logic, and rep productivity without jargon.

  • Data & Documentation Habits – Excellent habits in building auditable specs, validating data quality, and diagnosing root causes in data flows alongside Data and BAT teams.

  • Experience with multi-touch attribution modeling, lifecycle marketing operations (nurture flows, recycling, engagement scoring), and ABM platforms / account intelligence tools.

  • A background in seeing a company move upmarket to Mid-Market/Enterprise and building scalable, long-term GTM operations.

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You are an operational thinker who naturally designs sustainable systems, governance, and frameworks rather than executing quick-fix tasks.

  • You love working cross-functionally across Marketing, Sales Ops, and Data teams to streamline GTM processes and remove friction.

  • You are energized by driving practical AI adoption and upskilling team members through documentation, templates, and shared standards.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You prefer operating in established, rigid systems rather than designing new account-based infrastructure in ambiguous environments.

  • You look at marketing operations as purely executing inbound lead lists without considering account context or buying committees.

  • You rely on tribal knowledge rather than maintaining clear, auditable documentation and QA standards for your builds.

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll:

  • Lead the launch of our account segmentation model to directly power SDR assignments and Mid-Market/Enterprise routing.

  • Collaborate with Data and Marketing Ops teams to clean up attribution, reporting, and lifecycle data so performance metrics are fully trusted.

  • Grow your skills in AI enablement, enterprise GTM systems, and cross-functional RevOps alignment, taking on new challenges as the company continues to scale.

We’re committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on bigger projects, stepping into leadership, or acquiring new skills in advanced RevOps and enterprise go-to-market strategies.

The location

Please note: We can hire on a hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

Show me the benefits!

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

  • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

  • 25 days of annual leave + public holidays (additional days may apply in select countries based on local standards).

  • For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

  • We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  2. Hiring Manager Interview: A 45 mins chat with the hiring manager, to deep dive in your experience and role

  3. Pleo Challenge and Team Interview: We will send you a take home test and invite you to present during a 60 minute team interview. This is an opportunity to show us how you would handle the day to day of the role

  4. Final Interview: A final interview with a senior leader

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired for this role, we received a vast number of applications but only a few were selected for an intro call. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:

  • CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

  • Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

Electrician Career Coach

Part-Time Electrician Career Coach

(Flexible, Paid Workshops + Upside)

About CourseCareers

CourseCareers is an online education platform that helps people launch new careers without a college degree or prior experience.

We work with industry professionals to create job-focused courses that teach practical, employer-aligned skills in technology, business, and the skilled trades. Our students are career changers looking for realistic, entry-level opportunities — and coaching helps bridge the gap between coursework and landing the job.

About the Role

We’re looking for a part-time Electrician Career Coach to support students through live workshops and optional 1:1 coaching.

This is not a traditional employment role and not a guaranteed-income position. It’s a flexible, paid opportunity best suited for experienced electricians who enjoy mentoring, teaching, and helping others break into the trade — with upside if students choose to work with you.

How This Role Actually Works

  • You host a live, one-hour workshop (seminar-style) for students

  • You are paid $50 per workshop, plus any private coaching business you acquire

  • You may receive exclusive coaching opportunities based on performance and engagement

  • Workshops are used to provide value, answer questions, and showcase your real-world experience

  • If students choose to book you for 1:1 coaching, you keep the coaching revenue

  • You set your own availability and working hours

There is no requirement to convert students — workshops are paid regardless — but conversion is where the upside comes from.

Responsibilities

  • Host a live, one-hour workshop on a monthly basis

  • Answer student questions about the electrical trade and job search

  • Share real-world insight into what entry-level electrician roles and apprenticeships actually look like

  • Provide optional 1:1 coaching to students who request it

What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years of professional experience as an electrician (residential, commercial, or industrial)

  • Interest in mentoring and helping career changers enter the trades

  • Strong communication and teaching ability

  • Availability at least three evenings per week, ideally Tuesday–Thursday

  • Self-starter mindset — comfortable leading workshops independently

Ideal Fit

This role is a great fit if you:

  • Enjoy teaching and mentoring

  • Want flexible, side income

  • Like the idea of being paid to teach — with optional upside

  • Don’t need guaranteed hours or full-time income

Compensation

  • $50 per one-hour workshop (One per month guaranteed)

  • Unlimited upside from 1:1 coaching sessions you convert

  • No caps, no quotas, no minimums

Compliance Strategist

About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

jobs.title: Golang Backend Engineer, Financial Product Fraud
jobs.description:
Golang Backend Engineer, Financial Product Fraud

Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Your job is to make sure every payout and transaction lands with the right person.

We have spent years getting very good at protecting the things a marketplace has always had to protect: checkout fraud, account takeover, courier abuse. But we are no longer only a marketplace. We now issue banking products, lend to merchants, move instant payouts to couriers, and collect cash on the doorstep. Every one of those is a new way for money to leave the platform.

This is a new team, and it owns that surface: fraud wherever money moves through the platform. Who receives it, who lends it, who collects it, and who holds it in a financial account. Think instant payout rails, merchant cash advances, and platform-issued banking and earned-wage products serving millions of couriers and merchants. These are live loss surfaces, and the volume grows with every financial product we launch.

We are now looking for a Backend Engineer (Golang) to build that protection. You will design and ship real-time detection and automated enforcement for our financial products across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo. The work is high-throughput, low-latency, and unusually consequential: a rule you ship on Monday can stop a serious loss by Friday. It is also close to greenfield, so you will be setting the patterns every future financial product inherits on day one.

This role will be based in London, UK as one of the founding engineering roles in our London hub, working closely with our teams in Helsinki and Berlin.

What you'll do:

  • Build and maintain high-throughput, low-latency backend services in Go that score financial events in real time, including payout enrollments, bank account links, credit applications, and account-to-account transfers.
  • Design fraud detection and automated enforcement for our financial products end to end: from signal collection through to the decision that blocks a fraudulent payout.
  • Build on and extend our shared fraud decisioning platform, so signals, rules, and models work across all three of our brands instead of being rebuilt three times.
  • Partner closely with risk analysts, data scientists, and product managers to turn observed fraud patterns into shipped detection, and to know when a rule, a model, or a product change is the right answer.
  • Work across team boundaries with our account security, payments fraud, and financial product teams. We build on their signals rather than rebuild them, so clean interfaces matter.
  • Contribute to architectural discussions and technical decisions as we establish the fraud infrastructure baseline for financial products, with support from senior engineers on the team.
  • Write well-tested, observable code and help the team hold a high quality bar. In fraud, a silent failure is a loss event.

Our expectations:

  • 3 to 6 years of professional software engineering experience, including backend services you have shipped and owned in production.
  • 1+ years of production experience in Golang, or strong experience in another backend language and real enthusiasm for picking Go up quickly.
  • A working understanding of low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems. Real-time decisioning comes with a latency budget, and you are keen to learn to build inside one.
  • Hands-on experience with SQL and/or NoSQL databases, and some exposure to event-driven architectures (Kafka or similar).
  • Willingness to operate what you build, including a share of on-call, with a pragmatic approach to reliability.
  • Uses AI tooling in day-to-day development and can critically evaluate its output for correctness and quality.

Nice to have

  • Experience in fraud, risk, payments, lending, or financial crime, especially money movement fraud, bank account linking fraud, payout abuse, or lending fraud.
  • Experience with rules engines, real-time feature stores, or ML model serving in a decisioning path.
  • Background in Kotlin, Java, Python, or Node.js alongside Go.
  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP).
  • Experience working across multiple brands, regions, or regulatory regimes.

What we value

  • A product-oriented mindset. You think beyond the ticket, understand the "why" behind the work, and take a high level of responsibility for outcomes rather than output.
  • Comfort with ambiguity. This is a new team on a new surface; parts of the charter are still being drawn, and you will help draw them.
  • A track record of owning a project or feature end to end, especially in fast-paced environments.
  • Clear and proactive communication, with a collaborative spirit. We work across three companies and several time zones, so we move fast, but we succeed together.
  • An adversarial instinct. The best fraud engineers enjoy thinking like the attacker.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

jobs.description:
Senior Product Manager - Commerce

Who is Boulevard?

Boulevard provides the first and only client experience platform for appointment-based, self-care businesses. We empower our customers to give their clients more of the magical moments that matter most.

Before launching in 2016, our founders spent months interviewing salon managers and working behind front desks to understand their pain points so we could design a modern, user-friendly platform that meets the unique needs of their business. Our roots may be in hair salons, but we are built for the broader self-care industry, including many types of salons, spas, medspa, barbershops, and more. Our technology not only helps our customers survive but thrive. Take a look at how we (and YOU) can make that happen.

We have an insatiable curiosity and embrace experimentation. We believe that simple solutions require the most sophistication, and we design each and every detail to maximize potential, power, and impact. Do our values match? Read through our story and what we value the most.

Our team values and celebrates our diverse backgrounds. Being open about who we are and what we do allows us to do the best work of our lives. We believe in equal opportunity for all, and you should too.

Come Do the Best Work of Your Life at Boulevard

Every transaction that flows through Boulevard is a moment of truth — for the client who just received a service, and for the business trying to run a great operation. Commerce isn't just a feature layer; it's the transactional layer that thousands of businesses rely on to deliver exceptional client service, transact, and grow revenue. When the experience is right, it's seamless. When it's not, friction ripples from the front desk all the way into the business' books.

As Boulevard expands upmarket, supports complex franchise brands, and grows internationally, the commerce experience has to scale with it — more flexible, more reliable, and more intuitive for the operators and clients who depend on it every day. As Senior PM for Commerce Experience, you'll partner closely with a dedicated engineering and design team, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate underlying capabilities into experiences that feel obvious, trustworthy, and complete for a business and their clients. You'll bring rigor to how we measure and improve those experiences over time, using data and customer insight to continuously close the gap between where things are and where they need to be.

What You'll Bring

-5+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 years in a B2B or SaaS environment and a track record of owning consumer-facing flows end-to-end

-Systems thinker: You connect the dots across complex workflows, multiple persona types, and technical constraints — and translate that into product decisions that feel simple to the people on the receiving end, whether that's a client completing a transaction or an operator running a multi-location business

-Commerce to close: You've owned experiences that span the full transaction lifecycle — from checkout through to financial reporting, accounting and the other data surfaces andbusiness tools operators depend on

-Strong design partnership: You bring design in early, push the thinking together, and hold a high bar for experience quality without losing sight of what's shippable

-Bias toward outcomes: You navigate ambiguity by anchoring on what actually matters — cutting through noise to find the right problem, and measuring your work by whether it moved something real for the business or the people using it

-Cross-functional influence: You've worked effectively across product, engineering, and adjacent teams without direct authority, and you know how to move work forward when ownership lines are blurry

-Fluency with AI tools as part of your own practice — to accelerate discovery, sharpen tradeoffs, or move faster

Preferred

-Experience in vertical SaaS, or services-industry platforms

How We Will Take Care Of You

At Boulevard, we work hard to structure compensation in a way that balances internal equity with local market competitiveness, and we’re happy to share a good-faith estimate of the base salary range for this role. For candidates in NYC, the SF Bay Area, and Seattle, the anticipated base salary range is $129,000 - $161,300 per year. For all other U.S. locations, the anticipated base salary range is $113,400 - $155,900 per year. In addition to this base compensation, this role may be eligible to participate in a variable compensation program. Final compensation will vary based on a variety of factors which include but are not limited to applicable experience, location, and final leveling.

How we take care of our team

Our business is deeply immersed in an industry that’s centered around helping people feel their best, so we know that taking care of yourself isn’t selfish; it’s essential. That’s why our culture pairs high standards with genuine care. We don't glorify burnout or wear ‘always on’ as a badge of honor. Instead, we’ve created benefits designed to support you inside and outside of work, so you can bring your best self to both.

Here’s how we support you:

  • Competitive base pay and performance bonus eligibility because you deserve to be rewarded for your impact.
  • Equity participation for all full-time employees because we believe the people helping build Boulevard should share in our long-term success.
  • Comprehensive medical coverage with up to 100% employee premium coverage and 75% dependent coverage to help take care of you and your loved ones.
  • An annual $1,200 HSA employer contribution for eligible plans to help support healthcare costs and future planning.
  • 100% covered dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, ensuring you stay healthy, protected, and ready for whatever life brings.
  • 12 weeks of fully paid U.S. parental leave supporting all new parents equally as they take the time to bond, adjust, and be present when welcoming a new family member.
  • Flexible paid time off, plus 10 U.S. company holidays, where you are encouraged to rest, recharge, and take the time you need, guilt-free.
  • Fully remote with support, including a $200 home office setup allowance and a $50 monthly WFH reimbursement so your workspace is set up for success.
  • $200 quarterly Boulevard Bucks to prioritize your well-being and stay connected to the industry we serve.
  • And other perks like One Medical membership and Employee Assistant Program.

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

HR Business Partner

About Our Company:

Headquartered in Denver, Colorado, Cologix is a leading North America network-neutral interconnection and hyperscale edge data center company. Our platform gives customers access to 45+ digital edge and Scalelogix℠ hyperscale edge data centers in 13 markets across the United States and Canada along with a carrier-dense ecosystem of 710+ networks, 360+ cloud providers, 35+ onramps and seven Internet exchanges. We provide our nearly 2,000 customers with direct access to our local operations teams, resulting in strong partnerships enabled by exceptional operational support and unparalleled customer service. Backed by one of the largest North American infrastructure funds, Cologix's experienced leadership team, certified staff and commitment to ESG initiatives help form a culture that values our people, our environment and our clients.

About the Position

We are seeking an experienced and proactive HR Business Partner to support employees, managers, and business leaders across multiple locations throughout the United States and Canada.

This role combines hands-on HR support with business partnership, manager enablement, performance management, leadership development, leave administration, and organizational effectiveness. The ideal candidate possesses strong HR expertise, sound judgment, and the ability to build effective relationships while providing practical guidance and supporting organizational objectives.

What You Do Daily

Manager Enablement & Leadership Development

  • Assist in the development and deliver manager training in collaboration with HR leadership to strengthen managerial skills and competencies.
  • Identify opportunities to improve team effectiveness and support managers in the consistent application of HR policies and procedures.

Leave Management & Employee Accommodations

  • Manage and administer employee leaves of absence across the US and Canada, including FMLA, state and provincial leave programs, disability-related absences, and other applicable leaves.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for employees and managers regarding leave eligibility, documentation requirements, leave status, and return-to-work processes.
  • Coordinate workplace accommodation and return-to-work arrangements in accordance with applicable laws and company policies.
  • Maintain accurate leave records and employee status information in Dayforce, monitor leave timelines, and coordinate with Payroll and Total Rewards as needed.

Talent Management & Organizational Development

  • Partner with leadership to identify talent development needs, high-potential employees, and opportunities to improve organizational effectiveness.
  • Support talent reviews, succession planning, employee development, and retention initiatives in collaboration with HR leadership.
  • Evaluate employee exit feedback and turnover trends to identify retention risks and recommend improvements to the employee experience.

HR Projects, Analytics & Compliance

  • Support HR initiatives, including employee engagement surveys, policy development, organizational design, and process improvements.
  • Analyze workforce metrics, including turnover, retention, engagement, and performance trends, to identify opportunities and recommend improvements.
  • Support the development, implementation, and consistent application of HR policies and programs across the US and Canada.
  • Coordinate federal, state, provincial, and other applicable regulatory reporting requirements, collaborating with internal stakeholders to ensure accurate and timely submissions.
  • Monitor employment law and regulatory changes, provide compliance-related guidance to managers, and identify potential impacts on HR policies and practices.

Employee Relations

  • Assist with employee relations activities and recommend appropriate resolutions, escalating complex or sensitive matters as needed.
  • Promote a positive workplace culture through consistent application of HR policies, effective communication, and employee engagement.

Performance Management

  • Coordinate and administer performance management processes, ensuring consistent implementation across the organization.
  • Analyze performance trends and partner with leadership to address challenges, promote accountability, and support employee development.

What Makes You a Good Fit

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Minimum of 7+ years of progressive HR experience, with a strong background in manager development, performance management, and business partnering.
  • Demonstrated ability to advise and influence managers and business leaders while handling sensitive employee matters with discretion and sound judgment.
  • Experience supporting talent management, organizational development, and employee engagement initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of employment laws and HR practices in the United States and Canada.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to interpret workforce data and recommend actionable solutions.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities and balance day-to-day HR responsibilities with longer-term initiatives.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint; experience with Dayforce or a comparable HRIS preferred.
  • SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, PHR, SPHR, or applicable Canadian HR designation preferred.
  • Conversational or fluent French language skills preferred; experience supporting geographically dispersed or multi-site operations is an asset.

About the Team

At AudioEye, we believe access to digital content is a fundamental right, not a privilege. Our mission is clear: eliminate every barrier to digital accessibility so that everyone, regardless of ability, can experience the web without limitations.

We are a team of passionate problem-solvers who are driven by purpose and impact. Every challenge we tackle moves us closer to a future where creating accessible experiences is the standard. Senior Product Designer

At TeamSnap, we believe when the world connects through sports; the world becomes better. TeamSnap is a sports and communication platform dedicated to taking the work out of play in youth sports. We also believe our jobs should excite us, our teammates should support us and our bosses should inspire us. TeamSnap is looking for a Senior Product Designer who will craft experiences that connect parents, coaches and players to make youth sports more fun. You will partner closely with product and engineer partners to drive features from discovery through execution. You’ll play a key role in establishing consistency, ease of use and innovation across TeamSnap consumer experiences.

What You'll Do:

  • Design high-impact, consistent, and intuitive user experiences across platforms, considering market trends, customer feedback, and quantitative data.
  • Conduct user research and leverage insights to define product requirements, using sketches, wireframes, and prototypes to guide the ideation process.
  • Use a data-driven approach to tie design decisions to user research while balancing business goals and technical constraints.
  • Partner closely with product managers and engineers to refine requirements, validate designs, and iterate based on feedback.
  • Manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment, maintaining a sense of urgency while delivering high-quality designs.
  • Shape, improve, and maintain the TeamSnap design system.

jobs.description:
ERP System Administrator (Acumatica)

The ERP System Administrator is an individual contributor role within Alimentiv’s Corporate Digital Enablement function, serving as the primary functional and technical owner of the Acumatica ERP platform that powers our Finance, Procurement, Logistics and Project accounting operations. This is a hands-on administration role — the successful candidate will configure, operate, and continuously improve Acumatica.

Another significant focus of the role is supporting the buildout of Acumatica’s procurement functionality — supporting Corporate and Clinical operations as Alimentiv’s procurement function matures. The role also owns the operational health of the SAP Concur–Acumatica integration via Celigo middleware and will play a central operational role in the planned annual Acumatica upgrades.

Positions available: 1, cross-posted in multiple countries. Please only apply to one posting.

About the Role

Acumatica Administration & Finance Operations (~40%)

• Serve as the primary Acumatica administrator across the Alimentiv instance: configuration, user access, security, workflows, and module settings.

• Design and implement Finance solutions using native Acumatica functionality — Generic Inquiries, Business Events, push notifications, custom reports, and approval workflows.

• Support and optimize core Finance workflows: accounts payable, accounts receivable, general ledger, project accounting, billing, financial reporting, and month-end close.

• Partner with Finance to define requirements, document processes, and deliver Acumatica enhancements that improve data quality and operational efficiency.

• Troubleshoot and resolve Acumatica issues; coordinate with the Acumatica implementation partner while building internal capability over time and reducing vendor dependency.

• Maintain rigorous test environment discipline — validate all configurations in test before promoting to Production; ensure changes touching shared multi-tenant surfaces receive appropriate cross-domain approval.

Procurement & Projects Enablement (~25%)

• Partner with the Procurement function to continuously improve Acumatica’s procurement functionality— vendor management, requisitions, purchase orders, Concur-Acumatica integrations.

• Configure and test procurement workflows aligned with Alimentiv’s project-governed, goods & services-based procurement model.

• Maximize native Acumatica capabilities over customizations or third-party procurement platforms

• Support Procurement through discovery, requirements, configuration, testing, training, and operational rollout.

• Coordinate cross-domain approval and impact assessment for procurement-related changes given the shared instance and the downstream impact on Finance, Projects, and FP&A.

Integration Operational Ownership (~20%)

• Serve as the technical owner of the SAP Concur–Acumatica integration — understanding the end-to-end flow, triaging invoice processing, field mapping, and exception issues, and coordinating resolution with the integration developer and vendors.

• Monitor integration flows for errors, investigate root causes, and coordinate resolution with the integration developer and vendors — serving as the primary triage owner.

• Partner with the integration developer on the health of adjacent integrations including Host-to-Host banking, BambooHR HR sync, and ADF data pipelines to Power BI.

• Document integration architecture, field mappings, data flows, and change history to a standard that enables internal troubleshooting without vendor dependency.

• Lead integration change governance: ensure formal intake and approval before initiating vendor or system changes that could affect integrations.

Upgrade, Governance & Continuous Improvement (~15%)

• Play a central operational role in the planned Acumatica upgrades — customization risk assessment, validation, coordinated rollout, and post-upgrade stabilization.

• Operate within Alimentiv’s gate-based Finance Change Delivery Process; use JIRA as the system of record for change approval and evidence.

• Maintain living documentation of Acumatica configuration, customizationsand governance decisions.

What we're looking for

Required

Minimum 5 years hands-on Acumatica administration experience across Finance and adjacent modules. Candidates without direct Acumatica experience will not be considered.

  • Hands-on SAP Concur experience in invoice processing, AP workflows, or system administration.
  • Demonstrated experience with Acumatica major-version upgrades — including customization risk assessment, test validation, and coordinated rollout.
  • Hands-on experience with Acumatica Generic Inquiries, Business Events, push notifications, and approval workflow configuration.

Preferred

  • Experience administering Acumatica across Finance, Projects, and Procurement functionality. Ability to configure, troubleshoot, and improve any module deployed in the instance — and to learn new modules as the business adopts them.
  • Experience ERP system integrations with or without middleware e.g. Celigo.
  • Experience with Power BI or similar BI/reporting tools connected to ERP data sources.
  • Experience working in a professional services, CRO, or life sciences environment.
  • Acumatica certifications strongly preferred: Business Consultant, Advanced Financials, or equivalent.
  • Additional Acumatica certifications (Project Accounting, Manufacturing, Construction) an asset.

Compensation

At TeamSnap, we believe when the world connects through sports; the world becomes better. TeamSnap is a sports and communication platform dedicated to taking the work out of play in youth sports. About FastSpring:

FastSpring is how AI, SaaS, gaming, software, and digital product companies sell online in more places around the world. We handle all payment needs from checkout to taxes so you can go farther faster.

Founded in 2005, we are a privately owned company headquartered in Santa Barbara with offices in Amsterdam, Austin, Belfast, Dublin, Halifax, and Singapore.

The Position:

FastSpring is looking for a Senior Data Product Manager who has operated as a product innovator and data steward to drive both product innovation in analytics and trust for our sellers. FastSpring is a SaaS leader in subscription billing. This person will be responsible for executing the product strategy by discovering and delivering winning solutions that solve unmet needs, delights customers, and drive business growth. You will work cross-functionality with various teams and executives to identify market growth opportunities, prioritize features, and execute go-to-market strategies.

This role will report to the VP of Product who reports to the CPTO.

Responsibilities:

  • Define, evangelize, and execute a data product roadmap that services our sellers needs by providing actionable insights in and out of the FastSpring ecosystem.
  • Gather data use cases for both external and internal customers to craft a next generation data warehouse for improved efficiency and performance and partner with data engineering to implement it.
  • Identify and prioritize new product opportunities based on internal and external research and deep understanding of customer challenges and market trends.
  • Work closely with a dedicated agile development team to define user stories, research appropriate technical solutions, coordinate delivery, and drive adoption.
  • Gather and synthesize user feedback from various inputs to identify, prioritize, and champion new product opportunities to drive business outcomes.
  • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to develop business cases for new product development ideas, lead the prioritization of these ideas, and work to gain alignment across the business.
  • Develop a deep understanding of the market and our users by interviewing customers and stakeholders, conducting competitive analysis, and keeping abreast of industry news and trends.
  • Rigorously test and validate new ideas, present fact-based rationale for product prioritization initiatives, and establish and measure success metrics.
  • Define and measure product feature success based on objective and observable criteria.

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of product management experience in a SaaS environment.
  • Understanding of data pipelines, schemas, and the tools that enable them.
  • Proficiency in SQL, Python, R, or equivalent analytical tools.
  • Experience with Data APIs.
  • Exceptional communicator (written, verbal and presentation); able to quickly synthesize and communicate complex concepts to a wide range of audiences.
